501f827c.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Infiniband and Networking Ethernet - NVIS
501f827c.description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large\-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real\-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.
* Provide feedback to internal teams such as opening bugs, documenting workarounds, and suggesting improvements.


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields.
* At least 5\+ years of professional experience in networking fundamentals, Ethernet or InfiniBand World.
* Hands\-on experience with network switch/router platforms like Cumulus Linux, SONiC, IOS, JunosOS, and EOS, etc.
* Possess solid working knowledge of Ethernet/InfiniBand/RDMA core principles.
* Be proficient in end\-to\-end IB/Eth cluster deployment, adapter configuration and firmware maintenance, and able to conduct professional performance benchmarking with mainstream RDMA testing tools.
* Capable of independently diagnosing and troubleshooting typical IB/Eth network anomalies, including link flapping, connection failure, as well as bandwidth and latency jitter issues.
* Master practical RDMA network optimization strategies such as QP tuning, MTU configuration and congestion control optimization.
* Hands\-on working experience in RDMA\-accelerated business scenarios, including distributed storage and high\-performance computing clusters.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning solutions using tools like Ansible, Salt, and Python.
* Ability to develop CI/CD pipelines for network operations.
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are essential.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Familiarity with cloud networks (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus.
* Advanced Linux or Networking Certifications.
* Experience with High\-performance computing architectures. Understanding of how job schedulers(Slurm, PBS) work.
* luster management technologies knowledge (bonus credit for BCM (Base Command Manager).)
* Experience with GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) focused hardware/software.

862bde50.title: Senior Specialist - SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Administrator II - OTC
862bde50.description:
**Job Description**
 As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the world’s top professional services firms, and in support of our global workforce strategy, we’re growing our operations in India! We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!
   

  

 CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices worldwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.
   

  

 We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a
 **Senior Specialist or Developer II** 
 to join the
 **GDC** 
 team in our
 **SAP** 
 practice.
   

  

 CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings.
   

  

**YOUR TEAM.**
 This position will support our GDC team and this SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Administrator is responsible for the comprehensive management, maintenance, and optimization of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems. This role involves ensuring system performance, reliability, and security while supporting business operations and strategic initiatives.
   

  

**WHY COHNREZNICK?**
 At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.
   

  

 We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning \& development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
   

  

**YOUR ROLE.**
**Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To**
* Configure and maintain financial applications within SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
* OTC Process Management
* Architect, configure, and maintain SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud OTC processes, ensuring end\-to\-end order lifecycle from order entry to invoicing and cash application.


* Integration
+ Integrate OTC with other SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud modules (FICO, Project Systems) and external systems using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), APIs, and EDI/IDoc interfaces.

* System Optimization
+ Monitor OTC transaction flows, troubleshoot issues, and optimize performance.
+ Oversee upgrades, UAT, and change management for OTC and cross\-functional projects.

* Support \& Training
+ Provide advanced support and training to OTC users, ensuring adoption and satisfaction.

* Continuous Improvement
+ Drive automation and process improvements leveraging SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Fiori apps and analytics.
+ Monitor system performance and proactively identify and resolve issues.
+ Manage user access and security policies to safeguard system integrity.
+ Document system configurations and procedures for future reference and compliance.
+ Provide user support and training to ensure effective system utilization.
+ Lead system audits and compliance checks to meet regulatory requirements.
+ Implement new SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ecosystem modules and features to enhance system capabilities.
+ Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems with other business applications.
+ Develop and execute system improvement plans to optimize performance and efficiency.
+ Monitor all upcoming changes being deployed by SAP. Work on testing plans and keeping senior staff updated on upcoming changes.
+ Understand downstream impacts of changes including hot fixes. Create impact summary and review with leadership.
+ Execute UAT and tasks for Upgrades, Mergers and Acquisitions, Vendor Coordination, and other associated projects.
+ Monitor and troubleshoot SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ecosystem integrations.
+ Serve as backup to other team members to backfill during peak periods, PTO, etc.

**Outcomes**+ Efficiently manage and optimize SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems to support business operations.
+ Ensure high system performance and reliability to meet user needs.
+ Implement/Maintain robust user access and security policies to protect system data.
+ Resolve complex system issues promptly to minimize downtime.
+ Maintain comprehensive system documentation for future reference.
+ Provide advanced user support and training to enhance system utilization.
+ Lead successful system audits and compliance checks to meet regulatory requirements.
+ Implement new SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud features and modules to enhance system capabilities.
+ Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to integrate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems with other business applications.

**Your Experience.**
**The successful candidate will have:**+ At least 3 to 5 years’ experience with SAP S/4 Hana Public Cloud with a focus on financial accounting or professional service organizations.
+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field to ensure foundational knowledge.
+ Excellent communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate with various stakeholders. Experience working in a global team environment.
+ In\-depth knowledge of data management to ensure data integrity.
+ SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud certification to validate expertise.
+ Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet business demands.
+ Lead meetings by setting clear objectives, driving focused and collaborative discussion, and ensuring accountability for timely completion of action items.

**Required Knowledge And Skills**+ Comprehensive knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud architecture to understand system components.
+ SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Expertise
+ Deep knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud OTC functionalities and SD module.
+ Familiarity with SAP Activate methodology, cloud implementation lifecycle, and best practices.


* Technical Skills
+ Experience with Fiori apps, workflow management, and user roles.
+ Proficiency in data migration tools (e.g., migration cockpit) and integration technologies.

* Business Process Knowledge
+ Strong understanding of Quote\-to\-Cash processes, pricing procedures, credit management, returns, and revenue recognition.

* Working knowledge and subject matter expertise in one or more SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud functional areas, including FICO, Order\-to\-Cash (OTC), Project Systems (PS), Security, and/or system integrations. Proficiency in system monitoring and performance tuning to maintain optimal operation.
* Advanced scripting skills (e.g., Bash, PowerShell) to automate tasks. (preferred)
* Strong understanding of user access and security management to protect system integrity.
* Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex issues. This includes what is an incident versus what is a defect.
* Expertise in data management systems (e.g., S4 Hana Public Cloud transport management) to manage data effectively.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies to lead system improvement initiatives i.e., SAP Activate.


**Technologies, Coding Languages, And Methodologies**
* SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud for enterprise resource planning.
* SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Fiori for user interface and experience.
* SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud GUI for system access and management.
* Windows and Microsoft Office Suite operating systems for diverse environments. Cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) for scalable infrastructure.


 In addition, please take a moment to review our
 **Universal Job Standards.**
 Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.
   

  

 "CohnReznick" is the brand name under which CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC and their respective subsidiaries provide professional services. CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiaries) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. CohnReznick LLP is a licensed CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC and its subsidiaries are not licensed CPA firms.
   

  

 CohnReznick is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team to drive business results and create a better future every day for our team members, clients, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

89c352fa.title: Service Delivery Manager
89c352fa.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier
 **agentic platform for personalization** 
 .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the
 ***entire***
 customer journey.
   

  

* We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
* We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
* We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer\-first work marketers were always meant to do.


 And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine —
 **Loomi** 
 — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.
   

  

**About The SDM Team**
 The Service Delivery Management team at Bloomreach is the engine behind every successful customer implementation. We don't just manage projects — we orchestrate complex, multi\-workstream implementations that bring Bloomreach's AI\-powered platform to life for the world's leading brands.
   

  

**What makes our SDM team different in 2026:**
* AI\-native operations — We use Von (our AI copilot), automated processes, and intelligent workflows to eliminate manual overhead and focus on high\-value delivery
* Agentic tooling — ClickUp automations, Slack\-integrated utilization tracking, and automated retrospective analysis are standard operating procedure
* Commercial ownership — SDMs own the services metrics for their projects, identify upsell opportunities, author/ review SOWs, and drive revenue through delivery excellence
* Cross\-pillar delivery — We implement across Marketing (Engagement), Search (Discovery), DataHub, and Loomi AI for Shopify (LAIS), often on the same project alongside Content platform


**The Role**
 As a Service Delivery Manager based in India, you will own the end\-to\-end delivery of Bloomreach implementation projects for customers across EMEA and APAC. You'll manage multiple concurrent projects, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and serve as the primary delivery contact for customers — ensuring every project lands on time, on budget, and with measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 This is not a traditional PM role. You'll be expected to leverage AI tools and automation to operate at a higher level — spending less time on status updates and more time on strategic delivery, risk mitigation, and commercial growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Delivery \& Execution**
* Own the project plan, schedule, milestones, dependencies, and critical path for 8–12 concurrent implementation projects
* Manage customer launches on the Bloomreach platform, including data migration, SDK integration, Event Streams / Item Collections setup, and go\-live readiness
* Facilitate customer meetings, articulate business requirements, and translate them into actionable implementation plans
* Provide proactive reporting — leveraging automated reporting tools (Von, ClickUp) rather than manual slide decks
* Own escalation management — identify risks early, communicate clearly, and drive resolution with the right stakeholders


**Commercial \& Strategic**
* Identify opportunities to sell additional services during project delivery — create Salesforce opportunities, helping in scoping and estimation
* Own the services metrics for your project portfolio — track utilization, manage scope, and ensure profitability
* Partner with Account Managers and CSMs to align delivery with the customer's broader success plan and renewal timeline


**AI\-First Operations**
* Use Von and other AI tools for meeting prep, status reporting, customer research, and project analysis
* Build and maintain automated workflows (ClickUp, Slack, Zapier) to streamline repetitive delivery tasks
* Contribute to the team's automation roadmap — propose and implement new ways to use AI in service delivery
* Use data and dashboards to drive project decisions, track delivery health, and identify patterns across your portfolio


**Collaboration**
* Work closely with Business Consultants (BCs), Solutions Consultants (SCs), AMs, and CSMs to ensure seamless handoffs and aligned delivery
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering teams on technical blockers, feature requests, and platform capabilities
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives like LAIS rollouts, DataHub migrations, and One Platform upgrades


**What You Bring**
**Must\-Have**
* 5–7 years of experience in project/program management within SaaS, martech, or digital services
* Proven track record of managing multiple concurrent implementation projects (10\+ simultaneously)
* Strong understanding of web technologies — APIs, SDKs, webhooks, data pipelines, frontend/backend architecture
* Experience with project management tools (ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or similar) and comfort building automations within them
* Commercial awareness — experience with SOW review, services scoping, and revenue tracking
* Excellent communication skills — ability to run customer\-facing meetings, write clear status reports, and manage stakeholder expectations across timezones (EMEA/APAC overlap required)
* Comfort with AI tools — active user of AI assistants, automation platforms, or similar technology in a professional context


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience with CDP/martech platforms (Bloomreach, Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC, Emarsys, or similar)
* Familiarity with Jinja templating, SQL, or scripting languages
* Experience working in a globally distributed team with EMEA/AMER stakeholders
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certification
* Experience with Salesforce CPQ or services quoting processes


**What Success Looks Like**
**Timeframe**
**Milestone**
**30 days**
 Onboarded on Bloomreach platform, tools (Von, ClickUp, Slack workflows), and processes. Shadowed 2–3 active projects.
   

  

**60 days**
 Independently managing 4–6 projects. First automated status report generated. The first customer meeting led solo.
   

  

**90 days**
 Full portfolio of 8–12 projects. First services upsell opportunities identified. Contributing to the team automation roadmap.
   

  

**6 months**
 Recognized as a reliable delivery partner by AMs and CSMs. Delivering projects on time with \>90% customer satisfaction. At least one new automation or process improvement shipped.
   

  

**Why Bloomreach**
* AI\-first company — You'll work with cutting\-edge AI (Loomi) and be expected to use AI in your own work, not just deliver it to customers
* Global impact — Your projects will power personalized experiences for millions of consumers across the world's leading brands
* Growth trajectory — The India SDM function is new, and you'll have the opportunity to shape how it operates from the ground up
* Collaborative culture — You'll work with smart, passionate people across engineering, product, sales, and customer success


 More things you'll like about Bloomreach:
   

  

**Culture:**
* A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.
* We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.
* We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.
* We work virtual\-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.
* We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.
* We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities \- every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer\*.
* The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4\.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4\.9/5


**Personal Development:**
* We have a People Development Program \- participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing \& updating competency maps for select functions.
* Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work\-related communications \& decision\-making challenges.\*
* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow\-up check\-ins.
* Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)\*


**Well\-being:**
* The Employee Assistance Program \-\- with counselors \-\- is available for non\-work\-related challenges.\*
* Subscription to Calm \- sleep and meditation app.\*
* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.
* We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.
* Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.\*


**Compensation:**
* Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.\*
* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.\*
* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!
* We reward \& celebrate work anniversaries \-\- Bloomversaries!\*


*(\*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)*

381a285c.title: Program Manager, Practice Lab
381a285c.description:
**Job Description: Program Manager, Practice Lab**
**Location:** 
 Mathura
   

  

**Type** 
 : Full\-time, field\-intensive
   

  

**Reporting to:** 
 Program Director
   

  

**Saarthi Education: Overview**
 Saarthi Education is a non\-profit organisation focused on improving foundational numeracy outcomes in low\-resource schools by strengthening a core but underdeveloped element of classroom instruction: practice. We design and implement a structured, level\-based practice system that provides each child with daily, personalised arithmetic practice
   

  

 Our approach enables teachers to deliver targeted practice with minimal additional effort and has demonstrated consistent improvements in student learning outcomes. Our long\-term aim is to integrate high\-quality, targeted practice into mainstream pedagogy so that all children can achieve foundational mastery.
   

  

**Practice Lab: Overview**
 Practice Lab is a rapid, comparative testing ground for both tech\- and offline\-based practice products in Indian government schools. We implement multiple FLN solutions under the same conditions, like exact timetables, tablet ratios, and field support, to understand which tools drive the highest learning gains and why. The Lab also experiments with implementation models (dosage, device sharing, helper support) to define what it takes to deliver EdTech with high fidelity at scale. Insights from the Practice Lab inform product owners about potential improvements to their products and guide government and donors in making evidence\-based decisions about which products and models to adopt system\-wide.
   

  

**Program Manager: Role summary**
 Saarthi Education is launching Practice Lab, an ambitious effort to understand what truly works for EdTech\-based solutions in India's government schools. We will rigorously test multiple FLN products across government schools and uncover insights that can shape how millions of children learn.
   

  

 The Program Manager sits at the heart of this mission. You will bring this vision to life every day by enabling schools, supporting field workers and teachers, ensuring children get meaningful learning time, and making sure the Lab runs consistently and with high fidelity. This is an intensely hands\-on role:
 **80% field, 20% desk** 
 . It's designed for someone who feels energised by real classrooms, who can build trust with school leaders, who can guide teams through challenges, and who believes that excellent execution is what turns ideas into impact. If you are someone who wants to shape how practice\-based solutions (whether tech or offline) can reach and transform learning for children in India, this is a role where your leadership will matter every single day.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The role focuses on establishing the
 **gold standard** 
 for EdTech implementation in Indian government schools. The responsibilities can be categorised into three main sections:
   

  

* On\-ground operations
* 
* Train and manage a team of \~50 women field workers across the block.
* 
* Set up an EdTech Practice lab in each school: hardware, timetables, storage, SOPs
* 
* Design and implement school\-level processes (e.g., tablet allocation, session flow, troubleshooting, safeguarding).
* 
* Conduct regular school visits to ensure exceptionally high fidelity in daily usage.
* 
* Use dashboards to monitor usage/learning data and take corrective actions.
* 
* Firefight any operational challenges: device failures, low usage, field team absenteeism, timetable changes, etc.
* 
* Build strong relationships with Headmasters and teachers; appoint and coach school\-level usage champions.
* Government relations
* 
* Build strong relationships with district\-level officials (DEO, BEOs, ARPs).
* 
* Provide monthly updates and presentations to officials with clear, data\-backed insights.
* 
* Proactively manage risks related to school calendars, government events, and staff transfers.


**Skills Needed For The Role**
* Strong execution muscle
* 
* Proven ability to run large\-scale field operations in government schools with discipline and reliability. An ideal candidate will have around 3\-5 years of relevant on\-ground execution experience.
* 
* Skilled at designing, refining, and documenting processes/SOPs that bring clarity and consistency to operations.
* 
* Deep comfort with being on\-ground, solving real\-time challenges, and ensuring daily fidelity in implementation.
* 
* Strong data orientation, including the ability to read dashboards, spot trends, identify root causes, and act quickly.
* 
* High attention to detail and a bias for structured, evidence\-driven decision\-making
* Entrepreneurial leadership
* 
* Thrives in ambiguity and brings structure, clarity, and momentum to complex, fast\-changing environments.
* 
* Hands\-on, action\-oriented, and comfortable doing whatever it takes to keep the programme running smoothly.
* 
* Strong people leadership skills and ability to motivate, coach, and build accountability within distributed field teams.
* 
* Thinks like an owner: anticipates challenges, solves problems proactively, and consistently pushes for high\-quality execution.
* Technical and communication fluency
* 
* Able to translate field realities into crisp insights for internal teams, product partners, and government stakeholders.
* 
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to explain processes, give instructions, and share updates in a clear, simple, and structured way.
* 
* Comfortable working with Android tablets, basic troubleshooting, device setup, and understanding common tech issues in school environments.
* 
* Able to quickly diagnose app\-level problems, data sync issues, and communicate them clearly to product teams for fast resolution.


**Why this role matters**
 This is an opportunity to shape one of India's first Practice efficacy labs (EdTech and offline products). You will:
   

  

* Work closely with an International foundation's EdTech team
* Your work will directly influence how EdTech is deployed reliably in low\-resource settings and guide policy\-level decisions on FLN interventions.
* You will be the first to build the operational blueprint for a national EdTech Efficacy Lab and guide which EdTech and offline products the government scales.


**Compensation**
 We follow standard non\-profit compensation benchmarks. We will share the full compensation range openly with all shortlisted candidates before starting the selection process, so you have complete clarity from the beginning.
   

  

**Application process**
 To apply, please fill out this short form. Here is a brief overview of the selection process:
   

  

 Step 1: Intro call \- A 45\-minute call with shortlisted candidates to discuss the role in more detail.
   

  

 Step 2: Process Exercise \- A 4\-hour live exercise followed by an hour of debrief
   

  

 Step 3: Fieldwork \- A 6\-hour field\-level exercise followed by an hour of debrief
   

  

*This position was originally posted by Saarthi Education and has been curated by PurposePhil Career. To apply, please visit the original listing on the "apply" link on the side. We are not affiliated with the employer organization of this job ad or consultancy, and provide this curated listing as a service to our users.*

28805cf9.title: Gen AI Architect
28805cf9.description:
We are seeking a seasoned
 **Generative AI Architect with a strong foundation in enterprise and system architecture, combined with significant depth and breadth in Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI application development.** 




 This is a senior cross\-cutting role responsible for
 **architecting, designing, and guiding the implementation** 
 of Industry AI Solutions.
 



 The Generative AI Architect will serve as the technical authority for AI architecture decisions within their assigned teams, working alongside embedded GenAI Developers (who report to this architect for technical direction), traditional software engineers, and business stakeholders.
 



 The architect bridges the worlds of robust enterprise system design and cutting\-edge AI capabilities — translating business goals into scalable, secure, production\-ready GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
 



  





**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills** 




**Architecture \& Engineering Foundation** 




 • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related field.
 



 • Proven experience as a Solution Architect or Enterprise Architect (5\+ years), with a track record of designing large\-scale, production enterprise systems.
 



 • Strong command of system design principles: distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architecture, API design, cloud\-native patterns.
 



 • Experience architecting across cloud platforms, with strong preference for Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure API Management).
 



 Generative AI \& Agentic AI Expertise
 



 • Deep hands\-on experience with LLMs and GenAI application development — including RAG architecture, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and chain\-of\-thought design.
 



 • Proven experience architecting Agentic AI systems and multi\-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
 



 • Strong understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, and LLMOps practices — including tracing tools, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring.
 



 • Experience with vector databases and embedding stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, FAISS, Chroma, or similar).
 



 • Familiarity with LLM fine\-tuning approaches (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA) and when to apply them versus prompt\-based adaptation.
 



 Programming \& Technical Skills
 



 • Strong Python proficiency — able to prototype, review, and guide implementation of GenAI components.
 



 • Working knowledge of software engineering best practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, API design, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
 



 Responsible AI \& Governance
 



 • Sound knowledge of Safe AI principles, AI security patterns, AI governance frameworks, and data privacy compliance.
 



 • Ability to conduct AI risk assessments and embed governance into architecture decisions.
 



 Communication \& Leadership
 



 • Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions and drive consensus across multi\-disciplinary teams.
 



 • Effective at communicating architecture decisions, trade\-offs, and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences.
 



 • Experience mentoring developers and guiding teams through complex AI implementation challenges.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Experience leading AI architecture across multiple concurrent teams.
 



 • Familiarity with MLOps tooling and platforms (MLflow, Azure ML Pipelines, Weights \& Biases).
 



 • Exposure to multimodal AI models (vision\-language, speech\-to\-text, document AI).
 



 • Experience with enterprise AI governance and compliance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, or equivalent).
 



 • Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development workflows and coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or custom coding agents).
 



 • Prior experience in a product architecture role delivering Industry AI Solutions at enterprise scale.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 10\+ years of experience in respective domain.
* Solution Architecture
* Lead end\-to\-end solutioning activities for SAP transformation opportunities, including RFPs, RFIs, and proposal responses.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, account teams, and subject matter experts to define winning SAP solution strategies aligned with client requirements
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP solution architecture across core SAP S/4HANA business processes and cross\-workstream integration points.
* Translate business requirements and process designs into scalable SAP architecture, including fit\-to\-standard, extension, integration, reporting, security, and data considerations.
* Provide architecture oversight for SAP modules such as Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Plant Maintenance, Quality, Warehouse, Transportation, and HR interfaces, as applicable to the program scope.
* Define and govern solution principles, architectural guardrails, design decisions, and key integration patterns across SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Review functional and technical solution documents to ensure design completeness, consistency, and alignment with SAP best practices.


**Delivery Governance \& Program Leadership**
* Support full lifecycle SAP program delivery from discovery, design and build through testing, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.
* Drive architecture governance forums, solution review boards, design workshops, risk reviews, and key decision\-making discussions.
* Partner with project managers, workstream leads, technical leads, and client stakeholders to manage scope, dependencies, delivery plans, risks, issues, and quality gates.
* Identify cross\-functional gaps early and coordinate resolution across business process, application, integration, data, security, infrastructure, and change teams.
* Prepare leadership\-ready architecture updates, decision papers, options analysis, and steering committee inputs.


**Integration, Data \& Technical Oversight**
* Provide oversight for SAP integration architecture using SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, RFCs, event\-driven patterns, middleware, and third\-party platforms.
* Collaborate with data migration teams on data strategy, conversion design, mock migration planning, reconciliation, validation, cutover sequencing, and defect resolution.
* Assess custom developments, enhancements, RICEFW objects, forms, workflows, reports, and extensions to ensure maintainability and clean\-core alignment.
* Guide technical teams on architecture fitment across SAP S/4HANA, SAP RISE, BTP services, cloud integrations, analytics, identity, authorization, and infrastructure dependencies.


**Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure adherence to SAP Activate, fit\-to\-standard principles, agile delivery practices, documentation standards, and program quality gates.
* Conduct solution walkthroughs, design validations, test readiness reviews, cutover readiness checkpoints, and post\-go\-live stabilization reviews.
* Promote reusable assets, templates, accelerators, architectural playbooks, and delivery improvements across the SAP Architecture Team.
* Drive proactive risk identification and mitigation planning across architecture, integration, data migration, performance, security, and operational readiness.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Core SAP \& Transformation Expertise**
* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, SAP Activate methodology, enterprise process integration, and large transformation delivery models.
* Broad knowledge of SAP functional domains and cross\-module integration across finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, maintenance, quality, sales, and related business areas.
* Ability to evaluate business requirements, solution options, SAP standard capabilities, custom extension needs, integration requirements, and downstream operational implications.
* Experience with ECC to SAP S/4HANA transformation, brownfield, greenfield, selective data transition, or hybrid delivery approaches.


**Technical Architecture Skills**
* Working knowledge of SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, CDS views, Fiori, roles and authorizations, analytics, workflow, and cloud integration principles.
* Understanding of SAP RISE, hyperscaler environments, network/security dependencies, transport strategy, landscape planning, and operational readiness.
* Experience reviewing RICEFW scope, custom code remediation, simplification items, integration inventory, interface rationalization, and technical debt reduction.
* Knowledge of data migration strategy, master data governance, reconciliation, validation, migration cockpit, ETL tools, and cutover execution.


**Leadership \& Consulting Skills**
* Strong stakeholder management with the ability to engage business leaders, IT leadership, global process owners, vendors, and delivery teams.
* Ability to simplify complex SAP concepts into clear, actionable messages for leadership and project teams.
* Proven ability to lead distributed teams, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, and drive decisions in complex transformation environments.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, problem\-solving, decision\-making, and risk management skills.


**What We Offer You**

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

**EY \| Building a better working world**

 Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know\-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
   

  

 What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
   

  

 Peloton is seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud HCM Solution Architect to play a key role in a high\-growth practice area. This is a strategic, hands\-on role responsible for leading end\-to\-end solution design and guiding clients through complex HCM transformations using Oracle Cloud.
   

  

 As a Solution Architect, you will partner with business and IT stakeholders to define future\-state architectures, align business processes with Oracle leading practices, and ensure scalable, high\-quality solution delivery across the HCM suite.

* Recommending roadmaps to close performance gaps and developing high level implementation plans
* Gathering and analyzing benefits and open enrollment requirements
* Aligning business requirements and best practices to implement a technical solution
* Defining new and refining existing business processes
* Contributing to continuous improvement and development of Peloton processes and intellectual property


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* Qualified candidates must have a BS or BA degree in Business, Technology, or equivalent degree or experience in HCM.
* Overall 6\+ years of Experience with minimum of 2 to 3 years of experience in Oracle HCM Cloud.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in implementing Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Talent, Payroll, ORC and OTL.
* Minimum of 2\-3 modules and cross module knowledge.
* Experience in writing configuration workbooks and Understanding in Application Implementation Methodology.
* Experience with either development or reviewing fast formulas a plus.
* Ability to quickly understand HR concepts and apply to technology.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to work remotely and independently in support of clients
* Fit with Peloton culture and company values: teamwork, innovation, integrity, service, “can\-do” attitude, and communicating your ideas.


**Compensation**
 Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including
   

  

* Competitive base salary with performance\-based bonus
* Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
* Annual Health Wallet
* Group Medical Insurance
* Group Term Accident \& Life Insurance
* Paid holidays and PTO

195e9f1b.title: SAP Delivery Solution Architect-SENIOR MANAGER
195e9f1b.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title: SAP Delivery Solution Architect**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 10\+ years of experience in respective domain.
* Solution Architecture
* Lead end\-to\-end solutioning activities for SAP transformation opportunities, including RFPs, RFIs, and proposal responses.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, account teams, and subject matter experts to define winning SAP solution strategies aligned with client requirements
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP solution architecture across core SAP S/4HANA business processes and cross\-workstream integration points.
* Translate business requirements and process designs into scalable SAP architecture, including fit\-to\-standard, extension, integration, reporting, security, and data considerations.
* Provide architecture oversight for SAP modules such as Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Plant Maintenance, Quality, Warehouse, Transportation, and HR interfaces, as applicable to the program scope.
* Define and govern solution principles, architectural guardrails, design decisions, and key integration patterns across SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Review functional and technical solution documents to ensure design completeness, consistency, and alignment with SAP best practices.


**Delivery Governance \& Program Leadership**
* Support full lifecycle SAP program delivery from discovery, design and build through testing, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.
* Drive architecture governance forums, solution review boards, design workshops, risk reviews, and key decision\-making discussions.
* Partner with project managers, workstream leads, technical leads, and client stakeholders to manage scope, dependencies, delivery plans, risks, issues, and quality gates.
* Identify cross\-functional gaps early and coordinate resolution across business process, application, integration, data, security, infrastructure, and change teams.
* Prepare leadership\-ready architecture updates, decision papers, options analysis, and steering committee inputs.


**Integration, Data \& Technical Oversight**
* Provide oversight for SAP integration architecture using SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, RFCs, event\-driven patterns, middleware, and third\-party platforms.
* Collaborate with data migration teams on data strategy, conversion design, mock migration planning, reconciliation, validation, cutover sequencing, and defect resolution.
* Assess custom developments, enhancements, RICEFW objects, forms, workflows, reports, and extensions to ensure maintainability and clean\-core alignment.
* Guide technical teams on architecture fitment across SAP S/4HANA, SAP RISE, BTP services, cloud integrations, analytics, identity, authorization, and infrastructure dependencies.


**Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure adherence to SAP Activate, fit\-to\-standard principles, agile delivery practices, documentation standards, and program quality gates.
* Conduct solution walkthroughs, design validations, test readiness reviews, cutover readiness checkpoints, and post\-go\-live stabilization reviews.
* Promote reusable assets, templates, accelerators, architectural playbooks, and delivery improvements across the SAP Architecture Team.
* Drive proactive risk identification and mitigation planning across architecture, integration, data migration, performance, security, and operational readiness.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Core SAP \& Transformation Expertise**
* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, SAP Activate methodology, enterprise process integration, and large transformation delivery models.
* Broad knowledge of SAP functional domains and cross\-module integration across finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, maintenance, quality, sales, and related business areas.
* Ability to evaluate business requirements, solution options, SAP standard capabilities, custom extension needs, integration requirements, and downstream operational implications.
* Experience with ECC to SAP S/4HANA transformation, brownfield, greenfield, selective data transition, or hybrid delivery approaches.


**Technical Architecture Skills**
* Working knowledge of SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, CDS views, Fiori, roles and authorizations, analytics, workflow, and cloud integration principles.
* Understanding of SAP RISE, hyperscaler environments, network/security dependencies, transport strategy, landscape planning, and operational readiness.
* Experience reviewing RICEFW scope, custom code remediation, simplification items, integration inventory, interface rationalization, and technical debt reduction.
* Knowledge of data migration strategy, master data governance, reconciliation, validation, migration cockpit, ETL tools, and cutover execution.


**Leadership \& Consulting Skills**
* Strong stakeholder management with the ability to engage business leaders, IT leadership, global process owners, vendors, and delivery teams.
* Ability to simplify complex SAP concepts into clear, actionable messages for leadership and project teams.
* Proven ability to lead distributed teams, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, and drive decisions in complex transformation environments.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, problem\-solving, decision\-making, and risk management skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

cbbb5084.title: Cyber Resilience Architect, APJ
cbbb5084.description:
Rubrik is seeking a Cyber Resilience Architect (Field CTO) to drive technical strategy and business leadership across the APJ region.
   

  

 In this role you will act as a transformation architect operating at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution. You will help large enterprises modernize their approach to Data Protection, Cyber Recovery, Identity Resilience, and AI\-driven security and governance.
   

  

 You are accountable for influencing regional revenue outcomes by leading high\-impact discovery, shaping differentiated architectures, and guiding strategic account execution. You will evangelize and architect Rubrik’s portfolio across on\-prem, cloud, SaaS, identity, cyber resilience, and AI solutions.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Executive Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CISOs, and Board. Partner with CIOs on modern data protection, operational efficiency, and cloud strategy. Partner with CISOs on cyber resilience, identity protection, and breach recovery readiness. At the executive level, position data resilience as a board\-level priority — aligning Rubrik’s platform to measurable outcomes such as operational continuity, risk reduction, regulatory compliance, and AI readiness.
* Revenue Acceleration: Partner with regional leadership to hit revenue goals by leading high\-impact technical discoveries and architecting innovative solutions for Tier\-1 accounts.
* Deal Orchestration: Master the MEDDIC framework to qualify opportunities, identifying technical "champions" and neutralizing competitive threats through superior architecture.
* Product Liaison: Distill complex field requirements into actionable insights for the Product Management team, ensuring the APJ voice influences our global roadmap.
* Technical Leadership: Design integrated solutions across On\-Prem, SaaS, Identity, and Multi\-Cloud environments, with a specific focus on Cyber Security including designing isolated recovery environments (IRE) and clean room recovery.
* Market Evangelism: Represent Rubrik at select industry events and executive forums. Contribute to thought leadership initiatives and support key marketing engagements as needed. This is an important but limited portion of the role, with primary focus remaining on strategic account execution and revenue impact.


**About You**
* 18\+ years in Sales Engineering or Technical Consulting, with consistent success in winning 7\-figure enterprise deals across APJ
* Strong executive presence with experience engaging CIO, CISO, and Board\-level stakeholders
* You have deep roots in data protection, disaster recovery, and cybersecurity (zero\-trust, isolated recovery environments, cyber recovery).
* Commercially astute — able to connect technical strategy to financial and operational impact
* Entrepreneurial \- willing to go the extra mile, strong work ethic, resourceful, “get it done” attitude
* Strives in moving in a fast\-paced environment; including handling multiple calls/demos per day with immediate follow up.
* Strong understanding of APJ market dynamics, regulatory landscapes, and cultural nuances
* Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent experience


 Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation
   

  

 Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.
   

  

 Linkedin \| X (formerly Twitter) \| Instagram \| Rubrik.com
   

  

 Inclusion @ Rubrik
   

  

 At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.
   

  

 Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.
   

  

 Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:
   

  

* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.


 Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled
   

  

 Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.
   

  

 Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

0f80d4c5.title: Program Manager
0f80d4c5.description:
**Job Description \- Program Manager – Karnataka** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka
 



**Engagement:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 5–7 years
 



**Reporting To:** 
 State Lead – Karnataka
 



  





**About the Role** 




 STEP Foundation is seeking a driven, execution\-oriented Program Manager to support its work in Karnataka. The Program Manager will work closely with the State Lead to support engagement with the Government of Karnataka, Invest Karnataka, Karnataka Udyog Mitra, relevant government departments, industry bodies, and other ecosystem stakeholders.
 



 The role will be responsible for translating the State Lead's strategic priorities and stakeholder engagements into effective day\-to\-day execution. This will include coordinating with government and industry stakeholders, driving follow\-ups, tracking programme activities, supporting meetings and consultations, preparing programme materials, and ensuring timely execution of agreed actions.
 



 The Program Manager will play an important role in strengthening the Foundation's engagement with the government ecosystem and ensuring that relationships and opportunities developed by the State Lead translate into tangible programme outcomes.
 



 The ideal candidate will bring
 **5–7 years of professional experience** 
 , with meaningful exposure to government, public institutions, development organisations, consulting, public policy, skills, employment, or related programmes. They should have a good understanding of how government systems function and be comfortable working across multiple stakeholders and institutions.
 



 This is a hands\-on role for someone who is organised, proactive and comfortable taking ownership of execution. The candidate should be able to work independently on day\-to\-day responsibilities while closely aligning with the State Lead on priorities, stakeholder engagement and programme direction.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Government Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Support the State Lead in managing relationships with government departments, agencies, boards and institutions across Karnataka.
* Participate in meetings with government officials and support the State Lead in ensuring that discussions translate into clear next steps.
* Maintain regular communication with relevant government stakeholders and ensure timely follow\-through on agreed actions.
* Develop a working understanding of government processes, hierarchies and institutional structures relevant to programme implementation.
* Support coordination across departments and institutions wherever required. Track government priorities, announcements, programmes and developments relevant to the Foundation's work.



**2\. Programme Execution \& Coordination** 



* Drive day\-to\-day execution of state\-level programmes and initiatives under the direction of the State Lead.
* Translate strategic priorities and programme plans into clear action items, timelines and deliverables.
* Follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion of agreed activities.
* Identify execution bottlenecks and proactively escalate issues to the State Lead. Support implementation of pilots, partnerships and institutional initiatives across the state.



**3\. Stakeholder Engagement \& Follow\-through** 



* Support the State Lead in building and maintaining relationships with government, industry, development organisations, academia and other ecosystem stakeholders. Coordinate stakeholder meetings, workshops, consultations and roundtables. Prepare agendas, briefing materials, discussion notes and follow\-up trackers for stakeholder engagements.
* Build strong working relationships with mid\- and senior\-level stakeholders across the ecosystem.
* Serve as a consistent point of contact for day\-to\-day programme coordination with relevant stakeholders.



**4\. Industry \& Ecosystem Engagement** 



* Support engagement with companies, industry associations, investors, business leaders and other private\-sector stakeholders.
* Coordinate with industry stakeholders to understand workforce, investment, talent and ecosystem requirements.
* Support the conversion of stakeholder discussions into actionable partnerships, pilots and programme activities.



**5\. Programme Development \& Implementation** 



* Support the State Lead in translating government and industry priorities into actionable programme opportunities.
* Support the development of concept notes, proposals, presentations, briefing notes and programme documents.
* Coordinate internal teams to develop high\-quality programme outputs.
* Support the design and implementation of state\-level initiatives in consultation with government and industry stakeholders.
* Track programme performance and prepare regular updates for the State Lead and leadership team.



**6\. Reporting, Tracking \& Internal Coordination** 



* Maintain programme trackers covering key activities, milestones, stakeholders, meetings and deliverables.
* Prepare regular status updates for the State Lead on programme progress, stakeholder engagement and emerging issues.
* Coordinate across internal teams to ensure alignment on priorities and deliverables. Support preparation of internal reviews, presentations and leadership updates.



**7\. Supporting State\-Level Representation** 



* Represent STEP Foundation in relevant programme\-level meetings, consultations, workshops and stakeholder engagements, as required.
* Support the State Lead in preparing for high\-level government and industry meetings.
* Communicate programme\-related information clearly and professionally to government, industry and development\-sector stakeholders.
* Build credibility and trust with stakeholders through consistent engagement and strong execution.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The ideal candidate will be a
 **highly organised, proactive and execution\-oriented professional** 
 who is comfortable working with government and multiple stakeholders. They should be able to understand the larger strategic objective while being equally comfortable managing the detailed, day\-to\-day work required to deliver programmes effectively.
 



  





**Essential Experience** 



* **5–7 years of professional experience** 
 , with experience working with government, public institutions, development organisations, consulting firms, public policy organisations, or government\-facing programmes.
* Prior experience working directly with or alongside government institutions will be strongly preferred.
* Experience in programme management, project management, stakeholder coordination or implementation\-oriented roles.
* Experience working in a complex, multi\-stakeholder environment.
* Experience coordinating multiple workstreams, stakeholders and deliverables simultaneously.
* Experience preparing presentations, briefing notes, concept notes, reports and other professional programme documentation.
* Experience in areas such as skills, employment, economic development, public policy, industry engagement or government programmes will be an advantage.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Strong programme and project management skills.
* Strong stakeholder coordination and follow\-through.
* Good understanding of how government departments, agencies and institutions function.
* Ability to navigate government processes and institutional structures. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build productive working relationships. Ability to work effectively with government officials, industry stakeholders and development\-sector professionals.
* Ability to work independently while taking direction and strategic guidance from the State Lead.



  





**Strong proficiency in Kannada is mandatory.** 




 Excellent proficiency in English required.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 Master's degree in public policy, economics, management, engineering, social sciences, development studies, or a related discipline.
 



  





**Preferred Backgrounds** 



* Candidates with experience in 1 or more of the following environments will be particularly well suited:
* Government departments / state government institutions
* Development organisations and foundations
* Public policy organisations
* Organisations working at the intersection of government, industry, skills, employment and economic development
* Organisations working on large\-scale government or public\-sector initiatives



  





**Working Style** 




 The role requires someone who:
 


* Is highly organised, proactive and execution\-oriented.
* Is comfortable working closely with government stakeholders and within government systems.
* Can take ownership of day\-to\-day programme execution while working under the strategic direction of the State Lead.
* Is persistent and resourceful in navigating institutional processes.
* Can manage multiple stakeholders, workstreams and deadlines simultaneously. Is comfortable with ambiguity and can independently solve day\-to\-day execution challenges.
* Is able to move between government meetings, programme implementation, stakeholder coordination and internal team discussions.



  





**Location \& Travel** 




**Base Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka
 



 The role will require travel within Karnataka and regular in\-person engagement with government departments, government agencies, industry stakeholders and other ecosystem partners.
