97eb9077.title: Solutions Architect
97eb9077.description:
**About Nutpaa** 

 Nutpaa is an early\-stage deep\-tech company building a real\-time human movement perception and coaching platform that pairs on\-device capture and compute with a mobile app, cloud services, and a partner ecosystem. Our systems run analysis on the edge, protect user privacy by design, and are built for low\-latency, real\-time experiences.
 



 Our culture centers on technical depth, strong engineering ownership, peer collaboration, long\-term thinking, and patent\-protected innovation. This role is for a hands\-on technical leader who can hold the whole system in their head and guide a team to ship it.
 



  




**Role Summary** 

 We are looking for a Solution Architect to own the end\-to\-end architecture of our system the mobile app, cloud and application services, on\-device and cloud ML, edge runtime, and device integration and to guide our engineering team in delivering it as one coherent, production\-grade solution. You will make the technology, structure, and interface decisions that hold the system together, and you will be accountable for how well the pieces fit and how reliably they ship.
 



 A near\-term priority is taking our mobile app to production. You will drive that delivery end to end architecture, backend and device integration, security, performance, CI/CD, testing, and release readiness while keeping everything aligned to our core architecture principles: analysis compute on the edge, a fixed cue/telemetry protocol between device and app, and a privacy\-first, sealed\-box posture where only derived data leaves the device. This is a technical\-leadership role: primarily architecture and delivery guidance, but hands\-on enough to be credible in design and code reviews.
 



 The competencies that matter most to us: strong hands\-on cross\-platform mobile in both Flutter and React Native, solid backend and solution\-architecture depth, and offline\-first design done correctly (reliable sync, no data loss or duplicates) plus strong performance tuning and secure\-by\-default engineering. Cross\-platform mobile experience in both Flutter and React Native is a firm requirement; other tool names in this description are examples of the class, where equivalent experience counts.
   




**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Solution Architecture \& System Design** 

 • End\-to\-End Architecture: Own the architecture across mobile app, cloud/application services, edge runtime, and device integration how each part is built and how they connect.
 



 • Technology \& Patterns: Make and justify stack, pattern, and interface decisions; define clean, versioned API/protocol contracts between the app, services, and devices.
 



 • Non\-Functional Requirements: Set and enforce targets for performance, security, privacy, scalability, and reliability, and keep the system honest against our architecture invariants.
 


**2\. Mobile App to Production** 

 • Drive the Release: Own productionizing our mobile app end to end: architecture, backend/API integration, device/edge connectivity, deployment, and release management to production.
 



 • Production Readiness: Security and privacy (no raw video retained; only derived cues/authorized data leave the device), performance and latency targets, observability, and beta\-to\-production hardening.
 



 • Deliver on Milestones: Sequence the work, manage delivery against milestones and measurable KPIs, and get the app shipped on schedule and to spec.
 


**3\. Delivery Leadership \& Team Guidance** 

 • Guide the Team: Technically lead and mentor the delivery team full\-stack, UI/UX, CV/ML, and edge/hardware engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and clear standards; unblock them.
 



 • Engineering Discipline: Set the bar for SDLC, Git workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, and documentation, so the team ships tested, maintainable, production\-grade work.
 



 • Risk \& Governance: Run architecture governance; maintain a technical risk register; surface trade\-offs and dependencies early and drive them to closure.
 


**4\. Integration \& Cross\-Functional Coordination** 

 • Make It Fit: Integrate mobile, cloud, and edge/device into one coherent system; manage cross\-module and cross\-team dependencies.
 



 • Stakeholders: Partner with the founder and, as it grows, the partner ecosystem; translate product goals into architecture and delivery, and support investor\-demo and beta readiness.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



**Experience \& Requirements** 

 • Flutter \& React Native: Minimum 3–4 years of strong, hands\-on experience in both Flutter and React Native.
 



 • Backend \& Solution Architecture: Minimum 3–4 years of solid backend and solution\-architecture experience.
 



 • Architecture Understanding: Strong understanding of mobile architecture, offline\-first design, APIs, cloud, and system design.
 



 • Delivery \& Hands\-On: Guides a cross\-functional team while staying hands\-on leads design and code reviews and dives into the code when it matters.
   




**Technical Breadth (tools are examples of the class)** 

 • Cross\-platform mobile \& offline\-first (required): Firm requirement hands\-on experience with both Flutter (Dart) and React Native. Plus offline\-first design with reliable sync (no data loss or duplicates); local databases (SQLite / Drift / Isar); background tasks; and state management.
 



 • On\-device \& cloud ML: Edge inference (TensorFlow Lite / ONNX Runtime / Core ML; Snapdragon / Jetson) and cloud ML \& serving (PyTorch, ONNX, Triton / TorchServe), including quantization, safe over\-the\-air model delivery, and embeddings \+ vector search.
 



 • Backend \& APIs: Python / FastAPI (or Node / Go); REST \+ OpenAPI; async, event\-driven services with a message broker (RabbitMQ / Kafka / SQS); Argon2id \+ JWT \+ SSO; and role\-based access control.
 



 • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage (S3\); append\-only / double\-entry ledger design with derived balances; and search (Postgres FTS, or Typesense / Meilisearch / OpenSearch).
 



 • Web: Next.js / Astro and Flutter Web, with judgment on web\-native vs code\-reuse per surface.
 



 • Cloud \& DevOps: AWS (or GCP / Azure); Kubernetes (EKS); Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions); infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform); observability; multi\-environment; and cloud / GPU cost control.
   




**Non\-Functional \& Discipline** 

 • Performance Tuning (must): Proven ability to profile and optimize on mobile (frame rate / jank, startup, memory, battery) and on the backend (API latency, database query and index tuning, caching, and load testing) measuring first, then fixing the real hotspots against clear performance budgets.
 



 • Secure\-by\-Default (must): Builds security in from the start: a secure SDLC and OWASP Top\-10 awareness; strong auth (Argon2id, JWT \+ refresh, least\-privilege RBAC, SSO); secrets in a vault (never in code or the database); input validation and protection against SQL injection / XSS / CSRF; encryption in transit and at rest; dependency and secret scanning; and CI security gates. Given we handle sensitive personal and payment data, this is not optional.
 



 • Scalable \& Reliable Architecture: Designs systems that scale and stay reliable sound data modeling, caching, and awareness of data\-protection basics (consent / retention, residency).
 



 • Architecture Judgment: Spots the single biggest technical risk and de\-risks it early with a focused prototype; designs forward\-compatible, versioned protocols and contracts; makes pragmatic build\-vs\-buy calls.
 



 • Quality: A genuine habit of testing, CI/CD, and engineering discipline and of instilling it in a team.
   




**Preferred (Nice to Have)** 

 • Payments: Good exposure to payments and billing Stripe (Billing / Connect) or equivalent, subscriptions / wallet flows, and reconciliation.
 



 • Security / DevSecOps specialization: Deeper application\-security / DevSecOps depth threat modeling, SAST / DAST / dependency scanning (e.g. Snyk / SonarQube / Semgrep / OWASP ZAP / Burp), cloud security (IAM / KMS / GuardDuty), IaC scanning, penetration testing, and compliance (SOC 2, GDPR, DPDP). We may hire this as a dedicated role depth here is a strong plus.
 



 • Real\-time 3D graphics / body model: Real\-time 3D rendering on mobile (e.g. Filament or a comparable engine), glTF / GLB skeletal animation, level\-of\-detail, and performance / thermal tuning a strong plus, not a requirement.
 



 • Audio / Voice: Experience with audio/voice stacks text\-to\-speech (e.g. Polly / Google / ElevenLabs), on\-device TTS, and Bluetooth audio (A2DP / HFP).
 



 • Analytics: Product analytics and data pipelines PostHog (or similar) and a warehouse (BigQuery / Redshift / ClickHouse).
 



 • Edge / Device: Edge/IoT or device integration, BLE/pairing, or products backed by on\-device ML.
 



 • Domain \& Stage: Health/fitness or hardware\-connected consumer apps; and startup / 0\-to\-1 experience delivering under early\-stage constraints.
   




**What You’ll Gain** 

 • System Ownership: Own the architecture of an entire deep\-tech platform and see it through to production from an early stage.
 



 • Leadership: Shape both the technology and the team that builds it.
 



 • Patent Creation: Direct involvement in building patentable core technology.
 



 • Growth: A clear path toward Head of Engineering / Principal Architect as the company scales.
   




**How to Apply** 

 Interested candidates can send a CV and a short note about relevant work ideally with examples of systems or products you have architected and shipped to production to careers@nutpaa.com.
 



  





 Location: Madurai, Tamil Nadu · Full\-time.

* Architect enterprise Databricks solutions covering data ingestion, data lake modernization, lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, medallion architecture, ETL/ELT transformation, batch and streaming pipelines, analytics consumption, machine learning, GenAI enablement, feature engineering, and governed data sharing.
* Develop proposal\-ready architecture narratives, logical architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, migration architecture views, deployment views, Snowflake workload patterns, Databricks lakehouse workload patterns, AI\-ready data platform blueprints, and technology stack recommendations.

**Principal KPIs for the Role** 



* Contribution to strategic deal wins
* Quality and timeliness of RFP/RFI responses
* Customer solution acceptance and feedback
* Innovation and value\-added solution recommendations
* Alignment of Snowflake and Databricks solutions to customer business outcomes, AI\-readiness, governance, modernization, cost optimization, and enterprise data strategy.
* Effectiveness of proposed Snowflake and Databricks migration, lakehouse modernization, optimization, and managed services approaches.



**Core Competencies \& Technical Expertise** 



* Hands\-on experience in preparing solution responses, architecture documents, presentations, technical proposals, migration approaches, operating models, and implementation roadmaps.
* Experience responding to RFPs/RFIs/RFQs and creating solution narratives, architecture diagrams, delivery approaches, modernization strategies, migration estimates, governance models, and managed services constructs.
* Experience with Snowflake and Databricks deployment and integration across cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of migration patterns from legacy data platforms to Snowflake and Databricks, including workload assessment, data lake modernization, schema conversion, ETL/ELT rationalization, data pipeline migration, data reconciliation, testing automation, parallel run, cutover strategy, performance tuning, and post\-migration optimization.
* Knowledge of BI and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Looker, ThoughtSpot, or Sigma from a Snowflake and Databricks consumption and semantic layer perspective.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with experience interacting with customer stakeholders, CDO organizations, CIO teams, enterprise architects, data platform teams, analytics leaders, security teams, AI/ML teams, and business stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

 Responsible for the management, operations, delivery and support of defined IT applications and/or infrastructure services; directs and coordinates the efforts of people to accomplish goals and objectives using available resources.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Contributes to the delivery and support of specific IT services. Supports the development and maintenance of services and ensures that tools and resources are capable and available (i.e. IT Service Catalog, Asset Management system) Generates and reports service delivery metrics and drives standards across regions and locations (i.e. Scorecards, Service Level Agreement (SLAs) and Customer Satisfaction or Net Promoter Scoring). Acts as a point of contact for customers for service related inquiries and maintains relationships with key customers and suppliers. Is familiar with SLA / Operational Level Agreements between other IT Services Provided. Encourages root cause analysis using the formal problem solving approach for recurring issues. Champions the use of Six Sigma to reduce costs and improve processes.  Financial acumen \- Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.

674852ff.title: Digital Customer Engagement Manager - SAP Basis, Project Management
674852ff.description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 The digital Customer Engagement Manager (dCEM) is responsible for E2E customer engagement and delivery of contractual agreement and services for SAP Cloud Customers of SAP Global cloud operations, mainly focusing on SAP S/4HANA, private cloud edition deliverables.
   

  

 This role will primarily focus on customer onboarding scenarios, including system migrations and conversions from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA within the SAP private cloud landscape. The dCEM acts as the customer ambassador and primary point of contact, orchestrating migration projects, onboarding activities, and ongoing service delivery while ensuring customer satisfaction and successful adoption of RISE with SAP.
   

  

 The role requires strong SAP technical and migration expertise, combined with customer engagement and project management capabilities, to guide customers through complex cloud transformation journeys into the RISE with SAP.
   

  

 The dCEM oversees the customer lifecycle from the moment of contract signing, particularly customer onboarding, migration activities, continuous service delivery, release and maintenance project initiation, change management, and renewal support for a range of customers. The dCEM is also expected to maintain customer satisfaction through issue mitigation and escalation management and helping customers maximize the value of their partnership with SAP. The dCEM manages a variety of technical and engagement aspects during the various phases of a range of customer’s lifecycle. They will work in seamless collaboration with sales \& pre\-sales team and, SAP Global cloud operations internal delivery teams for the committed scope of delivery throughout the customer engagement lifecycle. This role also provides expert support in operations and facilitates the service lifecycle.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for driving successful onboarding of customers transitioning to SAP Global Cloud Operations, particularly those undergoing On\-premise to Cloud migrations, ECC to S/4HANA conversions and RISE with SAP transformation programs.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with SAP sales, presales, migration factories, delivery teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful execution of migration projects and stable post\-go\-live operations.
   

  

**Key Tasks Comprise The Following**
* Supports sales to delivery handover and supervise the delivery of services outlined in the customer contract.
* Orchestrate customer onboarding and migration activities for Brownfield customers moving to SAP Private Cloud Environment.
* Support downtime optimized migration strategies and coordinate with technical delivery teams to ensure minimal disruption to customer business operations.
* Orchestrates the overall service/project delivery according to planned scope, budget, and milestones.
* Supports critical customer situations in conjunction with Major Incident Management (MIM), SAP Global Cloud Operations Customer Escalation Team and SAP Product Support, as applicable.
* Supports customers on technical requirements throughout their lifecycle within the SAP Global Cloud Operations scope of engagement.
* Monitor project milestones, delivery timelines, and key risks to ensure successful project execution.
* Support customer satisfaction surveys (CSAT)


**What You Bring**
* 5 \- 7 years of work experience as SAP technical consultant with 2\+ years in a customer\-facing role (consulting, IT support, IT services, etc.)
* Hands on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP brownfield migrations, and infrastructure updates for cloud customers.
* Strong experience in SAP system migrations and conversions, particularly SAP system migrations to cloud environments (RISE PCE)
* Hands\-on experience with SAP migration approaches, including conversion : DMO Move to S/4 HANA, SWPM on migration using Backup/Restore, Migration using HANA Replication, and Selective Data Migration.
* Must have exposure to SAP private cloud deployments on Hyperscaler, Azure/ AWS (in context of SAP Green Field and Brown Field Customers)
* Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results\-driven / Self\-organized / Decision making.
* An individual in this role is expected to deliver ‘Effective customer communication’ using digital mediums to achieve high customer satisfaction. Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis, and SAP Application.
* Good understanding of ECSs operations infrastructure, processes, and automation tools like SPC, TIC, etc. is a plus.
* Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


**Where You Belong**
 The SAP Global Cloud Operations (GCO) organization is a business unit responsible for providing cloud\-hosted infrastructure and application management services to SAP customers around the world in a 24x7 operations model. Our portfolio of private cloud solutions turns SAP products into a solution\-as\-a\-service on customer’s preferred infrastructure, including Hyperscaler, as one SAP. The portfolio is at the center of the SAP strategy to help customers on their journey to use SAP S/4HANA and become an Intelligent Enterprise.
   

  

 As part of ECS, the SAP Global Cloud Operations Private Cloud Customer Center, or PC3, is a shared services organization dedicated to managing service delivery at scale for high\-volume, low\-touch, private cloud customers.
   

  

 Because we are at the heart of the SAP strategy, our business unit is growing rapidly. In order to facilitate that growth, we are looking for people with diverse technical and customer engagement backgrounds to join our Center of Expertise around the world. You will become part of a great team of smart technical and customer engagement professionals, where there are great opportunities for growth and there is tremendous potential for specialized development of your skills.
   

  

 \#SAPECSCareers \#SAPInternalT2
   

  

**Bring out your best**
 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\-driven and future\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
   

  

**We win with inclusion**
 SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
   

  

 SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e\-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
   

  

 For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.
   

  

 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.
   

  

 Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.
   

  

**AI Usage in the Recruitment Process**
 For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.
   

  

 Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

**About the Role** 




  





 The Technology Service Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring technology services, projects, and initiatives are effectively coordinated, communicated, and delivered.
 



  





 This role sits at the intersection of Service Delivery Management and Project Management, providing governance, coordination, visibility, and accountability across the Technology function. The successful candidate will work closely with technology teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and partners to ensure priorities remain aligned, risks are actively managed, and initiatives progress toward successful outcomes.
 



  





 This is an ideal opportunity for someone who combines strong organizational and project management skills with a solid understanding of technology and a passion for driving execution.
 



 Service Delivery Management.
 


* Support the ongoing delivery and continuous improvement of technology services across the organization.
* Coordinate and manage technology\-related escalations, ensuring issues are appropriately tracked, communicated, and resolved.
* Maintain visibility across technology operations, identifying service risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Work closely with internal teams, business stakeholders, and external partners to ensure service expectations are met.
* Contribute to service governance, reporting, and operational review processes.



 Project \& Initiative Delivery
 


* Coordinate technology projects and strategic initiatives from initiation through delivery.
* Maintain visibility across project timelines, dependencies, risks, priorities, and key milestones.
* Coordinate resources, stakeholders, and activities to help ensure successful project outcomes.
* Drive accountability and follow\-through across project teams and stakeholders.
* Escalate risks, delays, and blockers when appropriate to maintain delivery momentum.
* Support project governance, status reporting, and portfolio visibility across the Technology function.



 Communication, Reporting \& Stakeholder Engagement
 


* Develop professional presentations, reports, dashboards, status updates, and stakeholder communications.
* Translate technical information into clear and meaningful content for technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Support the preparation of leadership presentations, project updates, business reviews, and technology communications.
* Ensure stakeholders receive accurate, timely, and relevant information regarding technology services and initiatives.



 Documentation \& Knowledge Management
 


* Maintain and improve technology documentation, standards, knowledge repositories, and collaboration platforms.
* Promote consistency, accessibility, and quality across technology information and documentation.
* Support the development of operational processes, templates, governance frameworks, and reporting structures.



 Technology Governance \& Coordination
 


* Maintain visibility across technology priorities, commitments, projects, and operational activities.
* Coordinate activities across technology teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and consultants.
* Ensure decisions are translated into actions and initiatives continue progressing toward completion.
* Facilitate governance meetings, status reviews, and operational cadences that support effective execution.
* Help create structure, alignment, and accountability across the Technology function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 5\+ years of experience in Service Delivery Management, Project Management, PMO, Technology Operations, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple projects, stakeholders, priorities, and workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of technology environments, including infrastructure, cloud services, enterprise applications, software delivery, cybersecurity, or IT operations.
* Excellent organizational, planning, and execution skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Microsoft 365\.
* Experience preparing presentations, dashboards, reports, and executive\-ready materials.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building abilities.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced and evolving environment.



 Preferred Experience
 


* Experience supporting global or distributed organizations.
* Experience working within professional services, consulting, financial services, or technology\-driven organizations.

 Anoud Technologies builds scalable, high\-quality Insurance product solutions, partnering closely with global stakeholders and delivery teams.

This is an application implementation delivery role – the person will lead product configuration, rollout, and go\-live delivery for insurance clients, not infrastructure or platform operations.  Insurance Product Implementation • Application Delivery Management • Stakeholder \& Client Management • SLA/OLA Management • Delivery Governance • Team Leadership • Capacity Planning • Risk \& Escalation Management • Process Improvement • AI\-Assisted Delivery Practices

0068a8b3.title: Program Manager
0068a8b3.description:
**ROLE: PROGRAM MANAGER \- DELIVERY EXCELLENCE** 




**About Saras Analytics** 




 Saras Analytics is an AI and data analytics firm built for ecommerce and omnichannel brands. We help fast\-growing SMBs and mid\-market brands turn disconnected, messy data into decisions — covering ingestion, transformation, and consumption, backed by our own products (Daton and IQ) as the data infrastructure underneath every engagement. Our consulting team is built around forward deployed analysts, data scientists, and subject matter experts who sit close to the client and turn data into strategic guidance CXOs act on.
 



**Why Now** 




 Saras is profitable and bootstrapped. We run flat: talent and good ideas move fast here regardless of tenure or title. Right now our Consulting department is scaling fast — more clients, more concurrent engagements, more moving pieces — and leadership needs to see the department's efficiency and health without pulling delivery teams off client work to report on it. A Program Manager joining now builds that operating system from scratch, not inherits it.
 



**The Role** 




 You'll be the single person accountable for internal process compliance across the Consulting department, reporting to the Head of Consulting. This is a one\-of\-a\-kind, individual contributor seat: you carry no client accounts and no direct reports — your product is the department's operating discipline itself. You'll define and own the efficiency and health metrics leadership has asked to see — bugs caught, requirements and BRDs drafted, new features developed, sev1 issues handled — and run the written review rhythm that keeps every internal initiative moving to an outcome. This is not a client\-facing role.
 



**The Bar** 




 Compliance that holds without you in the room is the top priority for this role. A metric nobody trusts, or a process people quietly route around, isn't done — the bar is a department whose health leadership can read at any time, from numbers the delivery teams themselves stand behind.
 



**What You'll Own** 



1. **Understand the machine before you change it.** 
 Map the department's current delivery tools and workflows end to end — how work enters, moves, and ships — so every process you later define fits how delivery actually runs, not how a template says it should.
2. **Define the metrics and processes that answer leadership's visibility asks.** 
 Turn requests like "how healthy is the department?" into a concrete, instrumented metric set — bugs, BRDs drafted, features developed, sev1s handled, and the ones you propose — each with a definition the teams agree to, a source of truth, and a cadence. Then build the lightweight processes that keep those numbers accurate without adding reporting burden.
3. **Run initiative reviews the Amazon way.** 
 Every review starts with the room silently reading a written summary, followed by comments and clarifying questions — no slide theatre, no status meetings that could have been a document. You write sharply, you hold the quality bar on what others write, and you keep the ritual honest: documents exist to drive decisions, not to be graded.
4. **Drive initiatives to outcomes and closure.** 
 An initiative that's "ongoing" for two quarters is failing. Track every internal initiative to a decision, a shipped result, or an explicit kill — and make the closure visible.
5. **Enforce without becoming the person people route around.** 
 Process compliance holds because the teams see the value, not because you're policing them. When a rule creates more friction than signal, fix the rule.



**What Winning Looks Like** 




**First 90 days:** 
 you've mapped the delivery workflow end to end, agreed the first version of the metric set with the Head of Consulting, and run your first initiative reviews — written summary, silent read, comments — with the department showing up prepared.
 



**Steady state:** 
 leadership reads the department's efficiency and health from your standing review, not by asking around; every metric has a definition the teams stand behind; and initiatives visibly close — decided, shipped, or killed — instead of lingering.
 



**Who Thrives Here** 




 Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them: 7–10 years of experience, and at least once you've defined — not inherited — an executive\-facing metrics system that leadership actually ran on.
 


* You've run programs or operating mechanisms at Amazon or an Amazon\-influenced organization — written narratives, business reviews, metrics\-driven cadences — and you left with the mechanism, not the pathology.
* You've worked in delivery excellence or delivery governance at a premier consulting firm or large services firm — process compliance, KPI systems, governance forums — and you want your recommendations implemented, not filed in a deck.
* You've been a Business Operations / Strategy \& Operations individual contributor at a strong Indian tech startup, owning a department's operating cadence, metrics, and OKR system.
* You're a Technical Program Manager from a product or engineering organization who lives on sev metrics, bug counts, and release governance — and doesn't need a team reporting to you to have impact.
* You have enough delivery\-domain fluency to argue with a senior delivery lead about what counts as a sev1 or an adequate BRD — these metrics are not abstractions to you.



**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:** 



* You write to drive decisions — narratives, business cases, review documents — and you're comfortable proving it: we interview in the same format the role runs, starting from a written sample.
* You've enforced a standard on people senior to you, and can tell the story of where it held and where it failed — you know how to hold a bar without becoming the person people route around.
* You moved from client\-facing consulting (analytics or tech) into an internal operating seat — and stayed, because the leverage is real.
* You can show 2–3 initiatives you personally drove to closure with a before/after metric delta — not tracked, driven.



 Hands\-on fluency with delivery tooling (ClickUp, Jira, or similar) and AI tools like Claude to automate the reporting so the humans only do the judgment.

9e7d709f.description:

 Are you an energetic and customer\-focused
 **Project or Program Manager** 
 ? Are you action\-oriented and proactive by nature? Can you quickly decompose complex concepts and explain them in a way that makes sense to technical and non\-technical audiences? If so, we want to speak to you!
   

  

**Black Duck** 
 , a repeated leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Application Security, is seeking an experienced Project / Engagement Manager to help our Implementation and Services Team drive customer onboarding and adoption. We’re looking for someone to help take our business to the next level of excellence in delivery and customer delight!

 The Black Duck Technical Services team is dedicated to supporting our customers in developing their AppSec vision and achieving their goals quickly.  In this role, you'll be responsible for the planning and successful implementation of Black Duck solutions to help the world’s leading technology companies meet their software security goals.

3f66ce44.title: Technical Program Manager
3f66ce44.description:
**Technical Program Manager — Healthcare Deployments** 




  





*Function: Implementation \& Delivery \| Reports to: Sr Director, Client Solutions* 
*\| Location: Bengaluru* 




  





**About Augnito** 




  





 Augnito is next\-generation Voice AI for healthcare. Our cloud\-based speech recognition gives clinicians ergonomic data entry with 99% accuracy, with no voice profile training, from any device, anywhere. Built from the outset in partnership with clinicians using human\-centred design, Augnito supports a wide range of clinical vocabularies and workflows, halves clinical reporting and admin time, removes transcription delays, and helps prevent physician burnout.
 



  





 Augnito is deployed at 300\+ hospitals and health systems across 20\+ countries, including the US, UK and Canada — delivered both directly and through EMR, HIS and distribution partners.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to own the deployment of Augnito into enterprise hospital environments — from contract signature through go\-live, adoption and stable handover.
 



 This is a customer\-facing delivery role in a clinical setting, not a back\-office project coordination role. You will be the single accountable owner of each implementation: running the plan, holding the dates, managing hospital IT and clinical stakeholders, coordinating our Product, Engineering, QA, Customer Success and Support teams, and working alongside EMR/HIS and channel partners who co\-deliver with us.
 



  





 You will have the authority to escalate, to raise change requests when scope moves, and to recommend holding a go\-live when readiness criteria are not met. We expect you to use it.
 



  





**What success looks like in the first 12 months** 




  




* Implementations land on the committed go\-live date, or the date is re\-baselined early and deliberately rather than slipping.
* Clinicians are actively using Augnito 30 and 90 days after go\-live — not just provisioned.
* Our implementation playbook, runbooks and readiness checklists are materially better than when you joined, and repeatable across geographies and partners.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Project ownership and governance** 



* Own end\-to\-end implementation projects from kick\-off through go\-live, hypercare and formal handover to Customer Success.
* Build and maintain project plans, milestone schedules, RAID logs, go\-live runbooks and readiness checklists; keep a single source of truth for every project.
* Run governance cadence with customers and internally: kick\-off, weekly working calls, steering updates, go/no\-go review, post\-implementation review.
* Manage scope actively. Where customer requests fall outside the agreed scope, raise a documented change request with effort and timeline impact rather than absorbing it silently.
* Identify, log and mitigate risks and dependencies early; escalate blockers with a recommended course of action, not just a status.
* Maintain implementation milestone status for commercial purposes, including milestones tied to invoicing and revenue recognition.



  





**Technical delivery and integration** 



* Gather clinical, business and technical requirements and translate them into an implementation plan, integration design, and test scope.
* Coordinate integration delivery with EMR, HIS, RIS and PACS systems — including HL7 v2 message flows (ADT / ORM / ORU), FHIR and REST API integrations, and embedded or in\-application deployment models.
* Coordinate endpoint and environment readiness: Windows and virtualised desktop deployment (Citrix / VDI / RDS), group policy and software distribution, mobile app rollout via MDM, SSO and directory integration (SAML / Entra ID / AD), user provisioning, network allowlisting, bandwidth and latency validation, and microphone or dictation hardware.
* Plan and manage migration from legacy dictation and transcription workflows, including existing templates, macros, auto\-texts, and custom vocabulary.
* Coordinate configuration, internal testing, customer UAT and production cutover; define entry and exit criteria for each gate.
* Validate speech accuracy and workflow fit by specialty during UAT; route accuracy gaps, vocabulary needs and product issues to the Clinical Language, Product and Engineering teams with reproducible detail.



  





**Clinical adoption and change management** 



* Plan phased rollout by department, specialty and site rather than treating go live as a single event.
* Identify and enable clinical champions and super\-users; design training for clinicians, secretarial and transcription staff, and hospital IT.
* Run go\-live support — on\-site or remote floor\-walking, early\-week check\-ins, targeted re\-training for low\-adoption cohorts.
* Own a defined hypercare period after go\-live with explicit exit criteria before handover to Customer Success and Support.



  





**Partner and channel delivery** 



* Deliver implementations jointly with EMR/HIS vendors, integration partners, system integrators and distributors — managing dependencies you do not directly control.
* Enable and quality\-assure partner\-led implementations: provide playbooks, training, readiness criteria and review gates so partners can deploy Augnito to our standard.
* Act as the delivery\-side point of contact for partner technical teams during integration build and certification.



  





**Compliance, security and privacy** 



* Run compliance and security readiness as a project workstream, not an afterthought — data protection agreements and BAAs, data residency and processing requirements, and customer security reviews.
* Coordinate responses to hospital security questionnaires and assurance frameworks with the Security and Legal teams, including HIPAA (US), UK NHS DSPT and DTAC, PIPEDA/PHIPA (Canada), the DPDP Act (India), GDPR, and ISO 27001 / SOC 2 evidence requests.
* Ensure clinical\-safety and information\-governance signoffs required by the customer are secured before go\-live.



  





**Scale and continuous improvement** 



* Improve the implementation playbook, templates, runbooks and estimation model based on what each project teaches us.
* Support pre\-sales where required: implementation scoping, effort and timeline estimation, input to statements of work, and RFP/RFI delivery sections.
* Contribute to reporting on portfolio health, delivery capacity and recurring root causes of delay.



  





**How Performance Will Be Measured** 




  




* On\-time go\-live rate against the baselined plan, and milestone adherence.
* Time\-to\-go\-live and time\-to\-first\-value from contract signature.
* Clinician adoption on day 30 and day 90 — active users and usage depth against the target user base.
* Implementation of CSAT / NPS from customer and partner stakeholders.
* Hypercare ticket volume and time to hypercare exit.
* Quality and reuse of implementation documentation and playbook assets.



  





**Required Experience and Skills** 




  




* 5–8 years of experience delivering enterprise software implementations, professional services or technical programme management, including at least 2 years in a customer\-facing delivery owner role.
* Demonstrated experience implementing software into healthcare provider environments, or equivalent regulated\-enterprise delivery experience with clear evidence you can operate in a clinical setting.
* Track record of running multiple concurrent enterprise implementations across different customers, time zones and readiness levels.
* Practical working knowledge of integration concepts: APIs, authentication, message flows, environments, and testing. You do not need to write the integration, but you must be able to challenge an estimate, read a message spec and spot a bad assumption.
* Ability to hold a professional line with senior external stakeholders — hospital CIOs, CMIOs, IT managers, clinical leads and partner delivery heads — under schedule pressure.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; the discipline to write status that is accurate and unwelcome rather than comfortable and vague.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills; high personal organization and attention to detail.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Candidates from hospital IT, clinical informatics, radiology, health information management or clinical backgrounds who have moved into vendor\-side delivery are explicitly welcome.



  





**Preferred** 




  




* Direct experience with EMR/HIS/RIS/PACS integrations and HL7 v2 or FHIR message flows.
* Experience deploying to virtualised desktop environments (Citrix, VDI, RDS) and managing endpoint software rollout at scale.
* Experience with speech recognition, clinical documentation, transcription, or medical coding workflows.
* Experience delivering through channel partners, distributors, or system integrators.
* Exposure to healthcare privacy and security regimes (HIPAA, NHS DSPT/DTAC, GDPR, DPDP Act) and to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 environments.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification.
* Tooling: Jira / Asana / ClickUp, Smartsheet or MS Project, Postman, basic SQL, advanced Excel or Sheets, Salesforce / HubSpot / Zoho.



  





**Working Model and Practicalities** 




  




* Portfolio: typically, 4–6 concurrent implementations of varying size and complexity.
* Geographies: customers across India, the Middle East, UK, and others. Expect regular working overlaps with Middle East and UK time zones.
* Travel: This role will require travel to customer sites (domestically and/or internationally) for go\-lives and key customer or partner milestones.
* Reports to the Sr Director, Client Solutions. As the implementation function grows, this role is the intended path to leading the team.



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




  





 Our technology works. The difference between a hospital that pilots Augnito and a hospital that runs on Augnito is almost entirely implementation — integration quality, clinician trust, and someone competent holding the whole thing together. That is this job.

9c5d6618.title: Sr. Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
9c5d6618.description:
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.



Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer\-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast\-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”



As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server\-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start\-ups to large enterprises.



As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business\-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.



Key job responsibilities Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:


* You’ll build solutions, provide technical guidance and advocate for the customer
* Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
* Develop trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges
* Using your technical acumen and customer obsession, you’ll drive technical discussions regarding incidents, trade\-offs, and risk management
* Consult with a range of partners from developers through to C\-suite executives
* Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, and Sales Account Managers
* With a bias for action, you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS
* Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, detailed pre\-launch planning
* Solve a variety of problems across different customers as they migrate their workloads to the cloud
* Uplift customer capabilities by running workshops, brown bag sessions, etc.


Watch a short video about life as a Technical Account Manager here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=J\_Rm0QgWvQ8 The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!



A day in the life As a Senior TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services \- including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, Bedrock, SageMaker, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support, and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.



About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.



Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.



Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.



Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.



Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 7\+ years of hands\-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Knowledge of of cloud based architecture, cloud services and experience in customer facing roles
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, math, or equivalent, or experience in a STEM field equivalent to a four year degree
* Experience in external enterprise customer\-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead
* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in one or more of the following areas: software design or development, content distribution/CDN, scripting/automation, database architecture, IP networking, IT security, BigData/Hadoop/Spark, operations management, service oriented architecture


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit \[https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  


Could you be the full\-time Cybersecurity Architect in our dynamic team located in Bangalore we’re looking for?

  


**Your future role**


Take on a new challenge and apply your comprehensive cybersecurity expertise in a new cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside innovative, dedicated, and forward\-thinking teammates.


You'll lead and shape the cybersecurity landscape within our projects. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (IT, Engineering, Operations), validate security aspects of IT projects, and much more.


You’ll specifically take care of developing use cases, creating business cases with a thorough TCO analysis, and producing or validating architectural documentation. We’ll look to you for:

* Presenting solutions and enhancing the service catalog

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:


* A Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering/Technology

* Experience in the Transport Industry is a plus
* At least 7 years of work experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on architecture and design
* A strong grasp of security architecture and infrastructure
* Proficiency in risk analysis and network security patterns

**Things you’ll enjoy**


Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:


* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects

* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning

As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

10eb142f.title: Solutions Development Architect
10eb142f.description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

3dd9002c.title: Solutions Architecture - Advisor II
3dd9002c.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Solutions Architecture \- Advisor II
   

  

**About Your Role**
 You will join Fiserv’s AI Engineering Productivity team, which builds internal platforms and tools that apply AI to improve how software is designed, developed, tested, deployed, and operated across the enterprise. In this role, you will define the end\-to\-end architecture for AI\-powered developer tooling and agentic platforms, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, auditable, and aligned with the needs of a regulated financial services environment. You will work across engineering, infrastructure, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to turn AI productivity goals into practical platform capabilities and standards.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Define and own end\-to\-end architecture across data, model, application, integration, orchestration, and infrastructure layers for AI\-powered developer tooling and agentic platforms.
* Establish technical vision, reference architectures, architectural standards, and architecture decision records to guide engineering delivery.
* Design LLM\-based and agentic systems, including model selection, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool and function calling, orchestration patterns, evaluation approaches, and guardrail controls.
* Architect solutions for scalability, resilience, latency, observability, disaster recovery, and cost efficiency in enterprise production environments.
* Ensure architecture aligns with secure\-by\-design principles, privacy requirements, identity and access controls, auditability, and regulatory expectations for financial services.
* Evaluate AI models, frameworks, vendors, and platform integration patterns to support enterprise adoption and long\-term maintainability.
* Review solution designs and implementation approaches to ensure engineering execution remains aligned to architecture standards and intended outcomes.
* Prototype and validate architecture patterns using AI tooling and development frameworks to accelerate delivery and establish practical usage standards for teams.
* Partner with business, engineering, security, compliance, and infrastructure stakeholders to align solutions with enterprise priorities and constraints.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You’ll Need To Have**
* 6\+ years of experience in solution architecture across application, data, integration, and infrastructure domains.
* 6\+ years of experience in cloud\-native architecture using AWS, Azure, or GCP, including microservices, APIs, containers, and distributed systems.
* 6\+ years of experience in designing AI and LLM\-based systems using retrieval\-augmented generation, orchestration workflows, tool calling, model evaluation, and guardrail patterns.
* 6\+ years of experience in secure architecture practices including identity and access management, data protection, audit logging, and privacy controls in regulated environments.
* 6\+ years of experience in defining non\-functional architecture requirements including scalability, resilience, latency, observability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
* 6\+ years of experience in documenting architecture standards, reference architectures, and architecture decision records for engineering teams.
* 6\+ years of experience in prototyping and validating designs using Python, TypeScript, Java, or Go in enterprise software environments.
* 6\+ years of equivalent combination of educational background, related experience, and/or military experience


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience with financial services platforms supporting payments, settlement, ledgers, risk, compliance, or regulatory reporting.
* Experience with MLOps or LLMOps practices, including model deployment, monitoring, prompt versioning, and regression testing.
* Experience with multi\-agent orchestration frameworks and enterprise tool ecosystem integration.
* TOGAF, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud architecture certification.
* Experience presenting architectural trade\-offs and governance decisions to senior technology and business stakeholders.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

23f72b2b.title: Solutions Architect
23f72b2b.description:
At AT DAWN Technologies, we are a fast\-growing technology services company building high\-impact teams across Data Engineering, AI, and Backend Development. Our clients include some of the most innovative product companies in the world. We operate delivery centers in India and Vietnam, enabling rapid, high\-quality execution with a product mindset.
 



 We are seeking an experienced
 **Enterprise Solution Architect** 
 with expertise in
 **High** 
**Performance Computing (HPC) and Container platforms in Linux\-based environments** 
 to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for architecting solutions including but not limited to installation, configuration, integration and implementation of HPC technologies and enterprise\-grade container orchestration platform.
 



  





 We are looking for a person with very strong technical skills and a proven track record of designing and working with container platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher, CNCF Kubernetes, HPC Schedulers such as Slurm or PBS Pro, HPC/AI Cluster management technologies such as HPCM or BCM and the ability to work in a dynamic customer\-focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills.

* Identify the growth path and scalability options of a solution and include these in design activities.
* Solution Planning and Design:
* Gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and design integrated HPC and container solutions that align with business objectives.
* Architect and optimize the technical solutions to meet the requirements of the customer.

* Innovation and Research:
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and industry developments related to HPC, Kubernetes, containers, cloud computing, and Security.
* Develop best practices, Accelerators and Show \& Tell for HPC and container platform solutions and integrations.

* Strong focus on understanding customer business requirements and solving complex cloud technology issues
* Be the trusted advisor, delight customers, and deliver exceptional customer experiences to drive customer success.
* Communicate complex technical concepts and findings to non\-technical stakeholders

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including system administrators, developers, data scientist and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery.
* Understands the roles and effectively engages other teams and resources within the company
* Mentor and train new team members and lead the way in participation in tech talks, forums, innovation.



**Required Skills:** 



* Knowledge and experience with Linux System Administration, package management, scheduling, boot procedures/troubleshooting, performance optimization, and networking concepts.
* In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with HPC technologies, workload schedulers – Slurm, Altair PBS pro, and cluster managers – HPCM, Bright cluster manager.
* In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with containerization technologies like Docker, Singularity, or Podman.
* In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with at least two of the container orchestration technologies like CNCF Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher RKE/K3S, Canonical charmed kubernetes or Ezmeral Runtime. Good to have
* Good knowledge and hands\-on experience with OpenStack cloud solutions.
* Good knowledge and hands\-on experience with virtualization technologies like KVM, OpenShift virtualization
* Good knowledge and hands\-on experience with at least two various Linux distributions like RHEL, SLES, Ubuntu, Debian.
* Good Knowledge of GPU technologies, NVIDIA GPU operator, NVIDIA vGPU technology
* Good knowledge of HPC networking stack (high speed networking), InfiniBand, Mellanox
* Good experience in performance optimization and health assessment of HPC components



 such as operating systems, storage, servers, parallel file systems, schedulers, and container orchestration platforms.
 


* Must be good in any of the programming or scripting languages like python, bash
* Good understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, Routing and Load Balancing.
* Knowledge of network protocols like TCP/IP, S3, FTP, NFS, or SMB/CIFS
* Familiarity with microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tools.
* Excellent problem\-solving abilities, analytical thinking, and communication skills to interact with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead technical projects by gathering the requirements, preparing the architecture / design and executing it end to end. Must be able to bring clarity and drive complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Solid business acumen and ability to converse with client on issues and challenges.
* Demonstrates a solid knowledge of the company's breadth of solutions.
* Demonstrates a high\-level understanding of all related vendor product roadmaps.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solutions Architect, HPC and Container platform Specialist, or similar role, with expertise in designing and implementing complex solutions.
* Red Hat Certified Specialist in Containers and Kubernetes (RHCSA, RHCE), CNCF certification \- CKA, CKAD, CKS is preferred.

5b5878d8.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
5b5878d8.description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise\-level customers.



The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.



Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.



The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.



Key job responsibilities


* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.



Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.



Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.



Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.



Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7\+ years of leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2\)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C\-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit \[https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations) for more information.
