You can become a part of …
 



 Founded in 2018, BharatPe is one of India's fastest\-growing fintech companies, offering a comprehensive suite of financial products and services. What began as a single interoperable QR code has grown into a platform used by over 1 crore merchants across the country.
 



 At our core, we exist to drive financial inclusion and accessibility for the real Bharat, which is underserved by traditional finance and held back by complexity, paperwork, and products never designed for it. We are changing that, by building simple, accessible financial tools that meet people where they are, in the language they speak and at the scale they need.
 



 For our merchant partners, we provide an integrated ecosystem spanning QR and PoS payments, working capital credit, and deposit and investment products, enabling small businesses to accept payments, access finance, and grow. For consumers, we are building a fast\-growing set of offerings across UPI payments, Credit on UPI (BharatPe Flex), Personal Loans, and Invest (Digital Gold, Digital Silver, Fixed Deposits, and Mutual Funds), giving them a single place to pay, borrow, and grow their money.
 



 Together, these two sides of our business form a single mission: to bring the full power of digital finance to every merchant and every consumer across India, not just the few who have always had access. Alongside the business, we are equally committed to building an organization where people take genuine ownership, do their most meaningful work, and see their ideas realized at a national scale.
 



 We value diversity, and we encourage different points of view, ways of thinking, and new capabilities to strengthen and improve the lives of our customers. And that is not all.  Candidates based in India only

088fc25b.title: Solution Engineer (Post Sales)
088fc25b.description:
**Hevo Data** 




**Solution Engineer (Post\-sales)** 




**About Hevo** 




 DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus, Santander, and thousands of other data\-driven companies have one thing in common. They all use Hevo Data’s fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc.
 



 We are a San Francisco, Bangalore, and Pune\-based company with 2000\+ customers spread across 45\+ countries in e\-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper\-growth!
 



**Why do we exist?** 




 At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data\-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.
 



 Hevo Pipeline is a no\-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150\+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.
 



 Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40\+ countries to be more data\-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.
 



**The Role** 




 We are growing into mid\-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar \- and the stakes \- are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post\-sale motion to match.
 



 Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart.
 



 As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets.
 



 You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management \- a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.
 



**What You Will Do** 



* Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations \- architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior\-level technical engagements.
* Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co\-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
* Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
* Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance \- both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses, orchestration, transformation, and the broader ecosystem Hevo operates within.
* Identify expansion opportunities through technical engagement and hand them off to the AM with enough context to move the conversation forward commercially.
* Contribute to internal knowledge \- documenting patterns, building reference architectures, and raising the technical bar across the post\-sales team.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Required** 



* 6\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role \- Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, or a technical post\-sale or consulting function.
* Deep, broad knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), orchestration, and the modern data stack.
* Hands\-on experience with data integration tools, CDC, event streaming, or warehouse\-native transformation (dbt, etc.).

3e15ff9e.description:
Join us as a Solution Architect
   

  

* We’ll look to you to create the solution architecture definition for your assigned change projects, in addition to supporting the delivery of business outcomes that benefit both customers and colleagues
* You'll be working closely with stakeholders to contribute to the design and implementation of digital solutions, validating alignment with the bank’s strategic target architecture and roadmap
* If you’re ready for a new challenge and want to make a far\-reaching impact through your work, this could be the opportunity you’re looking for
* We're offering this role at vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 As a Solution Architect, you’ll be architecting customer centric, high performance, secure and robust end to end digital products, solutions, and services that deliver business value while aligning to the bank’s strategic target architectures and roadmaps.
   

  

 You’ll be supporting the growth of architecting capability, contributing to the development of architecture skills across the team by sharing knowledge, best practices, lessons learned, and mentoring others.
   

  

**As Well As This, You’ll Be**
* Supporting the realisation of the enterprise and solution architecture, working as part of development teams throughout the engineering development lifecycle
* Providing technical guidance, resolving architectural impediments, and championing the adoption of architecture patterns and practices
* Collaborating with programme stakeholders to help define the minimum viable solution architectures, while following the bank’s architecture method and frameworks
* Supporting the selection and integration of technologies using the bank’s approved technology catalogues and patterns, with a focus on practical and immediate application
* Adopting a DevOps mindset by working as part of development teams to embed architecture guidance in CI/CD pipelines


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 To take on this role, you’ll need practitioner knowledge of solution architecture frameworks, modern technologies such as Cloud, microservices and AI, agile architecture and DevOps practices, including a deep understanding of business use cases and emerging trends that drive organisational success. Produce HLSDs, Detailed Designs, architecture roadmaps, and technical standards and design and build scalable GenAI capabilities including RAG, Agentic AI, multimodal AI, and multi\-model orchestration.
   

  

 You’ll bring practitioner experience of leading PoCs, technology evaluations, and innovation initiatives from concept to production, define platform architecture for model serving, AI gateways, APIs, observability, security, and governance and collaborate with product, engineering, data science, security, and architecture teams to deliver business outcomes.
   

  

**You’ll Also Demonstrate Experience Of**
* Strong experience in Cloud Architecture, preferably AWS.
* Proven experience creating HLSDs and Detailed Solution Designs.
* Expertise in GenAI platform architecture, AI/ML solutions, and cloud\-native technologies.
* Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD practices.
* Strong knowledge of RAG, vector databases, model orchestration, and LLM\-based solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Python and platform engineering.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, and communication skills

 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
   

  

 Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview**
**ROLE PURPOSE**
 Serve as the programme's Jira Cloud subject\-matter authority in support of Client's migration execution. The role advises on target\-state architecture, rationalization, app strategy, and validation approach — ensuring Client's migration engineering team executes against a clean, well\-designed cloud destination — without itself owning migration execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Advise on target\-state Atlassian Cloud architecture: site and plan topology, sandbox strategy, data residency posture, identity and access patterns (SSO/SCIM, Atlassian Guard), and permission/governance models.
* Lead rationalization recommendations ahead of each wave: workflows, custom fields, schemes, screens, dashboards, and Confluence space structures — reducing migration payload and post\-migration debt.
* Own the Marketplace app gap analysis: Data Center app inventory, cloud equivalence assessment, Connect\-to\-Forge implications, and recommendations to replace, retire, or rebuild — a primary driver of wave complexity classification.
* Advise on integration patterns for rebuilt or replaced integrations with enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow), in coordination with the Senior Cloud Engineer and Client integration owners.
* Support wave criteria definition and per\-project complexity assessment; contribute to go/no\-go readiness reviews.
* Define the validation and verification approach for migrated data and configuration (staging\-first migration, integrity comparison, user mapping consistency) and review verification outcomes with Client's migration engineers.
* Provide escalation\-level troubleshooting guidance during migration windows and hypercare; document architectural decisions and standards in Confluence.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of Atlassian platform expertise spanning Jira Data Center and Jira Cloud administration/architecture at enterprise scale (5,000\+ users).
* Direct experience with Data Center\-to\-Cloud migration assessment and planning, including familiarity with Atlassian's cloud migration tooling and staged (staging\-to\-production) migration approaches.
* Deep knowledge of the Atlassian Marketplace ecosystem, including cloud app parity analysis and the Connect/Forge platform transition.
* Strong grasp of enterprise identity, security, and governance in Atlassian Cloud (Atlassian Guard/Access, SSO/SCIM, data residency).
* Ability to communicate architectural trade\-offs crisply to both engineers and programme leadership.


**Preferred**

0a8b042f.title: Hybrid Cloud Architect
0a8b042f.description:
**About Us**
**PHINIA:** 
 Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow.
   

  

 PHINIA is an independent, market\-leading, premium solutions and components provider with over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, with a strong brand portfolio that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY® and HARTRIDGE™. With over 12,500 employees across 43 locations in 20 countries, PHINIA is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA.
   

  

 At PHINIA, we Provide fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket products and solutions of the highest quality — developed and manufactured responsibly — that are designed to enhance efficiency and reduce the environmental impact of vehicles, industrial machinery, and other applications. In doing so, we contribute to a cleaner tomorrow, treat our people and surrounding communities with respect, and hold ourselves accountable to robust ethical standards.
   

  

**Our Culture**
 PHINIA promotes and cultivates an inclusive culture and diverse perspectives, strives to maintain its reputation for excellence, thrives on the power of collaboration, and fosters the development of our talented employees. We believe in making a positive impact through our business and actions, and we take our collective responsibility seriously.
   

  

**Career Opportunities**
 We believe in building a brighter tomorrow for our employees as well as our customers and encourage you to learn about our long history, strong culture, new technologies, and future vision. We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Join us on this shared journey toward a brighter tomorrow.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 PHINIA is seeking a Hybrid Cloud Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of PHINIA’s hybrid cloud ecosystem, spanning on‑premises infrastructure, private cloud, and public cloud platforms. This role ensures secure, scalable, cost‑efficient cloud architectures that align with PHINIA’s digital transformation strategy. The architect will guide cloud migration initiatives and governance standards while partnering closely with infrastructure, security, application, and business teams to deliver resilient hybrid cloud capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect hybrid cloud environments across on‑prem, private cloud, and public cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP).
* Lead hybrid infrastructure modernization, including cloud migration strategies and data center integration.
* Establish and enforce hybrid cloud governance models, compliance controls, FinOps principles and security standards in collaboration with PHINIA Security and IT governance teams.
* Develop disaster recovery, business continuity approaches, and hybrid failover patterns.
* Create and maintain hybrid cloud architectural documentation, integration diagrams, interface specifications, and operational runbooks.
* Evaluate emerging cloud technologies, recommend enhancements, and lead proof‑of‑concept initiatives.
* Collaborate with DevOps, Infrastructure, and Application teams to drive automation, IaC adoption, and CI/CD integration.
* Modernize workloads (ERP, MES, PLM, custom apps) using containers, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native services.
* Design secure OT/IT integration, industrial edge compute, and data pipelines (OPC‑UA, IoT, analytics).


**What we’re looking for:**
* Bachelor’s or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent work experience.
* 7\+ years of IT infrastructure experience with 4\+ years in cloud or hybrid architecture.
* Strong expertise in Azure (preferred), plus working knowledge of AWS/GCP.
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), automation, CI/CD tooling and containerization (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Experience with OT systems and industrial protocols.
* Foundation in cloud security, Zero Trust, networking, and governance.
* Background in manufacturing/automotive environments is a strong preference.
* Certifications such as Azure/AWS Architect, TOGAF, or FinOps are plus.


**What We Offer**
 We provide compensation and benefits programs intended to attract, motivate, reward, and retain an incredibly talented, globally diverse workforce at all levels within our organization. Our compensation programs are informed by market data and business needs, and we are committed to providing equitable and competitive compensation. 07239117.title: Enterprise Architect - Bengaluru
07239117.description:
**Job Description**
**Do you enjoy designing and building public cloud solutions for customers?**
**Do you enjoy working with a diverse multi\-national team of engineering talents?**
**Join our Global Services Cloud Solutions team!**
 Akamai is working to simplify the way people work in the cloud. The team's mission is to accelerate innovation by making computing simple, scalable, accessible, and affordable for all. We provide the infrastructure and services that enable developers to build next\-generation applications.
   

  

**Shape the future of the internet!**
 You will play a key role in the customer solution lifecycle, supporting success teams in defining Cloud/Linode solutions. Guide customers through strategic and technical aspects of Cloud transformations with a focus on implementation. Deliver valuable application outcomes using Akamai Cloud Compute products and services. Additionally, serve as a thought leader in cloud computing within and beyond Akamai.
   

  

**As An Enterprise Architect, You Will Be Responsible For**
* Collaborating with account teams to support cloud opportunities, ensuring lasting customer success through Linode service adoption and client engagement.
* Analyzing and breaking down application components while utilizing modern cloud technologies to create scalable, efficient solutions.
* Facilitating the design and implementation of Akamai Compute Solutions, service\-oriented architectures, APIs, and web services to solve complex enterprise challenges.
* Establishing technical thought leadership in cloud computing and Linode services to promote Akamai's business growth strategies.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with teams across Akamai's cloud compute, security, and delivery technology stacks to develop solutions for enterprise workloads.


**Do What You Love**
 To be successful in this role you will:
   

  

* Have experience with cloud\-based applications for 6 to 10 years in architecture, implementation, and strategy within large\-scale systems.
* Align IT investments and services with organizational goals and broader business strategies while evaluating their effectiveness.
* Have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrate expertise in technical roles at cloud software organizations or public cloud environments with customer\-focused responsibilities.
* Have expertise in architecting complex IaaS solutions with relevant certifications from AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Gain experience in cloud domains, including IaaS, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and open\-source tools like Kafka, Redis, ELK stack.
* Collaborate effectively with channel partners, systems integrators, third\-party developers, and internal teams within extensive enterprise environments.
* Demonstrate exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, effectively conveying technical content to varied audiences.


**About Us**
 At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
   

  

 Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.
   

  

**Our Focus Is Simple**
**Cloud and Edge:** 
 Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
   

  

**Security** 
 : Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
   

  

**Content Delivery** 
 : Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
   

  

**AI** 
 : Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.
   

  

 At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.
   

  

**Benefits at Akamai:** 
 We support your health, well\-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.
   

  

**FlexBase adapts to your job's needs**
 Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.
   

  

 We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.
   

  

 Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

d02fdb09.title: Architect AWS
d02fdb09.description:
We are looking for an Architect to own the technical vision for large\-scale, distributed, cloud\-native platforms built primarily on AWS (including EKS) and Red Hat OpenShift, with Go, Python, and Node.js, extending into adjacent technologies as engagements require. This role works closely with client stakeholders, engineering leadership, and onshore/offshore delivery teams to define architecture standards, guide technology choices, and ensure platforms are scalable, secure, and cost\-effective. The scope is intentionally broader than a single language or service stack: while Go, Python, Node.js, AWS/EKS, OpenShift, and automation form the core, the architect is expected to evaluate and guide adjacent technologies (containers and orchestration, event streaming, infrastructure\-as\-code, data platforms, and API management) as the right tool for a given problem.
   

  

 ‍
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end architecture forlarge\-scale, distributed, cloud\-native systems on AWS (including EKS) and RedHat OpenShift, extending into adjacent technologies such as Kafka, Terraform,and service mesh as needed
* Set platform strategy forcontainer orchestration across cloud (AWS EKS) and enterprise Kubernetes(OpenShift) environments, including decisions on workload placement,portability, and multi\-platform standards
* Define enterprise architecturestandards, design patterns, and engineering guardrails across teams
* Lead architecture reviews,produce system blueprints, and maintain technology roadmaps
* Drive an automation\-firstengineering culture: infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD, self\-healing systems, andobservability
* Guide technology selection andevaluate emerging tools and frameworks across the core stack and adjacenttechnologies
* Act as the primary technical advisor to client stakeholders on platform strategy, with particular depth inUS health insurance and payer environments
* Ensure architecture decisions account for relevant compliance and security requirements (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2\);any compliance\-related documentation produced is draft guidance for review against approved source policies, not an attestation of record
* Mentor senior engineers andemerging architects, building technical capability across onshore and offshoreteams
* Partner with pre\-sales anddelivery leadership on technical solutioning for prospective and existingclients
* Own non\-functional requirements across engagements: scalability, performance, security, cost efficiency, andresilience


 ‍
   

  

 ‍
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degreein Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 15\+ years in softwareengineering, including at least 7 years in an architecture\-level role
* Deep expertise in distributedsystems design and cloud\-native architecture on AWS
* Strong hands\-on background inGo, Python, and Node.js, with the ability to evaluate and guide adjacentlanguages and frameworks as needed
* Proven, hands\-on experiencearchitecting and operating container platforms on both AWS EKS and Red HatOpenShift, including workload portability and platform selection trade\-offs
* Proven experience designingautomation\-first platforms (infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD, orchestration)
* Strong working knowledge ofadjacent technologies: Docker, Kafka or similar event\-streaming platforms,service mesh, API gateways, and Terraform
* Experience leading architectureacross multi\-team, multi\-region engagements, including onshore/offshoredelivery models
* Excellent stakeholdermanagement and client\-facing communication skills
* Track record of mentoringengineering teams and setting technical direction at scale


 ‍
   

  

**AI Knowledge \& AI\-Assisted Development (Required)**
* Deep understanding ofAI\-assisted and agentic software development practices, with the ability todefine organization\- or program\-wide standards, tooling choices, and governancefor AI\-assisted engineering
* Strong working knowledge ofapplied AI/LLM architecture patterns: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, vectorstores/embeddings, agent frameworks, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), and howthese integrate with distributed, cloud\-native systems on AWS
* Able to evaluate build\-vs\-buydecisions for AI capabilities and architect AI\-enabled features responsiblywithin compliance\-sensitive environments, including data privacy and securityguardrails for AI usage around PHI and other sensitive health plan data
* Experience shaping anorganization's AI adoption strategy for the software development lifecycle:tooling selection, cost management, security review, and change managementacross onshore/offshore teams
* Able to advise clients andengineering leadership on where and how AI can responsibly accelerate deliverywithout compromising compliance or quality


 ‍
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong background in the UShealth insurance or payer domain: claims platforms, core administrationsystems, provider and member data, enrollment, benefits, and HIPAA
* Experience with healthcareinteroperability standards (HL7, FHIR, X12 EDI) and payer core administrationplatforms
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or equivalent, is a plus
* Experience in a consulting orprofessional services environment serving health plan clients

9710ac47.title: Cloud Infrastructure / Platform Engineer
9710ac47.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
   

  

 Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
   

  

**About F5**
 At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
   

  

 Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We’re looking for a Cloud Infrastructure/Platform Engineer to build and operate a secure, scalable cloud “landing zone” and platform foundations. You’ll define and automate FinOps and Security governance using policy\-as\-code, create reusable infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) libraries, and enable teams through CI/CD pipelines and GitOps practices. You should bring deep hands\-on expertise in at least one major cloud (Azure or AWS preferred), with additional experience in GCP, OCI, or IBM Cloud as a plus.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and operate cloud landing zones (multi\-account/subscription, org structure, network, identity, logging, security baselines).
* Implement governance and guardrails using policy\-as\-code (e.g., Azure Policy, AWS Organizations/SCPs, OPA/Conftest), including exception handling and auditability.
* Define and deploy FinOps observability and enforcement tooling to enable DevOps teams to operate efficiently as well as cross\-account financial oversight.
* Deliver an infrastructure platform as a product to the internal development community.
* Develop reusable IaC modules/libraries (Terraform primary; Bicep/ARM and CloudFormation also valued) and promote standard patterns for teams.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, OS Images, containers, and platform components using GitOps workflows (PR\-based changes, automated validation, progressive delivery).
* Standardize environments (dev/test/prod) with consistent controls, tagging/metadata, and cost management guardrails.
* Embed security and compliance into build/deploy: secret handling, encryption, IAM least privilege, vulnerability scanning, and evidence generation.
* Observability and SRE practices: implement monitoring/alerting and dashboards, support incident response, and help define/track SLIs/SLOs for platform services.
* Collaborate in an agile delivery model; participate in planning, refinement, and execution (SAFe experience is a bonus).


**Required Qualifications**
* Deep hands\-on experience engineering cloud infrastructure on one or more of Azure, AWS, and GCP (architecture \+ implementation).
* Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform primary; Bicep/ARM and CloudFormation).
* Specific background in cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices, including Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, native cloud cost management tools, and policy\-based cost controls.
* Proven experience implementing landing zones / foundational cloud platforms (identity, network, shared services, governance).
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and automated compliance (e.g., Azure Policy, AWS Config \+ SCPs, OPA/Conftest).
* CI/CD expertise for infrastructure: pipeline design, testing/validation, approvals, environment promotion, drift detection.
* Working knowledge of configuration management/automation in current\-state enterprise environments (e.g., Ansible and Puppet).
* Strong understanding of IAM, network security, encryption, key management, and secure\-by\-default patterns.
* Comfortable with Git\-based workflows (PR reviews, branching strategies, versioning, release management).
* Scripting/programming ability (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go) to build automation and tooling.
* Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
* Experience with Oracle Cloud (OCI)
* Experience with Cloud Financial Management (FinOps) and implementing FinOps policies using automation (“Policy as Code”)
* Strong Network Engineering background including cloud and hybrid\-cloud connectivity, network security policy automation, and cloud native network architectures.
* Experience working in hybrid environments to deliver platform automation solutions in the Data Center.
* Familiarity with security and control frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST 800\-171, SOX, SOC 2, and ISO 27002\.
* Kubernetes/platform experience (AKS/EKS/GKE/OKE), service mesh, or container platform operations.
* Experience with platform engineering concepts: developer portals/catalogs, golden paths, internal products.
* Familiarity with observability stacks: native CSP tooling, Datadog, Splunk, LogicMonitor
* SAFe or other structured agile delivery framework experience (PI planning, ARTs, epics/features).


 The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all\-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change.
   

  

**Please note that F5 only contacts candidates through F5 email address (ending with @f5\.com) or auto email notification from Workday (ending with f5\.com or** 
**@myworkday.com)** 
**.**
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 It is the policy of F5 to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and employment applicants without regard to unlawful considerations of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, sensory, physical, or mental disability, marital status, veteran or military status, genetic information, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, discipline, and termination. F5 offers a variety of reasonable accommodations for candidates. Requesting an accommodation is completely voluntary. F5 will assess the need for accommodations in the application process separately from those that may be needed to perform the job. Request by contacting accommodations@f5\.com.

a3ed9dd2.title: Google Cloud Technology Consultant
a3ed9dd2.description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking an experienced **Google Cloud Technology Consultant** to join our team and drive enterprise cloud transformation initiatives.


In this role, you will partner with clients to design future\-state GCP architectures, guide application modernization efforts, and serve as a trusted technical advisor across complex cloud programs. You will collaborate closely with pre\-sales, engineering, and delivery teams to shape scalable, secure, and innovative solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with enterprise clients to assess existing application and infrastructure landscapes and define future\-state GCP architecture and transformation strategies
* Advise clients across cloud platform engineering, cloud\-native adoption, application modernization, and migration
* Architect enterprise GCP environments covering organization structure, landing zones, networking, IAM, security, governance, observability, and platform services
* Define modernization approaches for legacy and enterprise applications, including re\-platforming, refactoring, containerization, microservices adoption, and cloud\-native re\-architecture
* Guide architecture using services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Pub/Sub, Apigee, and other GCP managed services
* Lead large\-scale workload assessments and define migration and modernization strategies, including rehost, re\-platform, refactor, and re\-architect
* Advise engineering teams on scalable application architectures, APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, integration patterns, and distributed systems
* Shape technical solutions for RFPs, proposals, architecture workshops, and client discussions in collaboration with pre\-sales, engineering, and delivery teams
* Evaluate opportunities to leverage GenAI and Vertex AI capabilities within cloud transformation and application modernization programs
* Act as a trusted technical advisor, bringing clarity and architectural direction to complex enterprise cloud transformation initiatives

**Requirements**

* 16\-22 years of overall IT experience with strong background in enterprise architecture, cloud consulting, systems/platform architecture, or application architecture
* Hands\-on architectural expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including compute, networking, IAM, security, storage, governance, observability, and managed services
* Proficiency in designing enterprise cloud foundations, including GCP Landing Zones, Organization/Folder/Project structures, Shared VPC, IAM, and Organization Policies
* Skills in GKE/Kubernetes, containers, and Cloud Run for cloud\-native application platforms
* Proven capability in application modernization, including migration from monolithic or legacy applications toward microservices, containerized, API\-driven, or event\-driven architectures
* Familiarity with application architecture and development technologies such as Java, .NET, or Python
* Background in enterprise\-scale cloud migration and modernization programs
* Understanding of APIs, integration patterns, and messaging/event streaming, along with databases, caching, and distributed application architectures
* Ability to engage with senior business and technology stakeholders and translate business transformation objectives into practical cloud architecture
* Experience contributing to pre\-sales, solutioning, RFPs, architecture assessments, and client workshops
* Capability to operate as a senior individual contributor and influence enterprise architecture decisions across cloud platform and application modernization initiatives

**Nice to have**

* Google Cloud certifications such as Professional Cloud Architect or other relevant GCP certifications
* Exposure to AWS or Azure
* Experience with multi\-cloud transformation programs

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

 The Investment Data Operations \& Transformation Lead / Project Manager will be responsible for leading investment\-data operations, data transformation initiatives, and delivery workstreams across the organization.
   

  

 The role requires a strong blend of investment\-domain expertise, data management, technical proficiency, project leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on techno\-functional leadership role responsible for supervising business analysts and data operations teams while actively reviewing, validating, and challenging investment\-data outputs. The incumbent will drive investment\-data quality, reconciliation, migration, remediation, and governance activities while acting as the bridge between investment teams, operations stakeholders, technology teams, fund administrators, and external service providers.

 Document Service continuous ingestion pipeline utilizing Azure Cloud technologies, Snowflake, SharePoint, and related data services.

* Lead and supervise a team of Business Analysts and Data Operations professionals, ensuring quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of investment\-data initiatives.

* Lead the implementation and ongoing enhancement of the Citco Document Service ingestion pipeline leveraging Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Snowflake, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph API, and related Azure services.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual reconciliation, data\-quality, and operational processes using Python, AI, and intelligent automation technologies.
* Develop operational dashboards, reporting, KPIs, and governance metrics to monitor data quality, process Key competencies
* Bachelor’s or Master’efficiency, and delivery performance.


**Key competencies**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, MCA, or a related discipline.
* Strong leadership and people\-management skills with proven experience leading Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or Data Operations teams.
* Deep understanding of private markets, fund investment data, fund structures, commitments, capital calls, distributions, NAV, valuations, cash flows, and performance metrics.
* Expertise in investment\-data reconciliation, data remediation, golden record creation, and multi\-source data validation.
* Proven experience managing complex data migration, transformation, and system implementation programs.
* Strong business analysis capability, including requirements gathering, process mapping, stakeholder workshops, and functional specification development.
* Advanced SQL skills with the ability to independently profile, analyze, validate, and troubleshoot large and complex datasets.
* Hands\-on experience with Snowflake, Azure Data Services, data warehouses/lakehouses, and modern data platforms.

* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and executive reporting skills with the ability to bridge business and technology teams.
* Continuous improvement mindset with experience leveraging automation, AI, or LLM\-enabled solutions to enhance data operations and operational efficiency.

2dc3473f.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
2dc3473f.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager
Job Description: Senior Specialist, Product Development, Digital Transformation \& Optimization  

  

Overview:  

Mastercard is a global technology company. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making payment and data transactions safe, simple, smart, and successful. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

  

The Digital Transformation and Optimization team is part of Core Solutions. We are responsible for optimizing eCommerce solutions and for driving transaction authorization improvement for digital transactions globally. We do this by being a consumer centric for our products and services and being relevant in all consumer money flows.
  

  

The Role:  

* Have good understanding of hybrid application integrations, analytical tools to measure and track customer experience, like Mixtiles, and Project management frameworks/ tools like GIT, copilot and Jira
* Responsible for identifying, analyzing, developing, and bringing solutions to market that meet customer needs through supporting stories, feature management and project planning, helping to make solid product decisions and deliver value
* Drive product evolution with a focus on data science, engineering and business impact by helping to maintain the product backlog, and prioritize requirements
* Provide Operational support of new products where authorization recommendations are delivered from an AI engine to an Mastercard global application
* Act as a Program Admin to support Mastercard product governance tools and services (Studio, Architecture Reviews, AI governance, Compliance and Data Security, etc.)
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including engineering, data science, operations, and design to deliver scalable solutions that enhance product connectivity, data flow, and performance insight
* Continuously innovate and explore new approaches, tools, techniques, and technologies to solve business problems
* Stay updated on emerging trends in integration technologies (e.g., AI ML model \& and data analytics platforms (e.g., Thoughtspot, Power BI)

  

Candidates based in India only  

  

ALL ABOUT YOU  

The candidate should demonstrate:  

* Must have a minimum of 5 years of experience in technical product management and project management
* Passion for all things digital and intrinsic curiosity to understand new technology like Artificial Intelligence, Cloud solutions
* Entrepreneurial spirit and global mindset with a passion for learning and using data to solve large scale business problems
* Experience using project management tools like Git, Jira, Aha, etc is preferable
* Excellent communication \& influencing skills to work with internal and external stakeholders; ability to articulate problem statements, opportunity areas and complex data models
* Excellent project management and execution skills, with strong problem solving, highly analytical, quantitative communication and organizational skills
* Create and maintain material in support of product development and management: business cases, product roadmaps, success metrics, etc.
* Good to have experience with Enterprise Business Intelligence Platform/Data platforms
* Ability to articulate the business value of products and actively participate in sales enablement efforts
* Proven success in interacting with stakeholders to understand technical needs and ensure analyses and solutions effectively meet their requirements

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

affa3dcd.title: ISP Program Manager
affa3dcd.description:
**Role Overview**
 The Program Manager – OSAT is responsible for leading large, complex customer programs from concept through high\-volume manufacturing. This role serves as the single point of accountability for program execution—integrating customer requirements, engineering development, supply chain, and factory operations to ensure on\-time, on\-cost, and on\-quality delivery.
   

  

 A major focus of this position is operations readiness for new products (NPI to HVM transition), including capacity planning, qualification, ramp management, and alignment of cross\-functional teams within an outsourced semiconductor assembly and test environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership \& Execution**
* Own end\-to\-end execution of multiple customer programs within the OSAT business unit.
* Act as the primary interface between customers and internal organizations (Technology Development, Factory NPI and Process Engineering, Operations/Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance).
* Develop and maintain integrated program schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Drive structured program governance: stage gates, risk reviews, and executive reporting.
* Manage program financials including cost optimisation models, margins, and change management.


**Customer Engagement**
* Lead customer technical and business reviews, ensuring alignment on scope, schedule, and performance.
* Translate customer requirements into actionable internal plans.
* Manage customer escalations and ensure rapid issue resolution.
* Support commercial teams in RFQs, SOWs, and new business opportunities.


**Operations Readiness \& NPI**
* Lead NPI to HVM transition activities including:
+ Factory readiness (equipment, capacity, tooling, materials)
+ Qualification planning (DOE, reliability, process validation)
+ Yield ramp strategies and learning cycles

* Coordinate process development, product engineering, and manufacturing teams.
* Ensure BOM, process flows, test programs, and quality controls are production\-ready.


**Cross\-Functional Coordination**
* Chair core team meetings and drive accountability across functions.
* Manage risk registers, mitigation plans, and contingency strategies.
* Partner with Industrial Engineering on line design, cycle time, and capacity modeling.
* Align with Quality on customer qualifications, audits, and compliance.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Establish program management best practices, KPIs, and dashboards.
* Drive lessons\-learned and standardization across programs.
* Support digitalization of program tracking and factory execution.


**Required Qualifications**
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Materials, Industrial) or related field.

- 15\+ years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, OSAT, or advanced packaging.

- Relevant years of experience in program/project management with direct customer ownership.

- Proven experience with:

- New Product Introduction (NPI) and HVM ramp

- Assembly \& Test processes (wire bond, flip chip, WLCSP, BGA, SiP, etc.)

- Semiconductor quality systems (APQP, FMEA, Control Plans, 8D)

- Strong knowledge of:

* Manufacturing operations, capacity planning, and yield management
* Supply chain coordination and material readiness
* Cost modeling and program financial management
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.


**Preferred Qualifications**
- Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, or MBA.

- Experience working directly in an OSAT or IDM ATM environment.

- PMP / PgMP / PRINCE2 certification.

- Hands\-on background in:

* Package development and reliability qualification
* Test engineering and product bring\-up
* Factory automation and MES systems
* Experience with Tier\-1 global customers in mobile, automotive, HPC, or networking.
* Six Sigma Green/Black Belt certification.

**Description**
**Salesforce Customer Success:**
 Salesforce’s worldwide Customer Success team is a global network of Salesforce employees and partners. Our sole mission is to ensure customer success. We work with our customers to build relationships, learn about their businesses, and drive value\-based results. Our motto for our customers is "Your Success is our Success"
   

  

* Job Description: Senior Success Archiect/Success Architect


**Role Description**
* Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long\-term business success.
* Success Architects play a flexible and pivotal role in supporting a wide range of customers. They act as the customer's first point of contact for a mix of reactive and proactive needs. This includes providing frontline technical support (Support), delivering educational 'Guide' sessions to drive feature adoption, and assisting with foundational architectural health checks (basic Architect). They collaborate closely with senior Success Architects and Support Engineers to triage complex issues and ensure customers are on a path to long\-term health, bridging the gap between daily challenges and long\-term success.


**Key Responsibilities**
* As a Sucess Architects specializing in Sales Cloud, you will:
* Drive Customer Impact – Partner with a portfolio of customers, assessing their implementations and delivering recommendations on common technical issues, feature adoption (Guide), and foundational solution design (basic Architect).
* Lead with Expertise – Serve as a trusted technical generalist, providing reactive and proactive guidance on product best practices.
* Communicate with Clarity – Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to customer stakeholders and managers, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
* Innovate \& Solve Problems – Triage capability gaps and design inefficiencies, resolving common issues directly and escalating complex architectural challenges to senior Success Architects.
* Execute Proven Strategies – Leverage and execute playbooks from Support, Guides, and the Architect team to meet customer needs.
* Build Strong Relationships – Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement and overall business growth.
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI\-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive\-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi\-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI\-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C\-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI\-augmented success practices — defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership


**Basic Requirements**
* Solution Design \& Architecture
+ 5\+ years of hands\-on technical experience
+ Strong working knowledge of Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance and best practices.
+ Experience participating in complex implementations and understanding integration principles.
+ Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics and security best practices.
+ Familiarity with industry\- or vertical\-specific solutions (preferred).

* Communication \& Leadership
+ Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options and drive stakeholder alignment.
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.
+ Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
+ Proven ability to manage customer\-facing discussions and explain technical concepts clearly.
+ High proficiency in English.

* Strategic Thinking \& Problem Solving
+ Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations and drive customer transformation.
+ Provide data\-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
+ Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
+ Desired Technical Skills

* Sales Cloud Expertise
+ Strong functional and configuration knowledge of Sales Cloud features, including opportunity/pipeline management, forecasting, email integration and advanced capabilities such as Einstein Conversation Insights, Sales Engagement and Sales Performance Management.
+ Ability to configure and optimize these features to meet business needs.

* Data Management \& Integration
+ Proficient in understanding and troubleshooting data models, relationships (lookup/master\-detail), validation rules and data governance best practices.
+ Experience with data import/export strategies, deduplication, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Informatica) and third\-party connectors.

* Secure \& Scalable Architecture
+ Strong understanding of role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets and security configurations.
+ Ability to review a customer's security model for common issues.
+ Skilled in identifying common anti\-patterns and escalating to senior architects for resolution.

* Salesforce Development
+ Ability to read, understand, and debug APEX, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
+ Hands\-on development experience is a strong plus, but the primary focus is on configuration and troubleshooting.
+ Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.

* System Integration \& Extensibility
+ Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware and event\-driven architectures.
+ Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects and tools like Salesforce Connect and Event Relay.
+ Certifications

* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer\-facing role, with hands\-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI\-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI\-generated insights into executive\-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization

Company Overview
  
  

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  

Job Overview
  
  

ROLE PURPOSE
  
  

Serve as the programme's Jira Cloud subject\-matter authority in support of Client's migration execution. The role advises on target\-state architecture, rationalization, app strategy, and validation approach — ensuring Client's migration engineering team executes against a clean, well\-designed cloud destination — without itself owning migration execution.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

**Advise on target\-state Atlassian Cloud architecture:** site and plan topology, sandbox strategy, data residency posture, identity and access patterns (SSO/SCIM, Atlassian Guard), and permission/governance models.
  
**Lead rationalization recommendations ahead of each wave:** workflows, custom fields, schemes, screens, dashboards, and Confluence space structures — reducing migration payload and post\-migration debt.
  
**Own the Marketplace app gap analysis:** Data Center app inventory, cloud equivalence assessment, Connect\-to\-Forge implications, and recommendations to replace, retire, or rebuild — a primary driver of wave complexity classification.
  
Advise on integration patterns for rebuilt or replaced integrations with enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow), in coordination with the Senior Cloud Engineer and Client integration owners.
  
Support wave criteria definition and per\-project complexity assessment; contribute to go/no\-go readiness reviews.
  
Define the validation and verification approach for migrated data and configuration (staging\-first migration, integrity comparison, user mapping consistency) and review verification outcomes with Client's migration engineers.
  
Provide escalation\-level troubleshooting guidance during migration windows and hypercare; document architectural decisions and standards in Confluence.
  
  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE
  
  

10\+ years of Atlassian platform expertise spanning Jira Data Center and Jira Cloud administration/architecture at enterprise scale (5,000\+ users).
  
Direct experience with Data Center\-to\-Cloud migration assessment and planning, including familiarity with Atlassian's cloud migration tooling and staged (staging\-to\-production) migration approaches.
  
Deep knowledge of the Atlassian Marketplace ecosystem, including cloud app parity analysis and the Connect/Forge platform transition.
  
Strong grasp of enterprise identity, security, and governance in Atlassian Cloud (Atlassian Guard/Access, SSO/SCIM, data residency).
  
Ability to communicate architectural trade\-offs crisply to both engineers and programme leadership.
  
  

PREFERRED
  
  

Atlassian certifications (e.g., ACP\-level Jira administration).
  
Experience in regulated industries where validation evidence and auditability matter.
  
Exposure to SAFe\-aligned Jira configuration at scale.
  
  

Compensation

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.

Job Title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect


Division: Assessment \& Qualifications Delivery


Location: Bangalore or Chennai, India (Hybrid)


**Role Summary**

As a Solution Architect (E30\), you will design and deliver new services on Microsoft Azure aligned with Pearson’s enterprise standards. Your remit includes the development of secure, scalable solution architectures, while ensuring integration across legacy on\-premise and AWS components where needed. You will collaborate with product owners, business analysts, delivery teams (including technical architects and developers) and external partners to convert business requirements into effective technical solutions. This includes evaluating solution options, estimating costs and ensuring that designs meet both functional and non\-functional requirements (e.g. security, performance, availability, scalability). Clear communication and stakeholder engagement are essential in this role.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Solution Architecture Design: Lead the design of end\-to\-end solutions on Azure (and advise on on\-premise or AWS where needed), selecting optimal services and patterns to meet both functional and non\-functional requirements. Produce architecture blueprints, dataflows and interface specifications.
* Solution Option Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Work with business analysts and product owners to evaluate multiple solution options, ensuring the trade\-offs are understood. Provide cost and effort estimations (including infrastructure, licensing and operational considerations), and help recommend solutions that balance performance, scalability and total cost of ownership.
* Technical Leadership \& Governance: Serve as design authority throughout delivery. Provide guidance, mentoring and quality assurance to delivery teams and third\-party partners. Develop and refine architectural standards where gaps exist to ensure consistent best practices.
* Support Delivery Teams: Collaborate closely with delivery teams—including technical architects, developers, testers and DevOps engineers—to interpret and implement architecture designs correctly. Assist with troubleshooting technical issues, and ensure that Technical Architects and developers share a common understanding of architecture decisions and design patterns.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with product owners, business analysts, subject matter experts and external partners to refine requirements. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, ensuring alignment and shared understanding.
* Vendor Oversight: Work with third\-party delivery teams, reviewing their architectures, holding them accountable to Pearson’s standards and supporting them in meeting quality targets.
* Documentation \& Planning: Produce system diagrams, interface specifications and implementation roadmaps. Ensure design decisions are thoroughly documented and communicated.
* Innovation \& Continuous Improvement: Monitor industry trends and evaluate new technologies (e.g. infrastructure automation, AI, data platforms) for relevance to Pearson. Propose enhancements that support robust, modern and cost\-effective solutions.
* Compliance \& Security: Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson’s security and data privacy standards. Participate in design reviews and governance forums to ensure compliance with enterprise architecture policies.
* Lifecycle Support: Support implementation teams from development through deployment, addressing technical issues and ensuring solutions deliver the intended business value.

**Essential Experience \& Skills**

* Extensive Solution Architecture Experience: Proven track record of designing and implementing complex enterprise solutions, with a strong emphasis on Azure cloud services and cloud\-native principles.
* Architecture \& Design Expertise: Ability to produce architecture blueprints, dataflows, integration diagrams and detailed specifications.
* Cloud Proficiency: Deep understanding of Azure compute, storage, networking, security and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g. ARM, Terraform). Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices.
* Technical Leadership \& Collaboration: Experience overseeing design implementation, defining architectural standards and providing technical guidance to teams and vendors.
* Solution Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Ability to evaluate solution options and provide well\-reasoned recommendations based on technical fit, effort and cost.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication and interpersonal skills; able to articulate architecture rationale to technical and non\-technical stakeholders and foster alignment.
* Problem Solving \& Adaptability: Proven analytical skills and adaptability; comfortable working in dynamic environments and adjusting solutions as requirements evolve.
* Business Insight: Ability to balance technology decisions with business outcomes to ensure solutions deliver value.
* Education \& Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; Master’s degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g. BCS Intermediate Certificate in Enterprise Architecture, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are highly regarded.

**Desirable Skills**

* Knowledge of relational databases, data modelling and data analytics solutions.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with Agile methodologies, TDD and other modern development practices.
* Programming/scripting for automation (PowerShell, Python).
* Good understanding of AWS PaaS services (such as RDS/SQL, SNS, Aurora) to support integrated or legacy components.
* Understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
* Awareness of AI/ML and emerging technologies and their impact on architecture.

**Job Location and Hours**

The role is aligned to our Bangalore or Chennai offices in India, working a 45 hour week. All our roles are hybrid working; our current policy requires our team to work from their base office 3 times per week.


**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

****Job Description****
 HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build
 **HPE Networking** 
 , with the ambition of creating the
 **best networking business on the planet** 
 . This role sits at the center of that effort as part of
 **the Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) program** 
 , responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a
 **single platform** 
 , replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.
   

  

 As part of a fast\-moving,
 **multi\-year transformation** 
 , the team will stabilize near\-term operations,
 **migrate core** 
**platforms, onboard businesses and suppliers globally** 
 , and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with
 **business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders** 
 on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.
   

  

 For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help
 **build a new business unit from its earliest days** 
 , rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain
 **hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership** 
 , with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.
   

  

**Workstream\-Specific Details**
**HPE Global IT is a dynamic organization enabling the enterprise to innovate and lead the industry with our consumption\-based IT transformation and our consulting, financial, educational, and operational support services. Join us as we develop innovative solutions that revolutionize how we help customers by simplifying their operations and move the world forward.**
****Responsibilities****
**What you’ll do:**
* Own the end\-to\-end solution design for SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI) and Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA) within the L2C landscape, covering subscription and software billing, invoicing, and receivables.
* Translate subscription and software monetization requirements — recurring, usage\-based, consumption, and entitlement\-driven models — into billable item classes, rating/charging logic, invoicing rules, and revenue\-relevant postings.
* Design the integration architecture between CI/FI\-CA and upstream quoting, ordering, and provisioning systems, and downstream FI/CO, revenue recognition, tax, payment, and dunning processes.
* Define the data model and mapping for billable item transfer (BIT), invoicing document flow, contract accounts, and business partner structures across the combined HPE and Juniper portfolios.
* Lead design decisions on convergent invoicing consolidation, billing cycles, credit/rebill, adjustments, write\-offs, and dispute handling.
* Produce and maintain solution architecture artifacts: functional and technical designs, interface specifications, decision logs, and non\-functional requirements for performance and high\-volume billing runs.
* Guide offshore development and configuration teams, review build against design, and resolve design gaps raised during build, test, and HyperCare.
* Partner with business process owners, finance, tax, and IT architects to validate designs, drive design authority approvals, and manage cross\-workstream dependencies.
* Support data migration and cutover planning for open items, contract accounts, and in\-flight subscriptions, including reconciliation approach.
* Contribute to stabilization of near\-term operations while building the target\-state platform, balancing tactical fixes against long\-term architecture integrity.


****What You Need To Bring:****
**Education And Experience Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, or a related field; Master's degree an asset.
* 10\+ years of SAP experience, including 5\+ years focused on Convergent Invoicing and FI\-CA in a solution architect or lead functional design capacity.
* Demonstrated experience delivering at least two full\-lifecycle SAP CI/FI\-CA implementations, ideally on S/4HANA, including design, build, test, cutover, and post\-go\-live support.
* Hands\-on experience with subscription, software, or services monetization in a high\-volume billing environment (telco, software, or technology sector preferred).
* Experience integrating SAP billing with CPQ/CRM, order management, provisioning, and revenue recognition platforms.
* Experience working in large, multi\-year transformation programs with global, distributed onshore/offshore delivery teams.
* SAP certification in S/4HANA Finance, BRIM, or Convergent Invoicing an asset.


****Knowledge And Skills****
* Deep functional and architectural knowledge of SAP BRIM components: Convergent Invoicing, FI\-CA, Subscription Order Management, and Convergent Charging concepts.
* Strong command of FI\-CA configuration: contract accounts, business partner, main/sub transactions, payment and dunning, clearing, returns, and account balance processing.
* Working knowledge of the underlying technical layer — BIT structures, event modules, BRFplus/derivation logic, IDoc/OData/API\-based interfaces, and mass activity performance tuning.
* Solid understanding of order\-to\-cash and record\-to\-report process flows, including revenue recognition (IFRS 15/ASC 606\), tax determination, and intercompany implications.
* Ability to design for scale: high\-volume billing runs, parallel processing, archiving, and reconciliation controls.
* Strong architecture documentation and design\-authority skills; able to defend design choices to senior business and IT stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical design into business outcomes for executive audiences.
* Proven ability to work independently in an ambiguous, fast\-changing environment and to mentor functional and technical team members.
* Collaborative, pragmatic problem solver comfortable operating across time zones in a globally distributed team.
