b98ba8e1.title: VP - Employee Workplace Solutions Management
b98ba8e1.description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor**


Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

 **Job description**

**In this role, the candidate will manage the following**

* To drive the strategy of IWPB Employee Banking Solutions for the allocated market
* To acquire, maintain relationships and increase product penetration within corporates by engaging with Key Influencers, by leading a team of 14\-15 Relationship Managers to drive EBS, Credit Cards, Personal Loans, Any time Credit and Top UP Medical Health Insurance ( BAGIC)
* To ensure that the quality of the corporates acquired are in line with the strategic focus of the Bank
* To ensure the team engages with existing EBS customers to increase penetration across various digital platforms (eg Mobile X \& PIB), IVR Card activations and salary credits.
* Drive open market business (Credit Cards, Personal Loans etc) through activities/deployments, promotions \& lead based calling.
* Develop a robust, diligent and compliant sales channel
* To liaise with product and support teams on a constant basis to enhance customer offerings and service delivery
* To adhere to all regulatory guidelines and handle complaints effectively.
* Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

 **Key activities to be driven**

* Work closely with both the GB/CMB RMs and MSF Business Development Managers (BDM) to engage with key decision makers of target corporates. Actively participate in presenting the HSBC EBS proposition with the objective to empanel them for the salary proposition
* Increase penetration of the corporates employee salary accounts with HSBC in the desired customer segments (Premier, personal Bankers)
* Make corporate work site marketing activities/deployments (WSMs) more interactive and effective
* Drive the overall asset strategy of WPB within the corporate space by identifying under penetrated opportunity segments, showcasing HSBCs offering and driving growth.
* Consistent delivery of the operating plan across all key products like EBS, Personal Banking accounts, PIL Cards, Premier Accounts)
* Controlling/lowering cost of acquisition within mandated cost guidelines
* Optimizing sourcing mix to focus on profitable segments in corporates
* Ensure minimal documentation errors (KYC) by driving the Right First Time behaviour across the team


We are currently seeking a passionate and experienced professional to join our team.

**Requirements**


To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

* University level education, preferably a MBA with 10 \-15 years of experience in banking.
* Front line sales experience is must in onboarding Salary Accounts, Personal Loans, Cards will be preferred.
* Good relationship management skills in order to engage effectively with both corporates and customers.
* Highly self\-motivated and self\-disciplined with the ability to work effectively and independently

 **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*

 *As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.*

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

The Program Manager – OSAT is responsible for leading large, complex customer programs from concept through high\-volume manufacturing. **Program Leadership \& Execution**

**Customer Engagement**
* Lead customer technical and business reviews, ensuring alignment on scope, schedule, and performance.

* Manage customer escalations and ensure rapid issue resolution.

* + Factory readiness (equipment, capacity, tooling, materials)

* Ensure BOM, process flows, test programs, and quality controls are production\-ready.
  

**Cross\-Functional Coordination**
* Chair core team meetings and drive accountability across functions.
* Manage risk registers, mitigation plans, and contingency strategies.
* Partner with Industrial Engineering on line design, cycle time, and capacity modeling.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive lessons\-learned and standardization across programs.
* Support digitalization of program tracking and factory execution.
  

**Required Qualifications**  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Materials, Industrial) or related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, OSAT, or advanced packaging.
* Relevant years of experience in program/project management with direct customer ownership.
* Proven experience with:
* + New Product Introduction (NPI) and HVM ramp
	+ Assembly \& Test processes (wire bond, flip chip, WLCSP, BGA, SiP, etc.)

* + Manufacturing operations, capacity planning, and yield management
	+ Supply chain coordination and material readiness
	+ Cost modeling and program financial management

* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, or MBA.
* Experience working directly in an OSAT or IDM ATM environment.
* PMP / PgMP / PRINCE2 certification.
* Hands\-on background in:
* + Package development and reliability qualification
	+ Test engineering and product bring\-up
	+ Factory automation and MES systems

**ZEISS in India**

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports \& Cine Optics.


ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R\&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales \& Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200\+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.


Further information at ZEISS India .


The role encompasses a broad range of responsibilities aimed at delivering innovative, high\-quality software consultation solutions across hardware, software, and digital platforms:


**Portfolio Strategy \& Category Ownership in alignment with overall department structure**

* Define and own the multi\-year Consultations strategy, aligned with the company's vision care growth objectives and competitive positioning, explicitly covering In\-Store Consultation categories.
* Establish and maintain the category roadmap, covering device\-agnostic consultation workflows that guide ECPs from anamnesis and measurement inputs to the appropriate consultation pathway and product recommendation, independent of the devices connected to the digital connectivity platform.
* Build on continuous market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and voice\-of\-customer research with ECPs and retail chains to identify white spaces, emerging technology trends, portfolio gaps and unmet needs in guided, measurement\-driven consultation workflows.

**Product development oversight in alignment with overall department structure**

* Provide indirect leadership to product development teams, aligning development priorities with category strategy and working closely with the Product Development team to reinforce the product vision, ensuring portfolio investments deliver competitive, market\-ready solutions.
* Own the business requirements and commercial specifications that inform product development and engineering; represent the market perspective throughout the development lifecycle (concept through launch), ensuring clear and testable requirements are defined in close collaboration with Product Owners.
* Define business and workflow requirements that enable consultation guidance based on consumer anamnesis, device\-sourced measurement data and workflow stage, ensuring the solution can recommend the right consultation path regardless of the measurement devices used in the store.
* Serve as senior sponsor for key development programs within the refraction category, ensuring cross\-functional alignment and timely escalation of risks.
* Champion design\-for\-configurability, total cost of ownership, and regulatory strategy considerations from the earliest stages of development.
* Ensure products are designed for serviceability (ease to install, configure, upgrade), partnering with Service/Operations to incorporate field feedback early.
* Ensure products are designed to be secure, including cyber security and data privacy requirements, working with relevant security/compliance stakeholders across the lifecycle.

**Product lifecycle management in alignment with overall department structure**

* Own the full device lifecycle from concept and market entry through growth, maturity, and end\-of\-life planning.
* Define launch strategies in partnership with Marketing, Sales, and regional teams, including go\-to\-market approach, pricing, positioning, and key opinion leader engagement.
* Monitor post\-launch performance against defined KPIs (revenue, margin, market share, customer satisfaction) and drive corrective actions where needed.
* Continuously validate post\-launch whether the solution improves ECP guidance quality, consultation pathway selection, workflow consistency and consumer conversion across different device setups and store environments.
* Plan and execute product refresh, extension, and phase\-out decisions, managing inventory implications in conjunction with Supply Chain and Finance.

**Team leadership \& people management**

* Directly recruit, develop, and manage a team of Product Managers responsible for product implementation across geographies and customer segments.
* Set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, and build individual development plans that grow product management capability within the team.
* Foster a high\-performance culture grounded in customer focus, analytical rigor, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Act as an indirect leader and integrating force for the extended cross\-functional team – including product development engineers, supply chain managers, regulatory specialists, and clinical affairs – ensuring shared ownership of category outcomes.

**Cross\-functional collaboration \& stakeholder management**

* Serve as the primary interface between the Consultations category and global functions including Product Development, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Marketing, and Sales.
* Partner with device, connectivity platform, clinical, workflow and UX stakeholders to ensure measurement data from different in\-store devices can be translated into meaningful consultation guidance for ECPs.
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs to ensure all Consultation Software Solutions in the portfolio are developed and maintained in compliance with applicable requirements (FDA, EU MDR, ISO 10937, and relevant national standards).
* Collaborate with Clinical Affairs to define clinical evidence requirements and support generation of data that strengthens the clinical and commercial position of the portfolio.
* Present category strategy, portfolio performance, and investment cases to executive leadership and governance bodies.

**Education / Professional Certification**

Preferred level of education (unskilled/vocational training/bachelor/university degree); preferred Institutes if any.


* Degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical/scientific discipline; MBA or equivalent business qualification is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 7\- 10 years of progressive experience in product management, portfolio management, or category leadership within medical/ophthalmic devices or vision care.
* Proven track record owning and growing a product portfolio across the full lifecycle (sourcing, development oversight, launch and lifecycle optimization).
* Leadership experience managing Product Managers and influencing senior stakeholders in a global matrix organization.
* International launch experience across multiple geographies (e.g., EMEA, APAC, Americas) is preferred.
* Experience defining or managing digital workflow solutions that use anamnesis and measurement data to support clinical or commercial decision guidance, ideally in device\-agnostic retail or healthcare environments.

**Knowledge / Skills / Other characteristics**

* Strong analytical and financial acumen; able to build business cases, manage P\&L\-related metrics and use data to drive decisions.
* Solid understanding of regulatory pathways and quality systems relevant to ophthalmic devices (e.g., FDA 510(k), EU MDR, ISO standards; ISO 13485\).
* Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management; able to present strategy and performance to senior leadership and engage clinical stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of ECP consultation workflows, including how anamnesis, measurement data, device interoperability and workflow context can be translated into guided consultation recommendations.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset.

**Preferred experience**

* Direct experience with refraction, centration, visual acuity testing, or ophthalmic diagnostic device categories and consultation software.
* Familiarity with integrated refraction, centration workflow platforms and digital health solutions for eye care professionals.
* Familiarity with device\-agnostic data integration concepts and consultation decision\-support workflows that guide ECPs through the consumer journey from anamnesis to recommendation.
* Experience engaging with eye care professionals (ECPs), optometrists, and ophthalmologists as primary customers or stakeholders.
* International product launch experience across multiple geographies including EMEA, APAC, or Americas.
* Experience in a global matrix organization with cross\-cultural team leadership.

b91ba7ff.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Partner Solutions Architect \- (Professional Services) based in India.**
 As a Senior Partner Solutions Architect, you will join a Professional Services organization focused on helping partners deliver secure, scalable, and successful technology solutions to their customers. You’ll work directly with system integrators, resellers, and technology partners to strengthen their technical capabilities and enable them to implement solutions independently. The role combines solution architecture, technical enablement, post\-sales delivery, and strategic partner engagement. You’ll help develop scalable technical programs, guide complex implementations, and translate partner feedback into meaningful product improvements. Working across engineering, alliances, sales, and customer success, you’ll become a trusted technical advisor throughout the partner lifecycle. This is an opportunity to shape how a growing partner ecosystem delivers secure software solutions at scale while contributing to a collaborative, remote\-first environment.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Lead technical enablement programs for partners, equipping their engineering and technical teams with the knowledge and capabilities required to successfully implement and drive adoption of container and software library solutions for their customers.
* Partner closely with alliances and channel stakeholders, including Partner Account Managers, Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success Managers, to understand partner capabilities, challenges, and go\-to\-market strategies and translate these insights into joint technical and commercial initiatives.
* Develop and maintain scalable partner\-facing technical resources, including integration guides, reference architectures, implementation documentation, and best practices, enabling partners to independently deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Support post\-sales technical engagements through co\-delivery, architecture reviews, implementation guidance, and escalation support for complex customer environments.
* Serve as a primary technical liaison between partners and Product and Engineering teams, communicating partner requirements, technical challenges, and feedback to help inform product development and roadmap priorities.
* Assess partner technical competencies, identify capability gaps, and design targeted enablement programs that improve implementation readiness and delivery quality.
* Maintain partner\-level architecture documentation and systematically share lessons learned, implementation patterns, and technical best practices across internal teams and the wider partner community.
* Collaborate across functions to strengthen partner relationships, improve customer outcomes, and ensure partners are equipped to deliver consistent and exceptional experiences at scale.
* Act as a technical leader and mentor within the partner ecosystem, continuously learning from customers, partners, engineering teams, and fellow architects to solve complex technical challenges.


**Requirements**
* 4\+ years of experience in a post\-sales technical role supporting customers, preferably in partner engineering, alliances, channel solutions architecture, or a similar partner\-facing function.
* 8\+ years of experience developing high\-performance, multi\-tier applications, with strong software engineering fundamentals and a practical understanding of modern application architecture.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and containers, together with solid knowledge of software development processes, engineering practices, and software design concepts.
* Proven experience working with partner ecosystems, including system integrators, ISVs, resellers, technology alliances, or comparable organizations, with an understanding of partner go\-to\-market models.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences, ranging from partner engineers and architects to business leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to create scalable technical enablement programs, educational materials, architecture guidance, and other content designed for partner audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with intellectual curiosity, a continuous\-learning mindset, and a drive to develop practical solutions to complex technical challenges.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, alliances, sales, customer success, and external partner teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and trust with both technical and executive audiences.
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% of the time.
* Must be located in India.


**Benefits**
* Compensation: Up to INR 11,529,674 base salary, plus bonus and equity.
* Flexible, remote\-first culture with opportunities for team meetups and collaboration.
* Bi\-annual destination summits designed to bring distributed teams together.
* Monthly stipend supporting coworking spaces, phone, and internet costs.
* Stock options upon hire and promotion, with opportunities to participate in secondary offerings.
* 10\-year option exercise period for eligible stock options.
* 100% company\-paid health, vision, and dental insurance premiums for employees and dependents.
* Flexible time off to support rest, personal needs, and sustainable high performance.
* Paid parental leave: 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non\-birthing parents, with flexibility to use the leave throughout the child’s first year.
* Opportunity to work with a global partner ecosystem and contribute to secure software adoption across enterprise environments.
* Collaborative culture built around customer focus, intentional action, trust, transparency, and continuous learning.

b0fa4534.title: Senior Technical Consultant / Architect
b0fa4534.description:
Introduction
   

  

**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is a leading enterprise AI solutions provider helping retailers and manufacturers optimize business operations through advanced analytics, planning, and automation solutions. Our products support global organizations in improving supply chain efficiency, inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 We are committed to delivering measurable outcomes for our clients through innovative technology, deep domain expertise, and strong customer partnerships.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Summary
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Consultant with strong technical expertise to support the implementation of SymphonyAI SCPO solutions for global retail customers.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing role focused on US retailer rollout support, requiring close collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and implementation teams. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience across enterprise application development, integrations, middleware, databases, and cloud technologies, along with the ability to lead technical workshops, define solution architecture, and support successful implementation and go\-live activities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Discovery \& Solution Design
   

  

* Lead technical discovery sessions and workshops with customers to understand current system landscapes, integration needs, and technical requirements.
* Design scalable and secure technical solutions aligned with SymphonyAI SCPO capabilities and customer business objectives.
* Define architecture, data flows, integration patterns, and deployment approaches for implementation programs.


 Integration \& Technical Implementation
   

  

* Support end\-to\-end integration efforts across enterprise systems, planning platforms, ERP systems, and third\-party applications.
* Configure and support REST APIs, middleware, messaging systems, and data integration pipelines.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and customer IT teams to ensure successful technical implementation.


 Application Development \& Technical Support
   

  

* Provide hands\-on support across Java, Angular, .NET, shell scripting, and related technologies during implementation activities.
* Work with PL/SQL, Oracle databases, UNIX/Linux environments, and middleware platforms such as WebLogic and Glassfish.
* Support development and troubleshooting of J2EE, JSP, and web\-based application components.


 Testing, Deployment \& Go\-Live Support
   

  

* Support integration testing, defect resolution, performance validation, and production readiness activities.
* Coordinate deployment support, go\-live activities, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Proactively identify technical risks and ensure timely issue resolution.


 Documentation \& Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Create technical design documents, integration specifications, environment setup guides, and deployment documentation.
* Work closely with customer stakeholders, implementation teams, and internal engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support knowledge transfer sessions and provide technical guidance to customers and internal teams.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6\-10 years of experience in enterprise application development, technical consulting, or software implementation.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java, Angular, .NET, and bash/shell scripting.
* Experience working with PL/SQL, Oracle databases, UNIX/Linux, middleware platforms such as WebLogic and Glassfish, and web technologies including J2EE and JSP.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, system integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
* Experience supporting integration testing, go\-live, and production support activities.
* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a customer\-facing environment and manage multiple technical stakeholders effectively.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Python, Kubernetes, Data Lake technologies, Snowflake, Kafka, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Familiarity with retail planning systems, supply chain applications, or enterprise retail platforms.
* Exposure to implementation projects for US\-based retailers.
* Experience working with large\-scale data integration and distributed systems.


**About Us**
 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to work on high\-impact retail transformation programs.
* Exposure to leading global retailers and large\-scale implementation projects.
* A collaborative and fast\-paced work environment.
* Learning and growth opportunities across supply chain, retail, and enterprise AI solutions.

4281feeb.title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect
4281feeb.description:
Job Title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect
 


  

  


 Division: Assessment \& Qualifications Delivery
 


  

  


 Location: Bangalore or Chennai, India (Hybrid)
 


  

  


**Role Summary** 



  

  


 As a Solution Architect (E30\), you will design and deliver new services on Microsoft Azure aligned with Pearson’s enterprise standards. Your remit includes the development of secure, scalable solution architectures, while ensuring integration across legacy on\-premise and AWS components where needed. You will collaborate with product owners, business analysts, delivery teams (including technical architects and developers) and external partners to convert business requirements into effective technical solutions. This includes evaluating solution options, estimating costs and ensuring that designs meet both functional and non\-functional requirements (e.g. security, performance, availability, scalability). Clear communication and stakeholder engagement are essential in this role.
 


  

  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  

  
* Solution Architecture Design: Lead the design of end\-to\-end solutions on Azure (and advise on on\-premise or AWS where needed), selecting optimal services and patterns to meet both functional and non\-functional requirements. Produce architecture blueprints, dataflows and interface specifications.
  

  
* Solution Option Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Work with business analysts and product owners to evaluate multiple solution options, ensuring the trade\-offs are understood. Provide cost and effort estimations (including infrastructure, licensing and operational considerations), and help recommend solutions that balance performance, scalability and total cost of ownership.
  

  
* Technical Leadership \& Governance: Serve as design authority throughout delivery. Provide guidance, mentoring and quality assurance to delivery teams and third\-party partners. Develop and refine architectural standards where gaps exist to ensure consistent best practices.
  

  
* Support Delivery Teams: Collaborate closely with delivery teams—including technical architects, developers, testers and DevOps engineers—to interpret and implement architecture designs correctly. Assist with troubleshooting technical issues, and ensure that Technical Architects and developers share a common understanding of architecture decisions and design patterns.
  

  
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with product owners, business analysts, subject matter experts and external partners to refine requirements. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, ensuring alignment and shared understanding.
  

  
* Vendor Oversight: Work with third\-party delivery teams, reviewing their architectures, holding them accountable to Pearson’s standards and supporting them in meeting quality targets.
  

  
* Documentation \& Planning: Produce system diagrams, interface specifications and implementation roadmaps. Ensure design decisions are thoroughly documented and communicated.
  

  
* Innovation \& Continuous Improvement: Monitor industry trends and evaluate new technologies (e.g. infrastructure automation, AI, data platforms) for relevance to Pearson. Propose enhancements that support robust, modern and cost\-effective solutions.
  

  
* Compliance \& Security: Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson’s security and data privacy standards. Participate in design reviews and governance forums to ensure compliance with enterprise architecture policies.
  

  
* Lifecycle Support: Support implementation teams from development through deployment, addressing technical issues and ensuring solutions deliver the intended business value.
  


  


**Essential Experience \& Skills** 



  

  
* Extensive Solution Architecture Experience: Proven track record of designing and implementing complex enterprise solutions, with a strong emphasis on Azure cloud services and cloud\-native principles.
  

  
* Architecture \& Design Expertise: Ability to produce architecture blueprints, dataflows, integration diagrams and detailed specifications.
  

  
* Cloud Proficiency: Deep understanding of Azure compute, storage, networking, security and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g. ARM, Terraform). Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices.
  

  
* Technical Leadership \& Collaboration: Experience overseeing design implementation, defining architectural standards and providing technical guidance to teams and vendors.
  

  
* Solution Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Ability to evaluate solution options and provide well\-reasoned recommendations based on technical fit, effort and cost.
  

  
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication and interpersonal skills; able to articulate architecture rationale to technical and non\-technical stakeholders and foster alignment.
  

  
* Problem Solving \& Adaptability: Proven analytical skills and adaptability; comfortable working in dynamic environments and adjusting solutions as requirements evolve.
  

  
* Business Insight: Ability to balance technology decisions with business outcomes to ensure solutions deliver value.
  

  
* Education \& Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; Master’s degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g. BCS Intermediate Certificate in Enterprise Architecture, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are highly regarded.
  


  


**Desirable Skills** 



  

  
* Knowledge of relational databases, data modelling and data analytics solutions.
  

  
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).
  

  
* Experience with Agile methodologies, TDD and other modern development practices.
  

  
* Programming/scripting for automation (PowerShell, Python).
  

  
* Good understanding of AWS PaaS services (such as RDS/SQL, SNS, Aurora) to support integrated or legacy components.
  

  
* Understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
  

  
* Awareness of AI/ML and emerging technologies and their impact on architecture.
  


  


**Job Location and Hours** 



  

  


 The role is aligned to our Bangalore or Chennai offices in India, working a 45 hour week. All our roles are hybrid working; our current policy requires our team to work from their base office 3 times per week.
 


  

  


**Who we are:** 



  

  


 At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.
 


  

  


 Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E\-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.
 


  

  


 If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

484200a3.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title:** **Engineering Solutions Lead, VP**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Corporate Title:**

**Role Description**

* We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on **VP, Engineering Solutions Lead** to drive the design and delivery of modern, cloud\-native enterprise solutions. This role combines deep engineering expertise with solution design leadership, focusing on **API\-first architectures, microservices, cloud platforms, and AI\-driven transformation initiatives.**
* The ideal candidate will possess strong system design capabilities, extensive experience building distributed applications, and a proven track record delivering enterprise\-scale cloud and AI solutions. They will be responsible for defining technical solutions, establishing engineering standards, and guiding teams through successful implementation while remaining close to the code and technology decisions.

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy


* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your key responsibilities**

* Lead the design and development of scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise platforms and digital products.
* Define **end\-to\-end solution architecture** for complex business problems, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology standards and strategic objectives.
* Drive system design decisions across **distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architectures, API ecosystems, and cloud\-native platforms.**
* Design and review REST APIs, service contracts, integration patterns, and data models to ensure scalability, maintainability, and performance.
* Architect cloud\-native solutions leveraging modern public cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* **Lead cloud transformation** and modernization initiatives, including application migration, containerization, Kubernetes adoption, and platform engineering practices.
* Define **AI solution architectures,** including LLM integration, AI orchestration frameworks, RAG\-based solutions, intelligent automation, and AI governance considerations.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product managers, architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the software lifecycle, from architecture and design through deployment and operational support.
* Establish architecture best practices for security, observability, reliability, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Mentor engineering teams on modern architectural patterns, cloud engineering, system design, and AI adoption.

**Your skills and experience**

* 12\+ years of software engineering experience with strong expertise in designing and delivering large\-scale enterprise applications.
* Proven experience in solution architecture, system design, and building scalable distributed systems.
* Deep understanding of microservices architecture, event\-driven systems, API\-first design, and integration patterns.
* Strong experience designing and governing RESTful APIs for high\-volume enterprise environments.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, including cloud\-native architecture and deployment models.
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience designing highly available, fault\-tolerant, and performance\-optimized systems.
* Practical experience implementing AI and Generative AI solutions, including LLM integrations, RAG architectures, AI APIs, and intelligent automation use cases.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, security, governance, and compliance considerations within cloud and AI ecosystems.
* Proficiency in Java and/or Python with the ability to engage in technical design reviews and guide engineering teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to influence technical strategy across multiple teams.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, or regulated enterprise environments is highly desirable.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:


**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high\-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this \#ConnectingTheDots.

a12a2a03.title: Enterprise Architect
a12a2a03.description:
**Who We Are**
 WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
   

  

 What we want from you
   

  

* Enterprise solution architecture across multiple products, teams, operational models, and business use cases.
* Ability to design scalable frameworks for platform reliability, health monitoring, operational insights, proactive issue detection, and executive visibility.
* Strong understanding of governance architecture, including access visibility, entitlement tracking, auditability, privacy, compliance, and operational accountability.
* Ability to identify gaps between business needs, operational needs, and current product capabilities, then define practical architecture patterns or prototypes to close those gaps.
* Cross\-platform Adobe Experience Cloud understanding across AEP, RTCDP, AJO, CJA, Analytics, Workfront, GenStudio, Experience League, and related integrations.
* Ability to translate complex platform signals into meaningful KPIs, value realization metrics, leadership reporting, and decision\-ready insights.
* Strong architecture judgment to decide what should be automated, standardized, monitored, governed, or escalated to product/engineering roadmap.
* Technical fluency with data, APIs, reporting, cloud platforms, and integration patterns, without the role being limited to hands\-on pipeline engineering.
* Strong technical leadership to influence cross\-functional teams, align stakeholders, guide implementation teams, and connect platform capabilities with measurable business outcomes.


 What you’ll be doing
   

  

 We are not looking for traditional AEP DA here. We are looking for solution lead who can guide team, unblock and help R\&I take to next level. Few points to consider...
   

  

* A traditional AEP Data Architect is primarily focused on core data architecture areas such as XDM design, datasets, identity strategy, ingestion patterns, data modeling, and activation readiness within AEP.
* The R\&I Solution Architect role is broader and more outcome\-driven.
* It focuses on making Adobe on Adobe reliable, governable, observable, automated, measurable, and scalable across teams and products.
* This includes designing solutions for platform health monitoring, data quality, access governance, operational insights, value realization, automation, and proactive issue detection.
* The key difference is that R\&I is not only designing how data flows through AEP. It is designing how the overall Adobe ecosystem operates successfully at enterprise scale.
* R\&I also helps close product gaps where out\-of\-the\-box capabilities may not fully meet Customer Zero needs, while partnering closely with engineering and product teams to influence future roadmap.


 In short, the R\&I Solution Architect role combines solution architecture, operational excellence, governance, automation, observability, and business value measurement. It is a strategic architecture role that goes beyond traditional AEP data design and directly supports the success and scale.
   

  

 What we can offer you
   

  

 Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
   

  

 Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact\-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
   

  

 We lead with
 **Heart** 
 , fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human\-centric work flourish.
   

  

 We empower your
 **Brains** 
 for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
   

  

 And we champion
 **Courage** 
 , inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world\-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

 WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

**Cloud, Infrastructure \& Security Engineer** 




  





 Location: Vadodara (HQ) \| Full\-time, On\-site
 



 Experience: 2–5 years
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 Phonon is looking for a hands\-on Technical Operations Engineer to own one or more of the security, reliability, scalability and cost efficiency of our technology infrastructure.
 



  





 The role covers CloudOps, TechOps, DevOps, SecOps and FinOps, spanning our predominantly AWS\-based cloud environment, Linux/network infrastructure and SIP/VoIP telephony platforms. The role will also lead resolution of complex cloud and production support issues.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 \* Own and operate highly available, secure and scalable AWS infrastructure.
 



 \* Manage Linux, networking, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers and telephony infrastructure.
 



 \* Own Asterisk, FreePBX, OpenSIPS, SIP/RTP, SIP trunks, IVRs, diallers and hosted PBX environments.
 



 \* Drive DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, containerisation and operational automation.
 



 \* Own infrastructure security, vulnerability management, patching, IAM, hardening, backup/DR and ISO 27001 readiness.
 



 \* Establish monitoring, alerting, incident management and RCA practices.
 



 \* Drive FinOps, including AWS utilisation, rightsizing and cloud cost optimisation.
 



 \* Lead complex production incidents and cloud/infrastructure support escalations.
 



 \* Lead and mentor the Cloud/Technical Operations team.
 



  





**Technology Stack** 




  





 \* Cloud: AWS – EC2, VPC, RDS, S3, ELB/ALB, Auto Scaling, Route 53, CloudFront, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Lambda, SNS
 



 \* Linux \& Networking: RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu, TCP/IP, DNS, routing, NAT, VPN, firewalls, SSL/TLS, load balancing
 



 \* Telephony: Asterisk, FreePBX, OpenSIPS, SIP, RTP, SIP Trunking, IVR, Diallers, Hosted PBX
 



 \* DevOps: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, AWS CLI, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI/GitHub Actions
 



 \* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/EFK, Nagios, CloudWatch
 



 \* Security: IAM/RBAC, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, infrastructure hardening, ISO 27001
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




  





 \* 2\-5 years across cloud infrastructure, Linux, networking, DevOps and technical operations.
 



 \* Strong hands\-on experience managing AWS production environments.
 



 \* Strong Linux and networking fundamentals with experience operating high\-availability systems.
 



 \* Telecom/SIP/VoIP experience is strongly preferred.
 



 \* Strong troubleshooting skills across cloud → network → Linux → application → telephony.
 



 \* Experience leading technical teams and handling critical production incidents.
 



  





 Preferred Certifications: RHCE and CCNA; AWS certification is an advantage.
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **hands\-on technology operations owner** 
 who can troubleshoot critical infrastructure issues while building a secure, reliable, scalable and cost\-efficient operations function.

**Company Description**
 At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
   

  

 Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
   

  

**Job Description**
 On a day\-to\-day basis, this individual will be responsible for administrating and implementing database solutions while providing system operational support, administration, problem resolution, and perform software installations and upgrades on our database systems concentrating on Google Cloud Platform and other cloud\-based solutions (up to 30%). The Database Administrator will be expected to exhibit strong troubleshooting techniques while striving to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction. Other duties also include monitoring performance and capacity on our database systems.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
   

  

* Responsibility for all enterprise database technology deployed in the cloud including various versions of Microsoft SQL Server and other database platforms including features such as the core database engine, reporting, data loading and transformations, business intelligence, replication technologies and other modules. Perform configuration and maintenance of database platforms, including patching.
* Monitor database instances for performance, utilization, and capacity. Work with application teams when appropriate to address issues.
* Manage maintenance plans, backups, and automated jobs.
* Responsible for the database platform security model, including using Active Directory\-integrated accounts in a multi\-forest environment where appropriate.
* Responsible for query writing and optimization.
* Responsible for database schema design.
* Develop, administer, and optimize Google BigQuery datasets, tables, views, partitioning, clustering, permissions, scheduled queries, and data pipelines to support reporting, analytics, and operational workloads.
* Responsible for advising report writers and their deployment in various reporting solutions or writing reports when needed.
* Support BigQuery SQL development, performance tuning, cost optimization, data governance, access controls, and integration with Google Cloud services, business intelligence tools, and enterprise data platforms.
* Use typical database, cloud, monitoring, and DevOps tools such as Google Cloud Console, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Dataflow, Dataproc, Looker, Tableau, SQL Server Management Studio, Visual Studio Code, Git, CI/CD release tools, PowerShell, Python, and ticketing or incident management platforms.
* Apply experience with AI agents and automation tools to improve database operations, including monitoring, incident triage, knowledge retrieval, documentation generation, operational workflows, and data\-driven self\-service capabilities.
* Responsible for performing traces and profiling to analyze and troubleshoot problems.
* Determine the best way to improve performance, whether through hardware adjustments, server configuration changes, or index and query changes.
* Understanding of software development methodologies, software development lifecycle management, and working in an Agile/SCRUM environment with software development teams, providing consultative advice on database design and query optimization, including indexes.
* Familiarity with DevOps tools for managing releases.
* Familiarity with code repository tools for managing SQL objects as code with version control.
* On\-call support for after\-hours issues required. Leverage automated alerting to be notified of issues as they happen. Tune alerts to reduce noise.
* Responds to incoming phone, email, or web\-reported technical issues from internal users related to network and infrastructure, and assists in troubleshooting database issues as well as application issues for which the database may be a contributing factor.
* Identifies severity and impact and documents details in the Help Desk call tracking system.
* Performs database monitoring to ensure service level agreements are met and alerts appropriate IT staff and management of any downtime.
* Works in partnership with all IT teams to find solutions, and/or escalates issues to appropriate IT groups for resolution.
* Communicates status and updates to end users in a timely and consistent manner.
* Sets priorities for open issues and escalates issues to the correct department for resolution.
* Follows through with closure of user issues.
* Recreates problems in development environments for troubleshooting and resolution when needed.
* Creates and documents workarounds.
* Assist in training.


**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**
 The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in database administration in a cloud\-based enterprise environment, preferably across multiple versions of cloud providers using multiple database platforms.
* Administrative knowledge of Active Directory and other forms of database security
* Scripting and automation experience
* Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrated strong customer service and analytic skills
* Demonstrated ability to think through sets of complex problems, create and implement appropriate solutions
* Proven ability to establish and maintain effective professional working relationships
* Ability to think and work independently
* Ability to adapt and learn in a fast\-paced, changing environment.
* Administrative experience with at least one of Azure, Google Cloud, AWS
* Experience using or supporting AI agents, copilots, or intelligent automation solutions for database administration, cloud operations, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, or analytics use cases.
* Linux experience a plus.
* Administration experience in backup technologies that can be used to back up various database platforms. Additional experience in Disaster Recovery technologies a plus.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 10\+ Years of experience preferred spanning more than one environment
* MongoDB and other non\-Microsoft SQL Server database technologies a plus
* Data Warehousing experience a plus
* Hands\-on Google Cloud database administration experience, including BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, IAM, performance tuning, cost optimization, and data governance.
* Experience using or supporting AI agents, copilots, or intelligent automation solutions to improve database administration, cloud operations, monitoring, incident triage, documentation, analytics, and self\-service workflows.
* PowerShell scripting and automation experience a plus


 Additional Information
   

  

**Our Cultural Beliefs**
**Patient Minded** 
 I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
   

  

**Client Delight** 
 I own every client experience and its impact on results.
   

  

**Take Action** 
 I am empowered and empower others to act now.
   

  

**Grow Talent** 
 I own my development and invest in the development of others.
   

  

**Win Together** 
 I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
   

  

**Communication Matters** 
 I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
   

  

**Embrace Diversity**

**Always Innovate** 
 I am bold and creative in everything I do.
   

  

 Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e\-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
   

  

 From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

008fe3e7.title: Senior Consultant – SaaS Managed Services (Retail/CPG)
008fe3e7.description:
Introduction
   

  

 Senior Consultant \- SaaS Managed Services (Retail / CPG)
   

  

**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is a leading enterprise AI solutions provider helping retailers and manufacturers optimize business operations through advanced analytics, planning, and automation solutions. Our products support global organizations in improving supply chain efficiency, inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 We are committed to delivering measurable outcomes for our clients through innovative technology, deep domain expertise, and strong customer partnerships.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Senior Consultant to deliver Symphony GOLD SaaS managed services across a portfolio of North American grocery accounts as the managed\-services organization's — providing technical interface between US customers and the global managed\-services organization.
   

  

 The consultant concurrently serves 8\-9 US and Canadian retailers with distinct GOLD configurations. The role's structural value is the combination of account breadth, local US presence, and cross\-region coordination with global teams across time zones.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Portfolio Managed Services
   

  

* Deliver SaaS managed services across 8\-9 concurrent North American GOLD accounts as first line of technical expertise.
* Provide production support: batch monitoring, incident triage and management, complex application troubleshooting.
* Maintain per\-account configuration knowledge across the portfolio, including customer\-specific implementations.


 Presence \& Coordination
   

  

* Act as primary technical interface between US customers and the global managed\-services organization, coordinating across time zones.
* Provide local, on\-site support for critical customer escalations and build customer relationships through regular communication and technical guidance.
* Coordinate with project teams, R\&D, Cloud Operations, and customer technical teams for timely resolution.


 Technical Delivery
   

  

* Support customer upgrades, deployments, production changes, and stabilization activities.
* Perform production investigations and root\-cause analysis (Oracle SQL/PL\-SQL, Linux/shell, log analysis).


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of SaaS managed\-services experience on Symphony GOLD or an equivalent renowned, market\-established and referenceable SCM solution, on North American retail accounts, with strong functional and technical platform knowledge.
* Demonstrated concurrent coverage of 8\+ accounts with distinct configurations.
* Strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL for production investigations; good Linux and shell scripting.
* Deep understanding of SCM\-platform operational processes (Symphony GOLD or equivalent), Night Batch execution, interfaces, and customer\-specific implementations.
* Cross\-region coordination experience between customers and global delivery teams across time zones.
* Customer relationship building; incident management discipline.


**About Us**

94f94fee.title: Senior Program Manager
94f94fee.description:
**About PRAGATI** 




 Rural India is central to India's economic future, accounting for 63% of the population and 70% of the workforce. Yet a large share of rural livelihoods remains concentrated in relatively low\-productivity agriculture, creating a significant opportunity to shift towards higher\-income economic activity.
 



 PRAGATI (Programme for Rural Advancement, Growth and Transformative Initiatives) is a TCF\-incubated organisation focused on accelerating economic prosperity in rural India. Its work is centred on two priorities:
 


* Increasing agricultural incomes by addressing structural constraints across land, inputs, finance, markets, processing and trade.
* Creating scalable non\-farm livelihoods by identifying, financing and supporting promising rural enterprises that can generate local jobs.



 PRAGATI works with central ministries and state governments to combine policy and economic analysis with hands\-on implementation. It identifies high\-potential opportunities, partners with relevant government institutions, tests solutions on the ground, and develops models that governments can ultimately own and replicate.
 



 PRAGATI is also leading Amrit Prayas, a 10\-year economic development initiative in the Deoria Lok Sabha constituency. It serves as a live testbed for coordinated interventions across agriculture, agro\-processing, labour\-intensive manufacturing and other growth sectors, with the aim of developing a replicable district transformation playbook.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 PRAGATI is working with the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) to help shape the next phase of rural development — building on MoRD's strong welfare and infrastructure delivery platform to increasingly enable sustained income growth and rural prosperity. The engagement focuses on three pathways: increasing agricultural incomes, creating non\-farm local livelihood opportunities, and enabling skilling for remunerative migration.
 



 The Senior Program Manager – Rural Economic Transformation (MoRD) will lead this engagement on a day\-to\-day basis. The role combines strategy, policy and execution — identifying and structuring complex problems, conducting rigorous analysis, designing practical interventions, building alignment with government and ecosystem stakeholders, and driving initiatives through implementation. The SPM will lead a small team and work closely with senior MoRD officials, PRAGATI leadership, financial institutions, experts and private\-sector partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work with MoRD and PRAGATI leadership to identify and prioritise high\-impact opportunities for increasing rural incomes.
* Structure complex problems into clear hypotheses, analytical workstreams and actionable interventions.
* Lead research and analysis across agriculture, rural enterprise, finance, skilling and migration.
* Translate priority opportunities into practical program and policy designs, including implementation models, financing mechanisms and outcome frameworks.
* Build the economic and operational case for new initiatives and government partnerships, working with experts and ecosystem partners to refine solutions.
* Translate ministry priorities into clear workplans, owners, milestones and deliverables, and establish a strong operating rhythm across workstreams.
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks, ensuring initiatives move from concept and approval to implementation.
* Build trusted relationships with senior MoRD officials and coordinate across ministries, state governments, public institutions, financial institutions and implementation partners.
* Prepare senior\-level engagements and translate discussions into clear decisions and follow\-up actions.
* Manage and mentor the MoRD PMU team, maintaining a high bar for rigour, ownership and execution.



  





**Qualifications and Skills** 



* 8–10 years of professional experience, ideally in management consulting, strategy, transformation, public policy, economic development or a similar problem\-solving environment.
* Demonstrated ability to own complex programs end\-to\-end, from problem definition and solution design through stakeholder alignment and implementation.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and the maturity to work with senior government officials, business leaders, financial institutions and experts.
* Strong quantitative skills and comfort working across policy, strategy and implementation.
* Entrepreneurial and comfortable working in an early\-stage organisation, with a strong interest in rural economic development and government\-led transformation.
* MBA or postgraduate degree from a leading institution is preferred, but not mandatory.

633b8279.title: Sr. Program Manager, WW FBA
633b8279.description:
**Description**
 The World Wide Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team is responsible for one of the most operationally complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: ensuring the right inventory is in the right place at the right time, at the lowest possible cost, for sellers across every marketplace. Getting this right requires tight coordination across forecasting, placement, capacity, and seller behavior — and a clear line of sight into what is driving outcomes at the country level.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager who will partner closely with in\-country FBA, Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT), Retail, and Operations teams in International Emerging Stores (IES) stores to drive key FBA capacity and inventory metrics — covering areas such as inventory availability, excess/Aged inventory, and capacity. In the near term, this role is focused on building the operating mechanisms, measurement frameworks, and cross\-functional alignment needed to move these metrics. Over time, as ownership matures, this person is expected to take on deeper accountability for metric outcomes, drive programs informed by experimentation and country\-level insights, and work directly with engineering, science, and BI teams to build scalable solutions. You will need to be comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook — diagnosing problems using data you pull yourself, influencing teams you do not manage, and making decisions in the face of incomplete information. The ability to think in terms of systems, design experiments with sellers, and approach problems with an AI\-first mindset will be critical to succeeding in this role and growing it over time.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with in\-country FBA, Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT), Retail, and Operations teams to drive key FBA inventory metrics taking progressively deeper ownership of outcomes over time.
* Build and maintain root\-cause attribution frameworks that connect upstream inputs (forecasting gaps, inbound defects, seller restock adoption, FC constraints) to downstream metric outcomes, enabling clear and consistent diagnosis across teams.
* Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly review mechanisms for your metric areas, representing FBA in Country Business reviews (weekly/monthly/quarterly) forums and ensuring that system\-driven insights are correctly communicated and acted upon.
* Design and run structured experiments with sellers \- adoption levers, communication treatments, and incentive mechanisms, etc. and use findings to build evidence\-based initiatives.
* Work with Product, science, and BI teams to translate operational insights and experiment results into scalable product improvements; identify IES\-specific requirements and ensure they are reflected in WW roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve how metrics are tracked, root causes are diagnosed, and corrective actions are triggered.
* Coordinate peak readiness (Prime Day, Black Friday/Cyber Monday (BFCM) by identifying inventory risks early, stress\-testing operational workflows, and working with partner teams on mitigation plans.
* Serve as the connective tissue between WW FBA and in\-country stakeholders — validating hypotheses, surfacing local edge cases, supporting system rollouts, consolidating country\-specific inputs for OP1/OP2, and ensuring smooth knowledge transfer in both directions


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* MBA or Master's degree in a quantitative or technical field
* 8\+ years experience in program management, supply chain analytics, business operations, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience owning business metrics end\-to\-end — defining measurement frameworks, diagnosing root causes, and leading cross\-functional teams to drive improvement
* Proficiency in SQL or equivalent querying tools to independently extract, analyze, and communicate operational insights without relying on a dedicated analytics resource
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing and presenting structured reviews to senior leadership
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment across teams you do not directly manage, in ambiguous or evolving organizational contexts
* Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation tools to redesign an analytical or operational workflow — not just familiarity with the concepts


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in inventory and capacity planning, or supply chain operations; or equivalent experience in marketplace or platform supply chain, or seller/vendor\-facing operations at scale
* Experience working in or closely with non\-US Amazon stores (EU, JP, IN)
* Demonstrated ability to build operating mechanisms from scratch — metric definitions, attribution frameworks, review cadences — in an environment without established playbooks


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. 16d037a6.title: Senior Customer Solution Architect
16d037a6.description:
**Introduction**
 At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you’ll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co\-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You’ll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world\-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that’s passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer to join our Customer Success and Professional Services team. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will help customers leverage streaming architectures and applications to achieve their business results. In this role, you will interact directly with customers to provide software architecture, design, and operations expertise that leverages your deep knowledge of and experience in Apache Kafka platform, and complementary systems such as Hadoop, Spark, Storm, relational and NoSQL databases. You will develop and advocate best practices, gather and validate critical product feedback, and help customers overcome their operational challenges. Throughout all these interactions, you will build a strong relationship with your customer in a very short space of time, ensuring exemplary delivery standards. You will also have the opportunity to help customers build state\-of\-the\-art streaming data infrastructure, in partnership with colleagues who are widely recognized as industry leaders, as well as optimizing and debugging customers’ existing deployments.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Helping a customer determine their platform and/or application strategy for moving to a more real\-time, event\-based business. Such engagements often involve remote preparation; presenting an onsite or remote workshop for the customer’s architects, developers, and operations teams; investigating (with Engineering and other coworkers) solutions to difficult challenges; and writing a recommendations summary doc.
* Providing feedback to the Product and Engineering groups
* Building tooling for another team or the wider company to help us push our technical boundaries and improve our ability to deliver consistently with high quality
* Testing performance and functionality of new components developed by Engineering
* Writing or editing documentation and knowledge base articles, including reference architecture materials and design patterns based on customer experiences
* Honing your skills, building applications, or trying out new product features
* Participating in community and industry events


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
 Deep experience designing, building, and operating in\-production Big Data, stream processing, and/or enterprise data integration solutions, ideally using Apache Kafka
   

  

* Demonstrated experience successfully managing multiple B2B infrastructure software development projects, including driving expansion, customer satisfaction, feature adoption, and retention
* Experience operating Linux (configure, tune, and troubleshoot both RedHat and Debian\-based distributions) Experience using cloud providers (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) for running high\-throughput systems
* Experience with Java Virtual Machine (JVM) tuning and troubleshooting
* Experience with distributed systems (Kafka, Hadoop, Cassandra, etc.)
* Strong desire to tackle hard technical problems, and proven ability to do so with little or no direct daily supervision
* Excellent communication skills, with an ability to clearly and concisely explain tricky issues and complex solutions


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Ability and willingness to travel up to 20% of the time to meet with customers

de8ec405.title: Presales Consultant / Solutioning Lead - Mining (Engineering Services)
de8ec405.description:
**Role Overview** 




 Senior Manager Presales acts as the bridge between customer business challenges and the technical solutions that address them. This role is responsible for driving solution strategy, shaping customer engagements, developing compelling proposals, and positioning value\-driven engineering services solutions within the Mining \& Energy industry.
 



 The Presales Consultant will partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Domain SMEs, and Solution Architects to understand customer requirements, identify business drivers, and create differentiated solutions that align with customers' operational and strategic objectives.
 



 This role requires a strong combination of industry expertise, solutioning capability, proposal management experience, commercial acumen, and executive\-level stakeholder engagement skills.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Customer Engagement \& Discovery** 



* Engage with prospective customers to understand business objectives, operational challenges, and transformation priorities.
* Lead customer discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and solution discussions.
* Analyze customer pain points and translate them into solution opportunities.
* Build trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders, including engineering, operations, digital, and executive leadership teams.



**Solution Development \& Architecture** 



* Develop end\-to\-end solution strategies aligned with customer business outcomes.
* Collaborate with solution architects, technical SMEs, delivery teams, and business units to create winning solutions.
* Design innovative service offerings across:
* Engineering Services
* Digital Engineering
* Asset Management
* Smart Mining
* Energy Transition Solutions
* Plant Engineering
* Industrial Automation
* AI/Analytics Applications
* Remote Operations Centers
* Sustainability and ESG initiatives

* Lead end\-to\-end proposal development activities for RFP, RFQ, RFI, and bid responses.
