* Develop executive summaries, solution narratives, value propositions, assumptions, effort estimations, and pricing inputs.
* Own proposal governance, compliance requirements, and submission timelines.
* Ensure proposals clearly map customer requirements to organizational capabilities and differentiators.



**Commercial \& Financial Analysis** 



* Develop business cases supporting proposed solutions.
* Perform:
* ROI Analysis
* Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Analysis
* Cost Modeling
* Pricing Strategy Development
* Risk Evaluation
* Support leadership teams with Go/No\-Go assessments and opportunity qualification.



**Sales Support \& Deal Enablement** 



* Partner with Sales teams throughout the opportunity lifecycle.
* Support customer presentations, solution walkthroughs, and executive briefings.
* Participate in customer negotiations and commercial discussions where required.
* Create persuasive collateral including:
* Solution Presentations
* Capability Decks
* Case Studies
* Value Propositions
* Competitive Positioning Documents



**Market Intelligence \& Practice Development** 



* Track industry trends across Mining and Energy sectors.
* Analyze competitor offerings and develop strategic differentiators.
* Contribute to reusable solution assets, proposal repositories, accelerators, and best practices.
* Support creation of industry\-focused go\-to\-market strategies and offerings.



**Required Experience and Personal Attributes** 



* 12\-16 years of Presales, Solutioning, Bid Management, Proposal Development, or Consulting experience.
* Strong experience supporting Mining in Engineering Services environments.
* Proven experience in responding to large\-scale RFPs/RFIs/RFQs.
* Experience in creating solution architectures and transformation roadmaps.
* Demonstrated success in supporting large strategic pursuits and revenue growth initiatives.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams and global customers.



**Domain Knowledge** 




 Strong understanding of one or more of the following:
 



 Mining
 


* Mine Planning \& Operations
* Asset Performance Management
* Autonomous Mining Technologies
* Mineral Processing
* Operational Excellence Programs
* Mine Digitization



 Energy

* Power Generation

* Plant Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electrical Systems
* Instrumentation \& Control
* Product Engineering
* Digital Engineering
* Industrial IoT
* AI \& Analytics Applications



 Desired Skills \& Competencies
 



 Business Skills
 


* Consultative Selling
* Strategic Thinking
* Customer Engagement
* Stakeholder Management
* Executive Communication
* Negotiation Skills
* Commercial Awareness



 Presales Skills
 


* Solution Design
* Proposal Management
* Bid Coordination
* Estimation and Pricing
* Value Engineering
* Business Case Development
* Workshop Facilitation



 Technical Skills
 


* Engineering Services Solutioning
* Digital Transformation
* Industrial Automation
* Cloud and Data Platforms

* AI/ML and Analytics Concepts

24bbf228.title: Presales Manager (Retail)
24bbf228.description:
We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on
 **Presales Manager (Retail)** 
 to front\-end the organization's Presales function across service lines, business units and customer segments. The role requires a strong IT Services background, end\-to\-end presales ownership, excellent communication skills and the ability to work closely with Sales, Delivery, Technology and Leadership teams to convert business opportunities into compelling, solution\-led proposals. The ideal candidate should bring strong Retail domain understanding and should be comfortable engaging with global enterprise customers, leading discovery discussions, shaping solution narratives, preparing proposals, coordinating estimates and presenting to senior stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Presales Ownership: Own the complete presales lifecycle from opportunity qualification to proposal submission and deal closure support.
* Partner with Sales teams to understand customer requirements, business objectives, pain points, and transformation priorities.
* Lead discovery sessions, customer workshops, solution walkthroughs, and executive presentations.
* Prepare compelling proposals, solution documents, RFI/RFP/RFQ responses, capability decks and executive presentations.
* Develop win themes, differentiators, solution positioning and value propositions aligned to customer priorities.
* Drive internal pursuit reviews and ensure alignment across Sales, Delivery, Technology and Leadership stakeholders.
* Solution Development and Consulting: Translate customer business problems into technology\-led solutions and engagement models.
* Work with technical SMEs, architects and delivery teams to define solution approach, delivery methodology and implementation roadmap.
* Create solution narratives that clearly articulate business value, delivery approach, risks, assumptions and expected outcomes.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, commercially viable, deliverable, and aligned with organizational capabilities.
* Support proactive proposal development and strategic account planning initiatives.
* Estimation, Pricing and Commercial Support: Coordinate effort estimation activities with Delivery, Engineering, QA, Data, Cloud, UX and other relevant teams.
* Support preparation of commercial models for Fixed Price, Time and Material, Managed Services, Dedicated Team and Outcome\-based engagements.
* Capture assumptions, dependencies, risk factors, staffing models and delivery milestones for proposal submissions.
* Support commercial discussions by providing inputs on scope, effort, delivery approach and solution value.
* Retail Domain Contribution: Apply Retail domain knowledge to create business\-relevant solutions for enterprise customers.
* Support opportunities across omnichannel retail, digital commerce, store operations, merchandising, customer experience, loyalty, inventory, fulfilment, supply chain, data analytics and AI\-led transformation.
* Understand how retail business processes connect with technology platforms, operating models and transformation programs.
* Contribute domain insights during customer conversations, solutioning workshops and proposal development.
* Presales Enablement Across the Organization: Act as the front\-end owner for presales activities across the organization, supporting multiple teams and opportunity types.
* Develop reusable presales assets, templates, case studies, capability presentations, solution frameworks and proposal libraries.
* Improve presales processes, governance, pursuit quality, proposal consistency and response timelines.
* Enable Sales and Delivery teams with sharper messaging, stronger positioning and customer\-ready collateral.


**Required Experience**
* Around 10 years of hands\-on presales experience in an IT Services environment.
* BE/BTech \+ MBA from a premium institute.
* Strong end\-to\-end presales exposure including opportunity qualification, requirement understanding, solutioning, proposal development, estimation coordination, pricing support and customer presentation.
* Must have worked in core IT Services organizations with exposure to enterprise customers and multi\-stakeholder pursuits.
* Strong Retail domain experience is mandatory.
* Experience supporting global customers across regions such as North America, Europe, Middle East or APAC is preferred.
* Experience working on medium to large\-sized deals, strategic pursuits and transformation\-led proposals is preferred.
* Core Skills and Expected Capability: Presales RFI/RFP/RFQ management, bid management, proposal writing, solution documentation, win themes, and value proposition development.
* Solutioning ability to translate business needs into practical technology solutions, delivery approaches, roadmaps, and commercial models.
* Retail domain expertise with strong understanding of retail operations, digital commerce, omnichannel, store systems, merchandising, loyalty, inventory, supply chain and customer experience.
* Commercial Acumen: Exposure to estimation, pricing, assumptions, dependencies, effort models and deal structuring.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, storytelling, executive presentations, and customer\-facing confidence.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to work with Sales, Delivery, Technology, Leadership and customer stakeholders in a matrix environment.

b9b567e0.title: Principal - Solution Engineering
b9b567e0.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of "solutions" that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  





**There's another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**




 Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost\-to\-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise\-grade yet easy\-to\-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
   

  





**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**



**Job Description**

 As a GSI Solution Architect, you will be the technical and solution engine behind our Global Systems Integrator ecosystem, with a dedicated focus on Employee Experience and Freshservice.
   

  





 You will help GSI partners find, shape, and progress new business and expansion opportunities — bringing solution credibility to early conversations, turning employee service challenges into structured opportunities, and building the assets and capability that let partners eventually run these motions themselves.
   

  





 You will work day\-to\-day with two Business Development colleagues and our GSI Partner Managers, and partner closely with Sales, Solution Engineering, Product, and Professional Services. This is a commercially aligned role — you will be measured on partner\-sourced ARR — but it is not a pure sales role. Solution leadership, partner enablement, and technical credibility are the core of the job.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Work with GSI partners to identify and shape new Freshservice opportunities linked to employee service transformation.
* Support early\-stage discovery with partner teams and end customers, translating service challenges into structured solution opportunities.
* Build solution narratives across ITSM modernisation, employee self\-service, workflow automation, knowledge management, and legacy ITSM migration.
* Identify where existing EX or ITSM footprints can expand into broader Enterprise Service Management — HR, Finance, Facilities, Legal, Procurement, Security, and Operations.
* Position AI as a practical accelerator: self\-service, ticket deflection, agent assist, knowledge discovery, and automation.
* Equip our two Business Development colleagues with messaging, discovery questions, and qualification guides, and join calls where solution credibility is needed.
* Deliver enablement sessions for GSI sales, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams, and support their certification and readiness.
* Create reusable assets — demo flows, reference architectures, discovery guides, and partner playbooks — that scale beyond any single deal.
* Support partner account planning and contribute to the quality and conversion of partner\-sourced pipeline.


**Qualifications**

**Required**



* Experience in solution architecture, presales, consulting, or partner solution engineering.
* Strong understanding of Employee Experience, ITSM, ESM, service desk modernisation, and internal service delivery.
* Experience working with GSIs, systems integrators, consulting firms, or other partner\-led business models.
* Ability to build EX, ESM, and AI solution narratives, and to support both new business and expansion motions.
* Understanding of AI use cases in service management — self\-service, agent assist, automation, knowledge, and ticket deflection.
* Experience creating demos, discovery guides, enablement content, and reference architectures.
* Comfortable being commercially aligned to partner\-sourced ARR.
* Strong stakeholder management across partner, sales, product, and technical teams, with excellent communication and presentation skills.



**Preferred**



* Experience with Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC, Ivanti, ManageEngine, or similar ITSM/ESM platforms.
* Experience supporting partner\-sourced or partner\-influenced revenue motions, or GSI\-led transformation programmes.
* Experience working with Indian or global GSI partners.
* Familiarity with ITIL, workflow automation, and internal service operations.
* Ability to build business cases, value propositions, and repeatable go\-to\-market plays.
* Experience supporting migrations from legacy ITSM platforms.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

14c9c5ae.title: Solutions Engineer - Pune
14c9c5ae.description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope
   

  

 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade\-offs.
   

  

 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.
   

  

 Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

This is an amazing opportunity for the sales professional who has a history of completely dominating their territory and who wants to make an impact on building the next iconic cloud security company.
   

  

 You will work closely with customers and partners as your primary point of contact for feedback and resolution of issues and will be the customers’ advocate for issues that require assistance from the HQ Support team. You will provide feedback to the Product Management team on new feature requests and product enhancements from your customer base. Heavy travel within the territory is required and as necessary to support other company\-based engagements within the US.
   

  

 This is a highly impactful role – You will have a compelling opportunity to impact the business and advance your career.
   

  

**Responsibilities include:**

* Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills ranging from tech level up to senior executives. Comfortable in public speaking and presenting to both internal and external executive audiences.
* Ability to scale from the whiteboard to working with security architects to influencing CISOs.
* Love and passion for helping customers and delivering satisfaction even when faced with difficult customers.
* Demonstrable experience with systems installation, configuration and administration Linux, MacOS and Windows\-based systems
* Proficient in mobile device technologies (MDM/MAM) and OS such as Android and iOS
* Knowledge of certificates, key management systems, HSM and related protocols
* Proven hands\-on experience with information security solutions such as Web Proxy, NGFW, Security Gateways, working with remote access and site to site VPN technologies, SAML/SSO, DLP, Data security and understand but also write regex expressions
* Experience working with Cloud Identity Providers, SCIM, SIEM, SOAR, EDR and SD\-WAN Deployments and Integrations
* Experience working with Active Directory Services including ADFS, working knowledge of Azure AD is desired
* Experience working with Public cloud environments (AWS, Azure and GCP)
* Working knowledge of the broader threat landscape and the ability to distill technology trends, and explain complex behaviors in simple terms
* Travel \- within region. Experience working in and selling cloud\-based technologies (SaaS, IaaS, and PaaS).


 Desire:

* Strong security skills that would include hands\-on experience with Bluecoat, Symantec, McAfee, Checkpoint, Cisco, Juniper along with other appropriate certifications (e.g. CISSP, CCSK, CCSP, CCSE, GCFW, PCNSE, JNCIS\-SEC/JNCIP\-ENT, GCIH, etc).

**Education**

 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

 Collaborate with product roadmap teams, R\&D, and engineering to translate market needs into platform features.
   

  

 Provide continuous feedback to improve solutions, architecture patterns, and product capabilities.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

 Architecture design (cloud/on\-prem), microservices, containerization, high\-availability and DR setups.
   

  

 Performance tuning, capacity estimation, and infra planning for high\-volume financial transactions.
   

  

 Strong understanding of digital payments, wallets, mobile money, merchant acquiring, lending platforms, KYC/AML, fraud systems, and transaction processing.
   

  

 Experience with financial protocols and integrations — ISO 8583, ISO 20022, REST/JSON APIs, SOAP, SFTP, OAuth2, JWT, Webhooks.
   

  

 Knowledge of financial compliance, risk controls, settlement processes, reconciliation, and transaction dispute flows.
   

  

 Experience with AI/ML and automation in financial use cases (fraud detection, credit prediction, operational optimization).

 Strong consultative and customer\-facing capabilities.
   

  

 Financial acumen to understand revenue models, pricing, ROI, and commercial impact.
   

  

 Ability to mentor, guide teams, and collaborate across multi\-functional units.
   

  

 Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and negotiation skills.

09c08a73.title: Azure Platform SME — Solutioning & Pre-Sales
09c08a73.description:
**Role Summary**
 Avanade India’s Cloud \& Infrastructure practice is looking for an Azure Platform SME who can sit in front of a customer, understand their landscape, ask the right questions and shape the solution — then design and build it. This is a pre\-sales\-led role with real technical depth: the same person runs the discovery conversation, proposes the architecture, prepares the estimate and proposal, and stays hands\-on enough to design and provision the environment.
   

  

 We are looking for someone whose strength is consultative rather than order\-taking. Much of the value in this role comes before any design is written — in asking the questions that surface the customer’s constraints, dependencies and real drivers, and in proposing an approach that fits their landscape rather than a standard template.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead customer discovery discussions and workshops — understand the current landscape across on\-premises and cloud estate, applications, infrastructure, network, identity, security, operations and existing commitments.
* Ask structured, probing questions to surface business drivers, constraints, dependencies, compliance requirements, timelines and success criteria — and identify what the customer has not said as much as what they have.
* Translate discovery findings into a proposed Azure solution — target architecture, options with clear trade\-offs (cost, risk, effort, timeline), phasing and a recommended approach.
* Present and defend the proposed solution to customer stakeholders, from technical teams through to IT and business leadership, and adapt the pitch to the audience in the room.
* Prepare proposals and pre\-sales collateral end to end — solution write\-ups, architecture diagrams, bill of materials, assumptions, dependencies, risks, scope boundaries and SOW inputs.
* Own effort and cost estimation — Azure consumption sizing and pricing, resource\-level estimates, licensing considerations, and services effort estimates with clear assumptions behind the numbers.
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs and customer questionnaires, working with sales, delivery and practice leadership to build a coherent and competitive response.
* Design Azure platform architecture: subscription and environment strategy, landing zone, networking and connectivity, identity, security baselines, governance, monitoring, backup and DR.
* Provision, configure and validate Azure resources hands\-on — building POCs, pilots and initial environments to prove the solution and de\-risk delivery.
* Shape migration approaches for customer workloads — assessment, sizing, wave planning, migration method and cutover considerations.
* Hand over cleanly to delivery teams and remain available as design authority — design reviews, escalation support and architecture governance through the engagement.
* Build reusable pre\-sales assets: reference architectures, solution templates, estimation models, proposal boilerplate and discovery question sets that shorten future pursuits.
* Engage Microsoft and partner stakeholders on joint pursuits, funding programmes and co\-sell motions where applicable.
* Mentor junior architects and pre\-sales consultants, and raise the quality bar on solution and proposal work across the practice.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8–11 years of overall experience in cloud solution architecture, infrastructure or cloud pre\-sales, with a strong recent focus on Microsoft Azure.
* Solid Azure platform knowledge across the core stack: compute, storage, networking, identity, security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, and the platform services commonly used by enterprise workloads.
* Proven customer\-facing solutioning experience — running discovery discussions and workshops, understanding a customer landscape quickly, and proposing an appropriate solution rather than a generic one.
* Strong questioning and listening skills, with the judgement to challenge assumptions constructively and to identify gaps, risks and dependencies early.
* Hands\-on experience designing and provisioning Azure resources — able to build and configure environments personally, not only produce diagrams.
* Demonstrated pre\-sales track record: proposals, solution write\-ups, bill of materials, RFP/RFI responses and client\-facing presentations.
* Strong estimation capability — Azure sizing and cost estimation, effort estimation for services, and the discipline to document assumptions, exclusions and risks clearly.
* Experience designing Azure landing zones and migration approaches for enterprise customers.
* Azure networking depth: hub\-and\-spoke topologies, ExpressRoute and VPN, NSGs/UDRs, firewalling and routing, Private Link and DNS design.
* Working knowledge of Azure identity and security: Entra ID and hybrid identity, RBAC, conditional access, Key Vault and Defender for Cloud.
* Ability to produce clear, well\-structured architecture and proposal documentation (HLD, solution overview, migration plan) at client\-ready quality.
* Scripting capability in PowerShell and/or CLI for provisioning, configuration and operational tasks.
* Confident communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to hold a room of senior customer stakeholders.


**Preferred / Good To Have**
* Infrastructure as Code experience — Terraform, Bicep or ARM templates — and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. Good to have, not essential; willingness to build this depth is expected.
* Microsoft certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\), Azure Administrator (AZ\-104\), Azure Network Engineer (AZ\-700\), or security certifications such as SC\-100 / SC\-200\.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Intune/EMS and endpoint management as part of an integrated customer estate.
* Experience with Microsoft partner programmes — partner capability alignment, specialization readiness, Microsoft field engagement or distributor GTM.
* AWS or GCP exposure for multi\-cloud positioning and comparative solutioning.
* Familiarity with Azure AI and data services (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric) and how those workloads land on a governed platform.
* FinOps awareness — cost optimisation, right\-sizing and ongoing consumption management.
* Experience in regulated or compliance\-heavy environments (BFSI, healthcare, energy, public sector), including data residency requirements.
* Experience in a global delivery / SI or Microsoft partner environment working with distributed teams.
* Prior contribution to reusable accelerators, reference architectures or practice\-building initiatives.

**Job Summary**
 Responsible for the management, operations, delivery and support of defined IT applications and/or infrastructure services; directs and coordinates the efforts of people to accomplish goals and objectives using available resources.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Contributes to the delivery and support of specific IT services. Supports the development and maintenance of services and ensures that tools and resources are capable and available (i.e. IT Service Catalog, Asset Management system) Generates and reports service delivery metrics and drives standards across regions and locations (i.e. Scorecards, Service Level Agreement (SLAs) and Customer Satisfaction or Net Promoter Scoring). Acts as a point of contact for customers for service related inquiries and maintains relationships with key customers and suppliers. Is familiar with SLA / Operational Level Agreements between other IT Services Provided. Encourages root cause analysis using the formal problem solving approach for recurring issues. Champions the use of Six Sigma to reduce costs and improve processes. Identifies opportunities for service improvements, discuss with the customer and raise the request for change for assessment if appropriate Maintains the accuracy of service related standards, procedures and work instructions in a knowledge management system. Able to support the Service Owner when needed. Champions the use of ITIL Standards for IT Service Deliverables Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Financial acumen \- Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.
   

  

 Balances stakeholders \- Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.
   

  

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Global perspective \- Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
   

  

 IT Supplier Relationships \- Leverages a vendor management framework to manage strategic supplier relationships and supplier performance based on business need throughout the contract life using the required processes and tools to control costs, drive service excellence, mitigate risks, and gain increased value from the suppliers.
   

  

 Request Fulfillment \- Manages a service request through its life cycle with efficiency and professionalism using the required processes and tools to maintain customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Service Asset and Configuration Management \- Manages service assets and configuration items by maintaining accurate configuration records to support other service management processes with documented and verifiable information.
   

  

 Service Catalog Management \- Maintains a service catalog that contains all details of active and approved services in service operations using the required processes and tools to provide clear and relevant information to users.
   

  

 Service Level Management \- Ensures the quality of the services delivered meet agreed levels using the required processes and tools in order to maintain customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Troubleshooting \- Diagnoses and resolves the customer\-identified issue by utilizing appropriate department standards to satisfy customer expectations.
   

  

 Problem Solving \- Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 5\+ years of experience.

c09873a2.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
c09873a2.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all\-remote R\&D PMO team, you will own complex, end\-to\-end programs that are central to our AI\-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high\-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next\-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment.
   

  

**Some Examples Of Our Projects**
* Leading the GitLab Duo Agent Platform from GA through enterprise adoption, including customer onboarding, support models, and billing integration for AI\-driven capabilities
* Delivering data\-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities
* Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
* Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry\-leading DevSecOps standards


**What You Will Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs
* Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates
* Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
* Partner with customer success and cross\-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
* Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation


**What You Will Bring**
* Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption
* Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity within extreme ambiguity
* Strong background in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps technology companies, with ability to quickly master the GitLab platform and AI/ML initiatives
* Proven experience influencing and driving impact at a division and company\-wide scale, affecting market position and revenue
* Excellence in cross\-functional leadership, with experience partnering with engineering, product, security teams and engaging effectively with senior and C\-level stakeholders
* Outstanding communication skills, including asynchronous collaboration, executive reporting, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business impact
* Track record of success in fast\-paced, dynamic environments with evolving technical requirements and market opportunities
* Strong facilitation and influence skills, with ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups while building trust through transparency and delivery excellence
* Expertise in high\-level stakeholder management, including masterful communication with Executive Boards and enterprise Customers
* Collaborative leadership style aligned with GitLab's values, including respect, openness to feedback, and commitment to team success
* Proven track record of redefining organizational operations and serving as an escalation point to resolve highly complex, enterprise\-level challenges
* Welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with consulting, enterprise technology, or technical leadership experience who have owned outcomes and delivered transformational initiatives
* Ability to act as a visionary leader, shaping R\&D direction and fostering technical excellence across the organization


**About the team:** 
 The Technical Program Management team sits within GitLab's R\&D Program Management Office and drives product, engineering, data, and security initiatives across our AI\-powered DevSecOps platform. You will join our growing, distributed team of Technical Program Managers currently spanning North America and Europe. We own the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, cross\-functional programs including AI platform capabilities, enterprise customer initiatives, and strategic technology transformations. As an all\-remote team, we excel at asynchronous communication to coordinate across time zones while partnering closely with executive leaders and stakeholders to deliver business\-critical outcomes.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. **Job Description** 




 Technical Program Manager – AWS \& AI\-First Engineering Delivery
 



*Level: Senior Program Management (12–15 years)* 




  





**Technical Program Manager – AWS \& AI\-First Engineering Delivery** 




**Location:** 
 Offshore (Hyderabad, India) – Hybrid
 



**Experience:** 
 12–15 years
 



**Scope:** 
 AWS, Distributed Systems Engineering, Data/BI \& Integration (AWS Glue, Power BI, Message Broker/ACE), Cloud DevOps, AI\-First Engineering Delivery
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead delivery across the engineering teams supporting our health plan technology platform, spanning software engineering (Junior through Architect levels, working in Go, Python, Node.js, and AWS\-based distributed systems), Data \& Integration Engineering (AWS Glue, Power BI, Message Broker/ACE), and DevOps \& Cloud Engineering (AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS/OpenShift). This is a techno\-functional leadership role: you will own the program plan, translate customer and business requirements into clear technical direction, and track delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams and onshore/offshore teams. Just as important, you will be the driving force behind an AI\-first mindset across every team and every solution, setting the expectation that AI\-assisted engineering is the default way of working, not an exception.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end program and project delivery across engineering teams spanning software engineering, data/BI \& integration engineering, and DevOps/cloud engineering
* Partner directly with customer and business stakeholders to understand business priorities, constraints, and success criteria within the health insurance/payer domain
* Translate business and customer requirements into clear technical requirements, epics, and stories, ensuring shared understanding across product, architecture, and delivery teams
* Build, maintain, and track detailed program plans, schedules, dependencies, RAID logs, and status reporting across all workstreams
* Drive sprint/iteration planning, backlog grooming, and delivery governance (Agile/Scrum/Kanban) across distributed onshore/offshore teams
* Champion and drive an AI\-first engineering mindset across all teams, ensuring AI\-assisted coding, testing, documentation, and operations practices are adopted consistently across every solution delivered
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to accelerate delivery, improve quality, or reduce operational cost, and drive adoption plans together with engineering and architecture leads
* Manage cross\-team dependencies across software engineering, data/BI/integration, and DevOps/cloud engineering roles, proactively resolving blockers
* Own stakeholder communication: executive status updates, steering committee reporting, and risk/issue escalation
* Partner with architects on technical roadmap alignment with business priorities
* Ensure delivery quality, compliance, and security requirements, including HIPAA\-aware practices, are embedded into program execution
* Mentor and guide engineering leads on program management fundamentals and on driving AI\-first delivery within their teams



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; PMP, PMI\-ACP, CSM, or SAFe certification is a plus
* 12–15 years of experience in technical program or project management, including delivery of complex, multi\-team software engineering programs
* Strong working knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture concepts, sufficient to engage credibly with engineering and architecture teams on technical trade\-offs
* Proven experience managing programs spanning distributed systems/backend engineering, data engineering/BI, and DevOps/cloud engineering disciplines
* Strong command of program/project management tools and methodologies (Agile/Scrum/Kanban, JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, or similar), including building and tracking project plans, RAID logs, and status reports
* Demonstrated ability to understand customer and business context and translate business requirements into actionable technical direction for engineering teams
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to track progress, surface risks early, and drive resolution across multiple concurrent workstreams
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience presenting to senior stakeholders and clients
* Experience managing and coordinating distributed onshore/offshore delivery teams
* Strong stakeholder management skills across business, engineering, and executive audiences



**AI\-First Leadership (Required)** 



* A genuine AI\-first mindset: able to identify, champion, and drive adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices (AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, AI\-assisted testing and documentation) across every team and every solution under their management
* Practical, hands\-on familiarity with AI coding/assistant tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar), sufficient to credibly set expectations and coach teams on effective, responsible usage
* Able to define and track AI\-adoption goals and metrics across engineering teams (e.g., proportion of AI\-assisted work, cycle\-time improvement, quality impact) as part of program governance
* Understanding of responsible and compliant AI usage in a health\-insurance context, including data\-privacy safeguards such as never exposing PHI or sensitive member/client data to external AI tools, and the ability to enforce these standards across teams
* Able to evaluate where AI can be applied across the full solution lifecycle, requirements analysis, design, coding, testing, documentation, and operations, and build these expectations into program plans
* Comfortable partnering with architects and engineering leads to embed AI\-first practices into technical roadmaps and solution designs



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in the US health insurance or payer domain: claims, eligibility, enrollment, provider/member data, and HIPAA\-aware program delivery
* Experience managing programs supporting health plan clients in a consulting or professional services environment
* Familiarity with the specific technologies used by the teams under management: Go, Python, Node.js, AWS EKS/OpenShift, AWS Glue, Power BI, IBM Message Broker/ACE, and cloud DevOps toolchains (Terraform, CI/CD)
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate)
* Experience establishing AI governance frameworks or an AI center\-of\-excellence function within an engineering organization

**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

 As a Sr Technical Program Manager, you will drive end\-to\-end program delivery, Agile transformation, and cross\-functional alignment across multiple teams and workstreams. This role requires strong execution leadership, deep SAFe expertise, and the ability to influence stakeholders while ensuring predictable, high\-quality delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead end\-to\-end program management for large\-scale, complex product development initiatives.
   

  

 Act as Lead Technical Program Manager / Release Train Engineer (RTE), driving execution across multiple Agile teams and workstreams.
   

  

 Facilitate and govern SAFe ceremonies (PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, Inspect \& Adapt, retrospectives), ensuring alignment and delivery predictability.
   

  

 Implement and strengthen Scaled Agile (SAFe) and Agile best practices, driving consistency across teams.
   

  

 Drive program\-level planning, execution, and delivery across scope, schedule, quality, and cost.
   

  

 Establish and track program metrics and KPIs (e.g., velocity, predictability, defect trends) to drive continuous improvement.
   

  

 Provide leadership and mentorship to Scrum Masters and Agile teams, reinforcing Agile, Lean, and XP principles.
   

  

 Ensure effective cross\-team coordination, managing dependencies, risks, and impediments across distributed teams.
   

  

 Maintain and communicate a clear view of program goals, delivery progress, and risks to leadership stakeholders.
   

  

 Drive initiatives to improve quality, automation, and defect management practices across the program.
   

  

 Foster a high\-trust, collaborative team environment focused on transparency, problem\-solving, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Support value stream planning, budgeting, and capacity management within a SAFe framework.
   

  

 Partner with business, product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure alignment with strategic priorities.
   

  

 Identify and escalate program\-level risks and issues, driving timely resolution.
   

  

 Recommend process improvements, policy enhancements, and strategic initiatives to improve delivery efficiency.
   

  

**All About You**

611a1ff4.title: Presales Solution Architect, Quality Engineering (AI and GenAI)
611a1ff4.description:
Digital Engineering (DE\-QE) \| Hyderabad, India \| Work from office
   

  

 OSI Digital is seeking an experienced Presales Solution Consultant for its Quality Engineering practice. This person owns presales for QE and drives QE accelerators as a product line: turning customer testing problems into scoped, defensible solutions and commercial proposals, and building reusable QE assets that OSI can sell repeatedly.
   

  

 The role is customer facing and solution led, not a pure delivery seat. It suits someone with real QE delivery depth, strong research instincts, and genuine hands\-on AI and GenAI ability, who wants to shape and sell solutions while staying technically credible.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own presales for the QE practice: qualify opportunities, run discovery calls, and scope QE solutions covering test strategy, test automation, performance, and security testing.
* Build effort estimates, proposals, solution decks, and responses to RFP and RFI documents, and defend the assumptions with customer stakeholders.
* Prepare and run tailored demos and proofs of concept, including AI assisted testing demos.
* Position and sell OSI accelerators into QE opportunities, showing where each reduces testing effort, cost, or risk.
* Identify, design, and drive net\-new QE accelerators: reusable automation frameworks, AI assisted testing assets, and repeatable solution packages the practice can sell more than once.
* Own the go\-to\-market for QE accelerators: the pitch narrative, the demo, the reference architecture, and the packaging story.
* Design and demonstrate Gen AI assisted testing workflows: test case generation from requirements, test data synthesis, and automated test script drafting.
* Evaluate and honestly position AI features in testing tools, for example self\-healing locators, visual validation, and risk\-based test selection.
* Prototype LLM and retrieval\-based aids for QE, such as a knowledge assistant over test documentation or GenAI support for defect triage.
* Research the QE tooling and vendor landscape and each prospect before engagement, and separate real capability from vendor marketing.
* Bridge the sold solution and the delivery team and contribute hands\-on to early delivery on strategic accounts, so the approach is proven in practice.
* Support architecture and code reviews for QE automation and drive AI, GenAI adoption across the QE team.
* Produce solution documentation, reusable assets, and enablement material.


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Core Experience
   

  

* 5 to 9 years of overall QA and QE experience, with at least 5 years hands\-on in test automation.
* 2 or more years of practical, hands\-on use of LLMs or GenAI in real work, not just awareness.
* Prior presales, solution consulting, or strong customer facing delivery exposure.


 QE and Automation Skills
   

  

* Strong with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, and RestAssured.
* API and UI automation, regression, and in\-sprint testing.
* Test integration in CI/CD pipelines and Git\-based workflows.
* Performance testing (JMeter, k6, or NeoLoad) is an advantage.


 Presales and Accelerator Skills
   

  

* Scoping and estimating technical engagements and defending the assumptions.
* Building proposals and presenting confidently to customer stakeholders.
* Track record of building reusable frameworks or assets that can be productized, not just one\-off delivery.


 AI and GenAI Skills
   

  

* Practical use of LLMs in real work, with the ability to check and validate generated output.
* Prompt design and retrieval (RAG) at a working level.
* Python or scripting for AI prototypes.


 Cloud and Ecosystem
   

  

* Understand at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Experience with Containerized test environments is an advantage.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience taking an internal accelerator or product to market, including pricing or packaging.
* Exposure to enterprise ERP or regulated industry testing.
* Security testing.
* Experience with AI augmented testing tools and vector databases.


 We are not looking for someone who
   

  

* Is not willing to work from the office.
* Has never worked directly with customers or in a client facing role.
* Has only manual testing experience with no hands\-on automation.
* Treats AI and GenAI as buzzwords, with no real hands\-on usage.
* Wants a pure delivery seat with no presales, solutioning, or customer interaction.

90bc44b4.title: Manager, SW System & Solution Dev Engineer
90bc44b4.description:
**The Company**

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.  



We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.  



  

**Meet the Team:**

We are looking for a motivated and experienced Software Development Lead to spearhead the establishment and growth of our new R\&D Software design center in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. This role is crucial in setting up our software development and test operations, seeking out the best talent to join in our mission, and fostering a culture of innovation, excellence, and collaboration.


In this role, you will provide strategic leadership and oversight, guiding the direction of our software product development and test automation initiatives. You will be responsible for ensuring the efficient and timely delivery of high\-quality solutions.


This position offers a unique opportunity to lead and shape the future of our R\&D reference arch and platform software efforts in a fast\-paced and collaborative environment. You will play a crucial role in the creation of new products and features, driving forward our technological advancements and market competitiveness. The portfolio you will be delivering includes mobile apps (iOS and Android), cloud\-based data platforms, web applications, software test frameworks, automation, and test scripts.


**Where you come in:**

* Lead, develop, and mentor a software engineering team delivering mobile and cloud software solutions supporting Dexcom products and services.
* Establish and communicate team priorities and execution plans aligned with product and organizational objectives.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, Marketing, Systems Engineering, and other stakeholders to define requirements, plan development activities, and ensure successful product delivery.
* Build and maintain a high\-performing engineering team focused on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive project planning, resource allocation, risk management, and execution across assigned software initiatives.
* Ensure software development activities comply with applicable quality system requirements, medical device regulations, cybersecurity standards, and company policies.
* Drive software development best practices across mobile and cloud applications, including **iOS and Android development, cloud services, Agile methodologies, automated testing, CI/CD, secure development practices, and performance monitoring** **.**
* Provide technical guidance and contribute to software architecture and design decisions across mobile and cloud systems to ensure scalability, maintainability, reliability, security, and product quality.
* Manage team staffing, hiring, onboarding, performance management, employee development, and resource planning activities.
* Use key performance indicators (KPIs), engineering metrics, and operational data to monitor team effectiveness, delivery performance, and product quality and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with engineering teams across the organization to manage interfaces and dependencies, share knowledge, improve development practices, and support successful end\-to\-end product delivery.
* Identify and manage technical, schedule, quality, security, and execution risks, escalating significant issues and tradeoffs when appropriate.
* Partner with Quality, V\&V, Cybersecurity, and other engineering functions to ensure software solutions meet functional, performance, reliability, security, and regulatory requirements.
* Support audit activities, inspections, and regulatory submissions as required.
* Foster strong cross\-functional relationships and advocate for engineering quality, technical excellence, effective execution, and continuous improvement.

**What makes you successful:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8\+ years of software development experience, including experience delivering complex software products.
* 3\+ years of people management experience leading software engineers.
* Demonstrated success leading, developing, and mentoring a software engineering team.
* **Strong experience with mobile and/or cloud application development, including iOS, Android, cloud services, or other connected software platforms.**
* Experience delivering software products through the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through development, verification, release, and maintenance.
* Experience managing engineering priorities, schedules, dependencies, risks, resources, and delivery commitments.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, software development methodologies, automated testing, and software quality practices.

1d774383.title: Senior Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer - India
1d774383.description:
**Company Overview**
 Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion\-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real\-time APIs for speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS), and building production\-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300\+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice\-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self\-hosted and on\-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.
   

  

****Company Operating Rhythm****
 At Deepgram, we expect an AI\-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
   

  

 Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.
   

  

 Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day\-to\-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9\-to\-5\.
   

  

**Note: this role is based out of India and will service the APAC region.**
**Opportunity**
 Deepgram is expanding across APAC and operating a follow\-the\-sun model. We are hiring a Pre\-Sales Solutions Engineer in India to win complex technical evaluations, design clear solution paths, and drive repeatable adoption for strategic accounts. Our strategic Account Executives do not hand off their customers after the first sale, so you will partner long term across discovery, POC, production launch, and expansion. You will focus on pre\-sales, and you will often step into post\-sales style work when the stakes are high and continuity matters.
   

  

**About Applied Engineering At Deepgram**
 Applied Engineering blends what many companies split into Solutions Engineering, Architecture, Consulting, and Senior Technical Support. We are builders and communicators who bridge sales and engineering. We help customers move from problem to production with speed, clarity, and measurable outcomes.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead technical discovery for strategic opportunities. Map business goals to measurable technical success criteria and an evaluation plan.
* Design, scope, and execute POCs that prove value. Define datasets, metrics, and timelines that land a clear technical win.
* Build lightweight prototypes, sample integrations, and demos using Deepgram SDKs and APIs.
* Advise on architecture for accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost. Cover cloud, self\-hosted, hybrid, and data residency needs.
* Run security and compliance threads common in APAC. Prepare crisp responses for Singapore PDPA, Japan APPI, Korea PIPA, Australia’s Privacy Act, and India’s DPDP Act.
* Triage and debug issues during evaluations. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support to unblock customers quickly.
* Create reusable assets that scale. Turn repeated requests into working samples, reference architectures, runbooks, and field guides.
* Partner with Solutions Architects and Support for seamless continuity after initial wins. Stay involved through expansion phases when needed.
* Enable the field. Collaborate with AEs, CSMs, and partners on positioning, demos, and technical validation for priority use cases.


**Regional Expectations**
* Based in an APAC time zone with strong overlap to customer business hours across East Asia, Southeast Asia, and ANZ.
* Excellent written and spoken English. Additional Asian languages are a strong plus, especially Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, or Hindi.
* Familiarity with procurement, InfoSec, and data privacy expectations across APAC.
* Ability to travel within the region for key customer milestones. Estimated travel 10 to 20 percent.


**Your First 90 Days**
**Ramp approach for this role** 
 Ramping mirrors the Solutions Architect plan, with explicit ticket work and earlier support for strategic Account Executives. In the first weeks you will pick up low\-risk customer tickets to learn our systems and support flow, then progress to pre\-sales escalations tied to active evaluations.
   

  

**First 30 days**
* Ramp on Deepgram’s product surface area, platform APIs, SDKs, evaluation methodology, and security review materials.
* Shadow strategic discovery and POC calls across APAC time zones.
* Triage and resolve low\-risk tickets with a Solutions Architect or Support partner. Focus on reproductions, log and trace collection, SDK setup issues, and clear notes and handoffs.
* Publish one internal field guide that clarifies a common APAC pre\-sales topic (for example data residency, telephony capture, or evaluation metrics).


**By day 60**
* Own two evaluations end to end with defined success criteria and timelines.
* Serve as the named technical partner for one or two strategic AEs. Run weekly technical deal reviews and prepare objection\-handling packs.
* Take point on higher\-signal tickets related to your evaluations, coordinating fast fixes with Product, Engineering, and Support.
* Deliver one live demo that becomes a reusable asset for the region. Pair with a Solutions Architect on a production launch to learn handoffs and escalation paths.


**By day 90**
* Act as the primary pre\-sales technical owner for several opportunities and expansions within strategic accounts.
* Close at least one complex technical win with a measurable impact on revenue.
* Lead one customer architecture workshop that documents a reference plan for production rollout or expansion.
* Convert repeated ticket patterns into a runbook, sample, or accelerator and present a short readout on the impact.


**You Will Thrive Here If You**
* Enjoy the mix of customer conversations and hands\-on building.
* Can move from whiteboard to working code and back without losing the thread.
* Communicate clearly with executives and deeply with engineers.
* Value speed with rigor and crisp documentation.
* Like winning together across regions and functions.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 5 or more years in Solutions Engineering or a similar customer\-facing technical role focused on pre\-sales.
* Professional software engineering experience in at least one language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Rust. You can build POCs and tools that real users run.
* Hands\-on experience with modern cloud platforms. Comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes, networking fundamentals, and secure API design.
* Proven track record leading POCs for enterprise customers and earning the technical win.
* Clear written and verbal communication across both technical and executive audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with speech recognition, TTS, voice quality analysis, or AI agents that orchestrate LLMs.
* Familiarity with telephony and real\-time media concepts such as SIP, WebRTC, streaming, and WebSocket integrations.
* Experience with self\-hosted and hybrid deployments, including Helm\-based installs and production observability.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, and data residency topics that appear in APAC enterprise reviews.
* Fluency in an additional Asian language such as Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, or Hindi.


**How We Work**
* Remote across APAC with periodic regional meetups.
* Close partnership with AEs, SAs, Product, and Engineering to support continuous coverage across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.
* Shared playbooks, defined escalation paths, and measurable SLAs.


**Interview Process**
* Recruiter screen focused on experience, motivations, and logistics.
* Hiring manager conversation focused on technical depth and customer impact.
* Practical assessment that mirrors real work. Expect discovery, solution design, and a short hands\-on exercise.
* Panel interviews with cross\-functional partners.
* Live demo and architecture walkthrough of a past technical win. Show your approach to success criteria, trade offs, and outcomes.


 If this sounds like you, we would love to meet you!
   

  

***Notice** 
 : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @* 
*deepgram.com* 
*email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.*

49b94770.title: Senior Group Technical Architect
49b94770.description:
Bangalore, Karnataka
  
Job Summary
  
  

As an Agentic Forward Deployed Engineer, you operate at the front line of delivery \- embedded with the client, turning ambiguous business problems into production agents, fast. Your deliverable is Business Transformation Agents: autonomous and multi\-agent systems that automate and reimagine real business processes such as invoice disputes, procurement approvals, onboarding, claims and compliance workflows. You own each agent end to end \-conceptualize, build, integrate, evaluate, deploy, and sustain \- and you lead a small team to do the same. You build exclusively in Python using agent development kits, and you bring Agentic AI capabilities to life inside the client's world, with Responsible AI, evaluation and security as non\-negotiables.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
**Conceptualize fast:** embed with stakeholders, frame a business process as an agentic solution, and stand up a working agent prototype in days, not weeks.
  
**Build Business Transformation Agents:** design and ship single\-agent and multi\-agent systems in Python using ADKs that automate and transform real client workflows, with measurable ROI.
  
**Own efficiency as the scorecard:** drive delivery efficiency and operational efficiency ; shorter cycle times, less manual effort, higher accuracy, lower cost\-to\-serve.
  
**Engineer the agent core:** apply prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context\-graph retrieval, memory, tool / function calling, MCP integration and multi\-agent orchestration.
  
**Integrate to standards:** connect agents into client ecosystems through proven integration patterns, standards\-based APIs and secure authentication.
  
**Make reusability and predictability the default:** build reusable agent components, skills, tool libraries and templates; add guardrails so agent behaviour is predictable, safe and repeatable.
  
**Prototype and iterate quickly:** use the kit's scaffolding to prototype, then harden to production\-grade, well\-tested Python.
  
**Run eval\-driven development:** build evaluation harnesses and test suites that measure agent correctness, safety and regression before anything ships.
  
**Own AgentOps / DevSecOps:** CI/CD for agents, versioning, observability and telemetry, shift\-left security, and Responsible AI governance baked in from day one.
  
**Run a continuous, adaptable feedback loop:** feed production telemetry, evals and client feedback back into prompts, context and agent design.
  
**Stay ahead of the curve:** adopt evolving agent frameworks and patterns quickly, and bring field learnings back to the practice.
  
**Lead and mentor:** set technical direction for a lean team of 3 agent engineers, raise the engineering bar, and grow the pod's agentic capability.
  
What you'll bring (must\-have)
  
Strong Python engineering ; idiomatic, typed, tested and packaged code; on a foundation of solid software engineering principles (design, version control, architecture).
