**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions \- Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end\-to\-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000\+ exceptional people, GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles.
   

  

 The Architect is a senior leader responsible for the successful technical execution and delivery of complex client projects across diverse domains. This role acts as a strategic anchor between clients, senior leadership, delivery managers, project managers, and delivery teams. In the AI\-first GCID organization, Architect(s) are expected to embed AI\-native thinking into delivery models, ensuring solutions are intelligent, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**AI\-First Delivery Leadership**
* Embed AI\-first principles into delivery workflows, leveraging automation and intelligent orchestration where applicable.
* Own the Architecture and drive end\-to\-end delivery of complex projects, ensuring solutions are scalable, robust, and aligned with client business outcomes.
* Drive engineering excellence through reusable components, accelerators, and scalable architecture.
* Oversee technical execution across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to best practices, quality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to define strategies, delivery plans, milestones, and risk mitigation approaches.
* Act as a technical point of contact for clients, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure delivery models are optimized for modern, AI\-native execution, including integration of automation and intelligent processes.
* Ability to step into at‑risk projects, quickly assess issues, and establish a credible path to recovery or exit.


**Engineering Excellence**
 Promote high\-quality engineering throughout all projects. Enforce coding standards, architectural integrity, and performance goals. Establish secure coding, TDD, and observability practices. Support ongoing learning and certifications. Advance modern methodologies like Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD for scalable solutions. Build a team culture of technical rigor, innovation, and accountability.
   

  

**Innovation \& Thought Leadership**
 Track new technologies to guide strategy. Drive innovation in delivery, assets, and tools for better efficiency. Promote best practices and continuous improvement across teams.
   

  

**Client Engagement \& Solutioning**
 Apply design thinking to develop user\-centric solutions that also support business objectives, architecture, and project delivery. Collaborate with clients to identify their needs and provide guidance throughout each stage of the project. Participate in pre\-sales and solutioning activities by preparing estimates, proofs\-of\-concept, and technical proposals. Additionally, maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and ongoing value.
   

  

**Team Management \& Mentorship**
 Lead cross\-functional teams, promote learning and collaboration, and uphold technical standards. Review work, offer feedback, and support team growth.
   

  

**Quality \& Compliance**
 Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements
   

  

**Other**
* Embody our culture and values


**Qualifications**
* 20\+ years of experience in software/solution engineering, with at least 10–15 years as Architect and delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience in leading delivery of complex, multi\-disciplinary projects.
* Strong understanding of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, DevOps, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant certifications are a plus.


**Areas of Expertise**
**Full Stack Application Engineering**
* 
+ End\-to\-end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend expertise using .NET / Java / Node.js / Python, with clean architecture, domain\-driven design, and API\-first principles
+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event\-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands\-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security


**AI Driven Application Development**
* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) \- enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.
* Strong experience modernizing application landscapes using GitHub Copilot‑assisted approaches, including rapid codebase comprehension, dependency analysis, large‑scale refactoring, and migration to cloud‑native and AI‑enabled architectures.
* Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the entire SDLC, from solutioning and scaffolding through CI/CD automation, test generation, production readiness, and operational excellence.
* Ability to coach and enable teams and customers on effective Copilot usage patterns, prompt strategies, and safe AI‑assisted engineering practices in enterprise environments.
* Apply Responsible AI principles across design and delivery, incorporating security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls into production‑grade engineering workflows.


**AI\-Enabled Application Development**
* Ability to translate business scenarios into production‑grade AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and custom ML models, with hands‑on delivery of RAG architectures leveraging Azure AI Search, vector databases, enterprise data grounding, and integration patterns.
* Strong expertise in prompt engineering, context management, grounding strategies, and LLM integration for copilots, conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, and decision‑support applications.
* Proven experience designing and implementing single‑agent and multi‑agent AI systems, including task boundaries, tool invocation, memory management, collaboration, delegation, and coordination, using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Deep understanding of agentic workflows, combining LLM reasoning with external tools, APIs, and enterprise data sources, alongside agent lifecycle management \- planning, execution, retries, failure handling, and human‑in‑the‑loop patterns.
* Designs enterprise‑ready AI solutions with built‑in observability and operational excellence, including telemetry, prompt tracing, agent behavior logging, model metrics, experimentation, drift monitoring, and cost/performance optimization, while applying Responsible AI principles across security, privacy, governance, and compliance \- balancing speed, quality, and enterprise constraints at scale.


**Cloud\-Native Architecture (Azure)**
* 
+ Deep experience designing cloud‑native, PaaS‑first solutions on Azure, prioritizing managed services over IaaS to improve scalability, resilience, security, and operational efficiency.
+ Proven expertise in architecting and delivering solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, AKS, Azure Functions, and API Management, selecting the right compute model based on workload characteristics and business needs.
+ Strong working knowledge of identity, security, and networking architectures, including Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault integration, private endpoints, and VNET‑integrated application deployments.
+ Design and implementation of architectures that support high availability, horizontal scalability, disaster recovery, and fault tolerance, including multi‑region deployment patterns and resiliency strategies.
+ Experience in cost‑aware architecture design, applying cost optimization strategies such as right‑sizing, autoscaling, consumption‑based services, and proactive cost governance.
+ Apply Microsoft Well‑Architected Framework principles across reliability, security, performance efficiency, operational excellence, and cost optimization, incorporating architecture reviews and continuous improvement into delivery.
+ Hands‑on experience building cloud‑ready landing patterns, integrating application architectures with enterprise networking, security baselines, and platform standards.


**DevOps, Platform \& Developer Productivity**
* 
+ Strong expertise in designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, enabling automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows across environments.
+ Proven hands‑on experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) using Bicep, ARM, and Terraform, leveraging GitHub Copilot to scaffold modules, generate templates, and propose secure configurations aligned with enterprise standards.
+ Deep understanding of observability and reliability engineering, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLOs, and proactive alerting for production systems.
+ Demonstrated ability to enhance developer productivity and delivery velocity through inner‑source practices, reusable components, reference implementations, accelerators, and automation.
+ Experience embedding DevSecOps practices into delivery pipelines, including secure coding checks, dependency scanning, secrets management, policy enforcement, and compliance validation.
+ Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the DevOps lifecycle, including authoring pipeline definitions, generating runbooks and release notes, assisting with PR summaries, and accelerating troubleshooting and incident response.
+ Strong grasp of platform engineering principles, building paved‑road solutions and self‑service capabilities that balance speed, governance, and operational excellence.
+ Ability to continuously improve engineering throughput, quality, and system reliability, while maintaining enterprise security and compliance expectations.


**Solutioning, Pre\-Sales \& Technical Leadership**
* 
+ Lead technical solutioning, estimations, and support architecture design during pre\-sales and delivery shaping
+ Translate business outcomes into clear architecture, execution plans, and risk mitigation strategies
+ Influence technical direction across multiple teams and engagements
+ Act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal leadership


**Frontier Engineering \& Customer Enablement Skills**
* 
+ Lead rapid prototyping, pilots, and early\-stage deployments for enterprise customers
+ Ability to go from whiteboard to production with minimal friction
+ Strong troubleshooting and production support expertise, including performance, reliability, and security issues
+ Side‑by‑side coding with customer engineering teams to unblock deployments and accelerate time to value
+ Outcome‑driven engineering focused on business impact, not activity
+ Building reusable assets, accelerators, and reference implementations
+ Comfortable operating in ambiguous, high\-pressure environments with C\-Level customer stakeholders


**Personal Attributes**
* Passion for technology and innovation.
* Ability to interact confidently with senior leaders and clients.
* Strong decision\-making skills and a consultative mindset.
* Flexibility to manage in a fast\-moving, ambiguous consulting environment.

98074ec3.title: Customer Engagement Manager
98074ec3.description:
**What We Do**
 At GoGuardian, we're helping build a future where all learners are ready and inspired to solve the world's greatest challenges. Our award\-winning system of learning solutions is purpose\-built for K\-12 and trusted by school leaders to promote effective teaching and equitable engagement while helping empower educators to keep students safe.
   

  

**What It's Like to Work at GoGuardian**
 We are an outcomes\-focused learning company with a steadfast focus on improving learning environments, one classroom at a time. Working with us means joining a remote team of diverse, committed, mission\-driven employees who are inspired by our vision, dedicated to our customers, and ready to roll up their sleeves. Guardians put their heads together to solve problems, learn together from experiments that fail, and stand together by their work with full accountability. We balance our diligence with an inclusive culture that invites everyone to bring their whole self to work. Join us and learn why "I love the people here" is one of the most frequent comments we hear from Guardians.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a Customer Engagement Manager to help identify and address customer engagement, adoption, and churn risks across GoGuardian's Curriculum and Instruction products.
   

  

 This is a data\-driven, customer\-facing role that combines customer investigation, analytics, product knowledge, and cross\-functional problem\-solving. You'll use customer and product data to identify strategic and at\-risk customers, deep dive into their behavior and engagement patterns to understand the underlying causes, and work with Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering to determine and drive appropriate actions.
   

  

 You'll also work directly with customers and customer\-facing teams to understand issues, answer questions, and support customers who require additional attention. This position sits within the Product Team and serves as a bridge between customers and the teams responsible for improving the product experience.
   

  

 This is a remote opportunity for candidates located in India and requires regular overlap with U.S. working hours.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Customer Engagement \& Risk Management (\~40%)**
* Partner with Customer Success to identify and support strategic and at\-risk customers.
* Maintain a data\-informed view of customer engagement, adoption, and churn risk.
* Provide support to identified at\-risk customers and help ensure their concerns are addressed.
* Participate in customer meetings and product discussions to understand customer goals and challenges.
* Help identify and drive actions that improve customer engagement, adoption, and retention.


**Analytics \& Customer Investigation (\~20%)**
* Regularly examine dashboards and customer/product usage data to identify customers with declining engagement, adoption risks, or other signals of churn.
* Deep dive into individual customer behavior and usage patterns to understand why engagement or adoption is changing.
* Investigate customer history, product usage, and other relevant signals to identify root causes.
* Develop clear, actionable findings and recommendations based on customer and product data.
* Track the impact of actions taken and use data to determine whether customer engagement or risk is improving.
* Build and maintain a reliable, data\-informed list of customers requiring attention.


**Product Partnership \& Customer Advocacy (\~20%)**
* Bring customer findings, recurring issues, and product opportunities to Product Managers in a clear and actionable way.
* Partner with Product Management to investigate customer problems and validate potential solutions or workflows.
* Capture and synthesize customer feedback, enhancement requests, and recurring product challenges.
* Work with Solutions Engineering and Engineering when customer issues require deeper technical investigation or resolution.
* Validate new features and workflows with customers and share feedback to help improve the product experience.


**Cross\-Functional Customer \& Product Support (\~20%)**
* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering to address customer questions and issues.
* Help troubleshoot customer\-reported product and data issues and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.
* Support customer data onboarding, integrations, and account maintenance where applicable.
* Communicate customer issues and findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Follow issues through to resolution and ensure relevant customer\-facing teams are kept informed.


**Who You Are**
* 3\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Engagement, Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer\-facing SaaS role.
* Experience working directly with U.S.\-based customers and confidently leading customer conversations, presentations, and business reviews.
* Experience supporting or retaining strategic or at\-risk customers and understanding customer engagement or churn risk.
* Analytical and data\-driven, with experience using customer, product, or business data to identify risks, investigate customer behavior, and inform actions.
* Strong investigative and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to dig into customer issues, identify root causes, and determine appropriate next steps.
* Familiarity with customer\-facing web applications, data integrations, APIs, and common web technologies, with the ability to troubleshoot issues and work effectively with technical teams.
* Ability to work effectively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering teams.
* Strong communication, relationship\-building, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer engagements and priorities.
* Comfortable learning new products, workflows, and technical concepts quickly.
* Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of problems in a fast\-paced, changing environment.
* Ability and willingness to regularly work during required U.S. working hours.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience in K\-12 education technology.
* Experience working with enterprise, strategic, or at\-risk customer accounts.
* Familiarity with student information systems (SIS), rostering systems, assessment platforms, or education data.
* Experience with SQL, APIs, data integrations, reporting tools, BI platforms, or CRM systems.
* Experience with Google Sheets or Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive pay, health insurance, accident insurance, life insurance, and a retirement savings plan.
* Paid annual leave, paid holidays, paid parental leave, paid leave for life events, and a paid year\-end holiday break.
* A robust catalog of benefits that support your professional growth and personal wellbeing, including work from home funds, wellness checks, and more…


*Plus the intangible:*
* A varied and challenging role in an innovative, global company.
* Supportive, driven colleagues who have your back and share your passion.


 Please share this with your friends or co\-workers who may be interested in working at GoGuardian! We have multiple openings and are always looking for talented people.
   

  

 GoGuardian is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs. GoGuardian does not discriminate against employees, applicants, interns or volunteers on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, sex, age, sexual orientation, military and veteran status, registered domestic partner status, genetic information, gender, gender identity, gender expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

* Design and implement RAG\-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.

**What We Need To See**
* B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).

* In\-depth understanding of state\-of\-the\-art language models, including but not limited to GPT\-3, BERT, or similar architectures.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

 Salesforce’s worldwide Customer Success team is a global network of Salesforce employees and partners. Our sole mission is to ensure customer success. We work with our customers to build relationships, learn about their businesses, and drive value\-based results. Our motto for our customers is "Your Success is our Success"
   

  

* Job Description: Senior Success Archiect/Success Architect


**Role Description**
* Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long\-term business success.
* Success Architects play a flexible and pivotal role in supporting a wide range of customers. They act as the customer's first point of contact for a mix of reactive and proactive needs. This includes providing frontline technical support (Support), delivering educational 'Guide' sessions to drive feature adoption, and assisting with foundational architectural health checks (basic Architect). They collaborate closely with senior Success Architects and Support Engineers to triage complex issues and ensure customers are on a path to long\-term health, bridging the gap between daily challenges and long\-term success.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive Customer Impact – Partner with a portfolio of customers, assessing their implementations and delivering recommendations on common technical issues, feature adoption (Guide), and foundational solution design (basic Architect).
* Lead with Expertise – Serve as a trusted technical generalist, providing reactive and proactive guidance on product best practices.
* Communicate with Clarity – Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to customer stakeholders and managers, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
* Innovate \& Solve Problems – Triage capability gaps and design inefficiencies, resolving common issues directly and escalating complex architectural challenges to senior Success Architects.
* Execute Proven Strategies – Leverage and execute playbooks from Support, Guides, and the Architect team to meet customer needs.
* Build Strong Relationships – Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement and overall business growth.
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI\-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive\-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi\-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI\-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C\-level alignment

+ Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics and security best practices.
+ Familiarity with industry\- or vertical\-specific solutions (preferred).

* Communication \& Leadership
+ Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options and drive stakeholder alignment.
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.

+ Proven ability to manage customer\-facing discussions and explain technical concepts clearly.
+ High proficiency in English.

* Strategic Thinking \& Problem Solving

f89c1bab.title: Lead Cloud Infrastructure Architect / Engineer (Azure, DevOps, Kubernetes, Terraform)
f89c1bab.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead Cloud Infrastructure Architect / Engineer (Azure, DevOps, Kubernetes, Terraform)
About Mastercard  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

  

About The Role  

Cloud Infrastructure Engineers at Mastercard design, build, and operate the foundational platforms that enable our product and service teams to deliver securely, reliably, and at scale. This role focuses on Azure\-based infrastructure, cloud\-native services, and automation that power transaction processing, analytics, developer productivity, and self\-service delivery across the enterprise.  

As a Lead Cloud Infra Engineer, you will operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical ownership and influence that extends beyond a single team. You will drive the design and evolution of complex platform capabilities, set technical direction for key areas of cloud infrastructure, and partner closely with engineering, security, and operations leaders to ensure platforms are scalable, resilient, and aligned with business goals. While still hands\-on, your impact is measured by the systems, standards, and teams you enable.  

As a Lead Cloud Infra Engineer, you are expected to perform the following general responsibilities:  

* Provide technical leadership for complex cloud infrastructure and platform initiatives spanning multiple teams or services
* Own the architecture, design, and implementation of critical Azure infrastructure components and platform capabilities
* Define and evolve standards, patterns, and guardrails for secure, scalable, and operable cloud solutions
* Lead cross\-team technical discussions, driving alignment on design decisions and tradeoffs
* Enable and improve self\-service provisioning and developer platforms that reduce friction and increase team autonomy
* Anticipate and mitigate systemic risks related to reliability, security, scalability, and cost
* Guide and mentor Senior and Software Engineer II team members through design reviews, feedback, and technical coaching
* Partner closely with product, security, operations, and architecture stakeholders to translate business needs into platform solutions

  

All About You  

  

* Overall 8\-12 years of career experience in a similar field
* Extensive hands\-on experience designing, building, and operating Azure\-based cloud infrastructure at scale, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and platform services

**Role 2:** Service Cloud
  
  

You will be part of our Service Cloud and Pharmacovigilance product line, bringing deep knowledge of customer service operations and Salesforce Service Cloud capabilities.

* Case Management (creation, routing, assignment, resolution)

**Role 3:** Life Sciences Cloud

**This includes:**

* Sample Management

Automate low\-value tasks to allow scientists to focus on high\-value work, leveraging elastic cloud resources to accelerate workflows. Optimize HPC resource availability, its performance and cloud costs. Collaborate with senior HPC SMEs, Application Support Engineers, and research stakeholders to reduce cycle times, boost efficiencies, and enhance UX, increasing researcher capacity.
  
Ultimately, you will play a key role in implementing scalable and efficient solutions on AWS to support compute\-intensive applications. We are looking for an individual with passion for HPC and motivated to provide worldclass HPC experience to enable research scientists to use the power of leading\-edge science to save and improve lives around the world.
  
  

What will you do in this role
  
* Deploy, maintain and support high\-performance computing clusters, platforms and AWS managed services.
* Monitor and maintain the performance of HPC cluster resources in both on premises and AWS, ensuring high availability, reliability and user experience.
* Optimize compute and data workflows for performance and cost\-efficiency in cloud\-based HPC environments.
* Create scripts and tools for automating cluster deployment, monitoring, and management (e.g., using Terraform, Ansible, AWS CLI, etc.).
* Analyse and determine bottlenecks in HPC cloud environment, including network performance and parallel file systems.
* Diagnose and resolve issues in complex HPC environments, including job scheduling, software, and cloud infrastructure.
* Document processes, configurations, and best practices for HPC workloads in AWS and Linux environments.
* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and Hyderabad based Director, as well as collaborating with other teams.
* Participate in project planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with both functional and project goals.


What should you have
  
* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 3\-7 years of experience in HPC infrastructure engineering, working with network principles, and system administration for Linux/Unix servers.


Primary skills (must\-have)
  
* Hands\-on proficiency in Linux operating systems, shell scripting, HPC architecture and job schedulers in a DevOps environment.
* Experience with job schedulers and orchestrators viz. GridEngine, PBS Pro, and Altair NavOps.
* Knowledge of network architectures and high\-speed interconnects.
* Strong analytical skills to assess and interpret complex data.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to convey findings and recommendations.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential risks.
* Meticulous attention to detail to ensure accurate assessments and reporting.
* Understanding of relevant regulations and compliance standards.
* Experience with disaster recovery, data backup solutions, and virtualization platforms
* Good problem\-solving skills
* Customer product\-centric mindset
* Ability to work effectively in a matrixed and hybrid environment


Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
* Relevant certifications (ideally AWS)
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals (virtual networks, VPNs, firewalls) and storage technologies
* Formal training in HPC.
* Experience with SLURM and AWS ParallelCluster.
* Computational Chemistry, Computational Biology or Imaging Processing domain knowledge.
* Experience with Atlassian stack.

 Own end\-to\-end lifecycle of global SD programs — from scoping problems to driving execution and delivering measurable outcomes across AMER, APAC, EU, and LATAM. 8228901a.title: Program Manager - Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) & Business Continuity Planning (BCP)
8228901a.description:
**We need people from manufacturing background** 




**Role Purpose** 




 The Program Manager will establish the end\-to\-end ERM and BCP architecture for Tata Electronics and lead phased rollout across semiconductor manufacturing, OSAT, EMS, corporate functions, and support organizations. The role will create the governance model, standards, methods, templates, training approach, testing regime, and performance review cadence required to make business continuity a managed capability rather than a one\-time project.
 



 The role will also serve as the central integrator across Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, EHS, Facilities, IT, Information Security, HR, Finance, Legal, and site leadership to ensure continuity obligations are owned locally and governed centrally.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Build the enterprise ERM/BCP framework** 



* Design and deploy the enterprise ERM/BCP framework, policy structure, governance model, standards, procedures, templates, and review mechanisms for all Tata Electronics entities and sites.
* Define the minimum continuity architecture required at enterprise, business, function, department, and site level, including risk assessment, business impact analysis, recovery strategies, crisis management, plan documentation, testing, training, and annual refresh cycles.
* Establish a common methodology for risk identification, prioritization, treatment, and monitoring using fit\-for\-purpose approaches such as FMEA, risk registers, dependency mapping, scenario analysis, and control plans.



**2\. Drive execution through assigned owners across the organization** 



* Create and operationalize a federated delivery model with named BCP coordinators, function representatives, department continuity owners, and site taskforce leads across each business and manufacturing location.
* Drive implementation through these assignees by issuing charters, RACI structures, milestone plans, workshop calendars, templates, and closure trackers, while holding owners accountable for quality and timeliness of deliverables.
* Chair or coordinate recurring review forums with business and function assignees to monitor readiness, action closure, overdue items, testing progress, risk escalation, and management reporting.
* Ensure every critical process has an identified owner, alternate owner, documented recovery requirements, upstream and downstream dependency mapping, and current continuity actions.



**3\. Lead risk assessment and business impact analysis** 



* Direct organization\-wide risk assessments covering operational, supply chain, facility, utility, EHS, cyber, information security, logistics, quality, workforce, and external ecosystem risks relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
* Lead business impact analysis with function owners to identify critical products, processes, assets, infrastructure, information, skills, suppliers, and services; define impact tolerances; and determine RTO, RPO, MTPD, and minimum resource requirements where relevant.
* Consolidate departmental outputs into enterprise views for prioritization, management review, and investment decisions.



**4\. Develop and institutionalize recovery and crisis capabilities** 



* Build recovery strategies for priority scenarios such as utility outages, equipment failures, cleanroom incidents, chemical events, IT disruptions, cyber incidents, supplier failures, logistics interruptions, natural disasters, labor shortages, and infrastructure breakdowns.
* Define crisis management structures, escalation criteria, notification protocols, communication flows, command\-center practices, and decision rights for enterprise, business, and site incidents.
* Ensure continuity plans are practical, role\-based, version\-controlled, and linked to trigger conditions, response actions, recovery steps, communication paths, and restart criteria.



**5\. Build certification and audit readiness** 



* Translate continuity and risk requirements into management\-system\-ready processes and records that support ISO 9001 risk\-based thinking, IATF 16949 contingency planning, ISO 27001 information security during disruption, and ICT readiness during disruption.
* Partner with Quality, Information Security, and Compliance teams to map BCP controls to clause requirements, create evidence repositories, define ownership of mandatory records, and prepare internal teams for audits and customer assessments.
* Establish a documented evidence trail for reviews, exercises, risk assessments, contingency plans, communication logs, corrective actions, plan updates, and management review inputs.
* Support audit responses, nonconformity closure, and remediation planning related to continuity, contingency, and resilience requirements.



**6\. Build testing, exercising, and readiness assurance** 



* Create an annual continuity exercise program that includes tabletop exercises, functional drills, site simulations, cyber\-disruption scenarios, supplier disruption scenarios, and post\-event reviews.
* Define testing coverage, pass/fail criteria, observation methods, issue logging, CAPA tracking, and retest requirements to demonstrate plan effectiveness.
* Establish readiness dashboards and KPI/KRI mechanisms for plan completion, exercise closure, overdue actions, recovery capability, risk heat maps, supplier dependency coverage, and training completion.



**7\. Integrate supply chain, IT, and manufacturing continuity** 



* Work with Supply Chain and Procurement teams to assess critical supplier resilience, alternate source strategies, logistics contingencies, inventory buffers, and communication protocols for supply continuity.
* Coordinate with IT and Information Security to align enterprise BCP with disaster recovery, cyber response, backup, access recovery, application recovery, and information security continuity requirements.
* Partner with Facilities, EHS, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality to ensure continuity strategies reflect fab realities such as utilities, contamination control, process qualification, equipment readiness, tool recovery, and safe restart sequencing.



**8\. Lead capability building and change management** 



* Develop training and awareness programs for executives, site leaders, functional assignees, crisis teams, and process owners so that continuity responsibilities are clearly understood and practiced.
* Build the organization’s continuity culture by embedding BCP requirements into business reviews, operating procedures, onboarding, leadership routines, and annual planning cycles.
* Coach local owners on plan quality, scenario thinking, evidence preparation, and corrective\-action discipline.



**Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 14 or more years of experience in program management, operations, risk management, quality systems, supply chain resilience, or business continuity, with significant experience in semiconductor manufacturing, electronics manufacturing, automotive electronics, or similarly complex industrial environments.
* Demonstrated experience building and rolling out enterprise or multi\-site BCP, contingency planning, ERM, crisis management, or resilience programs from the ground up.
* Proven success driving execution through matrixed stakeholders, site representatives, and function owners rather than relying only on direct reporting lines.
* Experience supporting management\-system compliance, customer audits, or certification readiness in regulated or high\-reliability manufacturing environments.



**Technical and Functional Expertise** 



* Strong command of business continuity lifecycle elements including governance, risk assessment, business impact analysis, recovery strategy development, crisis management, exercising, corrective action, and continual improvement.
* Strong working knowledge of risk\-based thinking under ISO 9001, contingency planning expectations under IATF 16949, and information security continuity requirements under ISO 27001\.
* Ability to connect continuity requirements to manufacturing, supply chain, quality, EHS, IT, cybersecurity, and supplier\-management processes.
* Experience with structured methods such as FMEA, CAPA, management review, internal audit, action tracking, and process mapping.



**Leadership Capabilities** 



* Strong program leadership with the ability to drive enterprise\-wide initiatives across multiple businesses, sites, and senior stakeholders.
* Excellent facilitation, communication, escalation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to translate high\-level resilience goals into practical deployment plans, role clarity, measurable milestones, and sustainable governance.
* High level of discipline in follow\-through, documentation quality, and operating cadence.



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Risk Management, Quality, Information Security, or a related discipline.
* Relevant certifications preferred, such as CBCP, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Auditor, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, PMP, ASQ, or equivalent.



**Success Measures** 



* Enterprise ERM/BCP governance established and functioning with clear role ownership across businesses, departments, and sites.
* Department and site assignees trained, active, and meeting defined deliverables and review cadence.
* Critical process BIA, risk assessments, and continuity plans completed to agreed quality standards.
* Exercise program implemented with measurable improvement in readiness and corrective\-action closure.
* Documented audit readiness for continuity\-related expectations linked to ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 27001, and internal governance requirements.
* Increased visibility of enterprise risks, dependencies, recovery capabilities, and unresolved gaps for leadership decision\-making.



**Role Impact** 




 This role is central to building Tata Electronics’ resilience capability as the company scales across advanced manufacturing operations. Success in the role will create a disciplined, auditable, and execution\-driven continuity system that protects customers, employees, assets, data, supply assurance, and operational recovery during disruption

5f6d1406.title: Sr. Program Manager, WW FBA
5f6d1406.description:
**Description**
 The WW FBA (Fulfilment by Amazon) team is responsible for one of the most operationally complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: ensuring the right inventory is in the right place at the right time, at the lowest possible cost, for sellers across every marketplace. Getting this right requires tight coordination across forecasting, placement, capacity, and seller behavior — and a clear line of sight into what is driving outcomes at the country level.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager who will partner closely with in\-country FBA, Supply Chain, Retail, and Operations teams in International Emerging Stores (IES) stores to drive key FBA inventory metrics — covering areas such as inventory availability, excess/Aged inventory. In the near term, this role is focused on building the operating mechanisms, measurement frameworks, and cross\-functional alignment needed to move these metrics. Over time, as ownership matures, this person is expected to take on deeper accountability for metric outcomes, drive programs informed by experimentation and country\-level insights, and work directly with engineering, science, and BI teams to build scalable solutions. You will need to be comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook — diagnosing problems using data you pull yourself, influencing teams you do not manage, and making decisions in the face of incomplete information. The ability to think in terms of systems, design experiments with sellers, and approach problems with an AI\-first mindset will be critical to succeeding in this role and growing it over time.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with in\-country FBA, Supply Chain, Retail, and Operations teams to drive key FBA inventory metrics taking progressively deeper ownership of outcomes over time.
* Build and maintain root\-cause attribution frameworks that connect upstream inputs (forecasting gaps, inbound defects, seller restock adoption, FC constraints) to downstream metric outcomes, enabling clear and consistent diagnosis across teams.
* Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly review mechanisms for your metric areas, representing FBA in country Business Review forums and ensuring that system\-driven insights are correctly communicated and acted upon.
* Design and run structured experiments with sellers \- adoption levers, communication treatments, and incentive mechanisms, etc. and use findings to build an evidence\-based product and program roadmap.
* Work with Product, science, and BI teams to translate operational insights and experiment results into scalable product improvements; identify IES\-specific requirements and ensure they are reflected in WW roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve how metrics are tracked, root causes are diagnosed, and corrective actions are triggered.
* Coordinate peak readiness (Prime Day, BFCM) by identifying inventory risks early, stress\-testing operational workflows, and working with partner teams on mitigation plans.
* Serve as the connective tissue between WW FBA and in\-country stakeholders — validating hypotheses, surfacing local edge cases, supporting system rollouts, consolidating country\-specific inputs for OP1/OP2, and ensuring smooth knowledge transfer in both directions


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, data science, public administration, finance, engineering, human resources or related field
* 
* Demonstrated experience owning business metrics end\-to\-end — defining measurement frameworks, diagnosing root causes, and leading cross\-functional teams to drive improvement
* 
* Proficiency in SQL or equivalent querying tools to independently extract, analyze, and communicate operational insights without relying on a dedicated analytics resource
* 
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing and presenting structured reviews to senior leadership
* 
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment across teams you do not directly manage, in ambiguous or evolving organizational contexts
* 
* Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation tools to redesign an analytical or operational workflow — not just familiarity with the concepts


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 
* Experience in inventory planning, or supply chain operations; or equivalent experience in marketplace or platform supply chain, or seller/vendor\-facing operations at scale
* 
* Familiarity with generic inventory systems — including placement logic, restock recommendations, capacity management, or seller\-facing tools
* 
* Experience working in or closely with non\-US Amazon stores (EU, JP, IN)
* 
* Demonstrated ability to build operating mechanisms from scratch — metric definitions, attribution frameworks, review cadences — in an environment without established playbooks

****About MISUMI Americas****
 MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
   

  

 MISUMI Americas is bringing together MISUMI and Fictiv to build the future of manufacturing — combining standard, configurable, and custom parts into one powerful platform for engineers and manufacturers. We’re creating a faster, smarter, AI\-enabled way to go from design to production, backed by global scale, deep supply chain expertise, and a culture that moves with startup speed. For builders, problem\-solvers, and people who want to make a real impact, this is a rare opportunity to help transform how the world makes things.
   

  

****Impact In This Role:****
 As an
 **Associate Technical Program Manager II** 
 , you’ll play a key role in managing high\-mix, low\-volume projects, ensuring seamless execution from customer requirements to final delivery. By bridging the gap between our U.S.\-based customers and US based manufacturing partners, you’ll ensure production runs smoothly, meets specifications, and stays on budget—while continuously driving process improvements.
   

  

****Areas Of Responsibility:****
* Project Management – Manage projects throughout entire execution to ensure success as defined by adherence to standards of scope, budget, and timeline.
* Risk Mitigation \- Mitigate risks and coordinate with various stakeholders (internally and externally) in order to ensure the on\-time delivery of an order to the builders’ design specifications.
* Work Order Assignment – Take ownership of scheduling and overseeing the distribution of your assigned manufacturing work orders to members of our manufacturing partner network in order to fulfill our builders’ orders on time.
* Production Issue Resolution – Answer open technical questions that our manufacturers may have around how best to manufacture the parts, and build the products that we have assigned to them.
* Change Order Management – Ensure post\-sale change requests from all stakeholders are evaluated, and appropriately implemented while mitigating any associated risks.
* Continuous Improvement – Identifying areas of improvement and driving tactical and strategic improvements to the Technical Project Management workflow.
* Communication Management \- Communicate proactively with all involved personnel to provide encouragement, identify problems, create solutions, and implement efficiency improvements

* Strong project management skills: scoping, timing, quality control, testing, and logistics
* Skilled at managing multiple stakeholders \- aligning expectations and communications through project completion.
* Self\-starter: works independently, manages time well, detail\-oriented, documentation\-focused, data\-driven decisions
* A data\-driven approach to problem\-solving and process improvement
* Adaptable/gritty in ambiguous processes; builds systems that are both repeatable and flexible
* Strong problem\-solver, results\-oriented, urgency\-driven on tight deadlines
* Strong English communicator, multicultural work experience is a plus.
* Open to working night shifts.

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

**Position Summary With Job Responsibilities**
 Purpose of the position
   

  

 To Lead a Vehicle Platform or Variant for Vehicle NVH Simulation.
   

  

 This is critical position considering role of digital processes in overall product development. This role impact design and development activities in many ways –
   

  

* Vehicle subsystem \& system design activities will stall or become extremely inefficient.
* Digital validation capability road map execution will be compromised significantly.
* Timely delivery of project milestones will be affected.


 Representation of CAE function in design/testing/product development will be affected.
   

  

 Key Responsibility \& Key Tasks
   

  

 1Program Management \& Delivery
   

  

* Plan and manage NVH digital validation activities –
* Prepare plan and allocate resources.
* Assure quality of deliverables.
* Assure robust and optimized design through simulation techniques.
* Track, monitor \& deliver within program timeframe.
* Technical mentoring of NVH digital validation activities in vehicle development program –
* Work\-out feasible design solutions along with design COC to all identified risks.
* Support investigations pertaining to performance lapses identified during physical validation by providing in\-depth understanding of physics involved.
* Support by simulation activities to assess what\-if scenarios for comparative studies of design concepts.


 2Technology Roadmap/Methodologies \& Process development
   

  

* Support technology road map –
* Identify department needs
* maximize benefits from current tools.
* Drive method \& process development as per road map
* Carryout pilot projects to demonstrate method capabilities \& benefits.
* Drive process automations to productionize new capabilities.
* People Management
* Mentoring \& coach project team
* To liaison with NVH Test, NVH PAT, CE, COC ODC


 Education
   

  

 Master of Engineering in Mechanical
   

  

 Work Experience
   

  

 Relevant Experience: 3\+ Years in automotive Vehicle subsystem and system evaluation and optimisation for NVH structure borne and air borne NVH assessment through digital simulation techniques and experimental techniques.
   

  

* Sound knowledge mechanical engineering and automotive engineering.
* In\-depth knowledge of one or more of FEM, BEM, SEA, MBD, 1D tools simulation tools, theory and technologies for NVH low, mid and high frequency simulation of vehicle Structure, Powertrain, Aggregates, etc. Hands on or working knowledge of tools like NASTRAN, Hyperwork, AVL Excite, Simcenter, GT Power, VA1, etc is must.
* Working knowledge of material science, vehicle packaging, and product development process.
* In\-depth knowledge of vehicle NVH domain for theory, objective \& subjective assessment, experimental data analysis, NVH target setting, root cause analysis.
* In depth knowledge of vehicle subsystem / systems (e.g. Body, Powertrain, Suspension, Cooling Module, Steering System, Sound Pack, etc) for construction, operation \& its dynamics


 Knowledge of TML product development process, its milestones, deliverables

fb5a1411.description:
**Company Description** 
 VDart Digital is a high\-growth global digital solutions, product development, and professional services firm headquartered in Atlanta, GA, with a strong presence across Canada, Mexico, Belgium, the UK, Malaysia, the UAE, and India. The company focuses on building next\-generation solutions and connected platforms that transform business operations and customer experiences. VDart Digital delivers turnkey digital transformation, mobility, and supply chain management solutions leveraging AI/ML, GenAI, intelligent automation, data analytics, blockchain, cloud, IoT, identity and access management, UI/UX, and full\-stack development. Its product portfolio includes Test SamurAI, LendSmartAI, IDoc Lens, VGo Fleet Management, V Validate for document verification, and V Engage for employee engagement, offering talent the opportunity to work with advanced technologies in diverse domains.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Pre Sales Solution Consultant role based in Bengaluru North. The role involves collaborating with sales teams to understand client needs, shaping solution approaches, and creating compelling proposals and presentations. The consultant will work closely with delivery and product teams to define solution architectures, estimate efforts, and ensure technical and functional alignment with customer requirements. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting discovery workshops, analyzing business processes, preparing solution demos and proof\-of\-concepts, and responding to RFPs and RFIs. The role also requires maintaining up\-to\-date knowledge of VDart Digital’s offerings and market trends, supporting sales enablement activities, and contributing to continuous improvement of presales assets and methodologies.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to assess client requirements, interpret data, and translate business problems into solution opportunities.
* Candidates should possess Consulting skills to conduct discovery sessions, advise on digital transformation strategies, and communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Presales skills to design solution narratives, build demos and proof\-of\-concepts, and create persuasive proposals, presentations, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Candidates should possess Sales\-related skills to collaborate effectively with account teams, support deal qualification, and contribute to pipeline growth and deal closure.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to coordinate presales activities, manage timelines and dependencies, and ensure high\-quality deliverables for client engagements.
* Experience with digital technologies such as AI/ML, GenAI, cloud, data analytics, integration, and mobility solutions is highly beneficial.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, stakeholder management abilities, and a collaborative working style are required.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, business, or a related field, and prior experience in IT services or digital solutions presales, are preferred.

**About The Role**
 GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. \* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support. You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross\-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long\-term, trusted relationships. What you’ll do
   

  

* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner\-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in\-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab\-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies. What you’ll bring
* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision\-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go\-to\-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies. About the team The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go\-to\-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape. How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law . 4d448aaa.title: Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery
4d448aaa.description:
Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager \- AI and Data Delivery.


### **What you’ll do:**



This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.



The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.


* Lead end\-to\-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.
* Manage the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, capability building and retention of employees and contractors.
* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.

### **Skills**


* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands\-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high\-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.


All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.



We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

fdd33704.title: Solutions Architect (India)
fdd33704.description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies \- from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups \- use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Solutions Architecture Team partners with our users to realize their full potential through the adoption of prescriptive solutions that drive their growth and success.
   

  

 We work with founders, C\-level executives, finance leaders, product design and engineering teams at large global brands and platforms who are building financial services solutions with Stripe. We work closely with Account Executives, Professional Services, Customer Success Managers, Partners, Technical Account Managers Product, and Engineering teams to develop and execute on the account strategy for Stripe in market.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 You will be building trusted relationships with brand new founders to the C\-suite, and solving mission\-critical business challenges for our users. You will be building new business models and help expand existing ones with users of all shapes and sizes in the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support key technical engagements for Stripe in India
* Drive thought leadership and be a trusted advisor for key business and technical stakeholders including CIO, CTO, COO, CRO, CDO, Head of Product Engineering, and Head of Payments.
* Work to deeply understand the customer’s business objectives, and then design and apply Stripe’s solutions to their challenges. Develop and articulate the end to end customer transformation journey and create future roadmaps and architectures with deep 3rd party integrations in play.
* Lead strategy engagements with users to align to business priorities, design solutions and secure the technical win by performing in\-depth customer discovery, evangelizing the proposed solutions through executive briefings, readouts, presentations and solution demos.
* Bring understanding of the regional market to our Product and Engineering organizations by acting as the “Voice of the User” to bring insights, trends and opportunities to the leadership, product and engineering teams.
* Participate in sales forecasting, Quarterly Business Reviews and account/territory planning to strategically and tactically align for success.
* Act as a crucial part of the sales team, providing technical insight and solutions to prospective and existing platform users. Guide and provide technical expertise on Stripe and its benefits.
* Showcase the capability of Stripe's platform in solving business problems, highlighting features, benefits, and potential customizations.
* Manage pre\-sales projects, coordinating proof of concept development, and feasibility checks. Ensure all solutions proposed are viable, beneficial to our potential clients, and also accommodating to their customers.


 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* 4\+ years of experience in a similar customer\-facing engineering role such as solution consultant, solutions architect, or sales engineer, for a global software enterprise.
* Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.
* Effective group\-facilitation skills and confidence in proposing and leading customer meetings to gain strategic footing and pursue opportunities.
* Thorough understanding of the software development lifecycle and API architecture.
* Outstanding spoken and written communication skills, presentation skills, and confidence in explaining complex concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Gather an in\-depth understanding of all of Stripe’s products and their applicability across diverse business models to beneficially cater to individual clients' and their customers' needs.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* \* Experience as a customer facing, domain expert in the payments space, presenting, and architecting solutions for platform customers.
+ Prior experience driving technical sales and supporting them and their customer’s unique requirements
+ Can read, write, and understand code in one to many programming languages
+ Experience with integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications.
+ Experience in systems design, building and deploying complex applications.
+ Passionate about learning and actively seeks out knowledge
+ Ability to work independently and confidently to develop a path forward with customers under ambiguous circumstances.
+ Strategic and creative thinker who can proactively identify challenges and maintain a positive approach when facing difficult obstacles.
+ Strong collaboration skills to work seamlessly with extended global teams to support our users.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now
